Ur yezmir ara ad ibeddel umyerr n tɣuri kan n ubleɣ-ik aqbur. Senqed tisirag n unekcum ɣer ufaylu.
Tuccḍa: Anekcum yegdel.\n\nAḥric i tebɣiḍ ad tkecmeḍ ɣur-s yesɛa 0 n yigezman, neɣ d ibenk n usekkar.
Anedbal
Akken ad tsaliḍ anuḍaf n VeraCrypt, ilaq ad teqqneḍ s umiḍan yesɛan taseglut n unedbal.
Ẓer belli akken ad twgelhneḍ, ad tzemkeḍ neɣ ad tmesleḍ aḥric/ibenk, ilaq ad teqqneḍ s umiḍan yesɛan taseglut n unedbal.\n\nAya ur yettḥaz ara iblaɣen i yettwaḥerzen deg yifuyla.

Ur yezmir ara ad yessermed asnulfu arurad n yifuyla: ilaq taseglut n unedbal.
Ales asekkar n wahil s yisem n unedbal akken ad tesremdeḍ tameẓlit-a.

Tebɣiḍ ad tkemmleḍ war asnulfu arurad n yifuyla?
Akken ad d-tesnulfuḍ ableɣ uffir, ilaq ad teqqneḍ s umiḍan yesɛan taseglut n unedbal.\n\nAd tkemmleḍ?
Ẓer belli akken ad tmesleḍ ableɣ s NTFS/exFAT/ReFS, ilaq ad teqqneḍ s umiḍan yesɛan taseglut n unedbal.\n\nWar taseglut n unedbal, tzemreḍ ad tmesleḍ ableɣ s FAT.

Alguritm n uwgelhen i yeqbel FIPS (Rijndael, i d-yeffɣen deg 1998), i zemrent ad sqedcent temhaliyin akked tkebbanin n unabaḍ n Marikan i umesten n telɣut yettwasemlen d tuffirt alamma d aswir Top Secret. Tasarut n 256 n yibiten, iḥder n 128 n yibiten, 14 n wallusen (AES-256). Askar n tmahilt d XTS.
Ableɣ yettwaserkeb yakan.
ƔUR-K: Ɣerṣum yiwen n ulguritm n uwgelhen neɣ n ugeddeḥ ur iɛedda ara ikayaden iwurmanen n usenqed iman-is i yellan deg wahil!\n\nAsebded n VeraCrypt yezmer yexṣer.

ƔUR-K: Ulac aṭas n yisefka deg ugraw n usaraw n yimḍanen igacuranen akken ad d-yefk amḍan yettwasutren n yisefka igacuranen.\n\nUr ilaq ara ad tkemmleḍ. Fren « Mmel-d abug » seg wumuɣ n Tallalt, syen mmel-d tuccḍa-a.

Aḍebsi yexṣer (yesɛa lexṣara tarrumant), neɣ agatu yexṣer, neɣ takatut ur tetteddu ara akken iwata.

Ẓer belli ugur-a icudd ɣer warrum-ik, mačči ɣer VeraCrypt. Ihi, ur t-id-mmel ara d abug/ugur n VeraCrypt, ur d-sutur ara tallalt fell-as deg yisuguren n VeraCrypt. Nermes agraw n tallalt tatiknikant n win i k-yesnuzan aselkim-ik akken ad k-iɛiwen. Tanemmirt.

Tamawt: Ma tuccḍa tettuɣal-d yal tikkelt deg yiwen umḍiq, ahat s waṭas d iḥder yexṣer deg uḍebsi i d sebba-s. Yezmer ad yettuseɣti s useqdec n useɣẓan n wiyaḍ (ẓer belli, aṭas n tikal, anaḍ 'chkdsk /r' ur yezmir ara ad t-iseɣti acku ixeddem kan deg uswir n unagraw n yifuyla; tikwal, ula d afecku 'chkdsk' ur yezmir ara ad t-id-yaf).
Ma tkecmeḍ ɣer umeɣri n tannalin tizirazin, ḍmen belli tella tannalt deg umeɣri. Ameɣri/tannalt yezmer yexṣer daɣen (yezmer ad yesɛu lexṣara tarrumant), neɣ agatu yezmer yexṣer neɣ ur yeqqin ara.

Anagraw-ik iban-d iseqdac inuḍafen udmawanen n chipset i yesɛan abug i yesseḥbas awgelhen n uḍebsi n unagraw meṛṛa.\n\nƐreḍ ad tmucceḍeḍ neɣ ad tekkseḍ inuḍafen udmawanen n chipset (wid ur nelli n Microsoft) uqbel ad tkemmleḍ. Ma aya ur d-yewwi ara tifrat, ɛreḍ ad twgelhneḍ aḥric n unagraw kan.

Tawsit n ubleɣ

Yezmer ad k-iḥettem yiwen ad d-temleḍ awal uffir n ubleɣ awgelhan. Llant aṭas n tegnatin ideg ur tezmireḍ ara ad tagiḍ ad t-id-temleḍ (amedya, s uḥettem akked usḥillef). Aseqdec n wayen iwumi neqqar ableɣ uffir ad k-yeǧǧ ad d-teffɣeḍ seg tegnatin-a war ma temleḍ-d awal uffir n ubleɣ-ik.
Fren taxtiṛit-a ma tebɣiḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ ableɣ n VeraCrypt amagnu.
Ẓer belli ma tebɣiḍ ad yettwasbedd unagraw n wammud deg ubleɣ uffir i yellan deg uḥric, aḍebsi n unagraw meṛṛa ur yezmir ara ad yettwawgelhen s yiwet kan n tsarut.

Tuccḍa: Afaylu i uḥraz n yisefka yettwasekkussem deg uswir n unagraw n yifuyla. VeraCrypt ur yessefrak ara ifuyla-a mi ara ttusekkusmen (ẓer belli asekkussem n yisefka iwgelhanen ur ineffaɛ ara, ur yesɛi ara azal).

Ssens asekkussem n ufaylu s uḍfar n yisurifen-a:
1) Sit s tqeffalt tayeffust ɣef ufaylu deg Windows Explorer (mačči deg VeraCrypt).
2) Fren 'Properties'.
3) Deg usfaylu n udiwenni 'Properties', sit ɣef 'Advanced'.
4) Deg usfaylu n udiwenni 'Advanced Attributes', ssens taxtiṛit 'Compress contents to save disk space', syen sit ɣef 'OK'.
5) Deg usfaylu n udiwenni 'Properties', sit ɣef 'OK'.

ƔUR-K: Ibenk/aḥric yettuseqdec sɣur unagraw n wammud neɣ isnasen. Amsal n yibenk/uḥric yezmer ad d-yawi lexṣara n yisefka akked warurked n unagraw.\n\nAd tkemmleḍ?
Ɣur-k: Aḥric yettuseqdec sɣur unagraw n wammud neɣ isnasen. Ilaq ad tmedleḍ yal asnas i izemren ad yili iseqdac aḥric-a (ula d aseɣẓan amgel-avirus).\n\nAd tkemmleḍ?

Tuccḍa: Ibenk/aḥric yesɛa anagraw n yifuyla ur nezmir ara ad nekkes aserkeb-is. Anagraw n wammud yezmer it-iseqdac. Amsal n yibenk/uḥric ahat s waṭas ad d-yawi lexṣara n yisefka akked warurked n unagraw.

Akken ad tefruḍ ugur-a, ad k-nwelleh ad tekkseḍ aḥric di tazwara, syen ad t-id-tesnulfuḍ tikkelt-nniḍen war amsal. I wakken ad tgeḍ aya, ḍfer isurifen-a:
1) Sit s tqeffalt tayeffust ɣef tignit 'Computer' (neɣ 'My Computer') deg 'Start Menu', syen fren 'Manage'. Asfaylu 'Computer Management' ilaq ad d-iban.
2) Deg usfaylu 'Computer Management', fren 'Storage' > 'Disk Management'.
3) Sit s tqeffalt tayeffust ɣef uḥric i tebɣiḍ ad twgelhneḍ, syen fren 'Delete Partition', neɣ 'Delete Volume', neɣ 'Delete Logical Drive'.
4) Sit ɣef 'Yes'. Ma Windows yessuter-ak ad talseḍ asekkar n uselkim, eg-it. Syen ales isurifen 1 akked 2, kemmel seg usurif 5.
5) Sit s tqeffalt tayeffust ɣef teɣzut n tallunt ur nettunefk/illellin, syen fren 'New Partition', neɣ 'New Simple Volume', neɣ 'New Logical Drive'.
6) Asfaylu 'New Partition Wizard' neɣ 'New Simple Volume Wizard' ilaq ad d-iban tura; ḍfer tinaḍin-is. Deg usebter n umallal iwumi qqaren 'Format Partition', fren 'Do not format this partition' neɣ 'Do not format this volume'. Deg umallal-nni kan, sit ɣef 'Next', syen ɣef 'Finish'.
7) Ẓer belli abrid n yibenk i tferneḍ deg VeraCrypt yezmer ur yameɣtu ara tura. Ihi, ffeɣ seg umallal n usnulfu n ubleɣ n VeraCrypt (ma mazal iteddu), syen sekker-it tikkelt-nniḍen.
8) Ɛreḍ ad twgelhneḍ ibenk/aḥric tikkelt-nniḍen.

Ma VeraCrypt ur yezmir ara ad ywgelhen ibenk/aḥric, ɣas tɛerḍeḍ aṭas n tikal, tzemreḍ ad tferneḍ asnulfu n ufaylu i uḥraz n yisefka deg umḍiq-is.

Tuccḍa: Anagraw n yifuyla ur yezmir ara ad yettwasekkeṛ akked/neɣ ad yettwakkes userkeb-is. Anagraw n wammud neɣ isnasen zemren t-seqdacen (amedya, aseɣẓan amgel-avirus). Awgelhen n uḥric yezmer ad d-yawi lexṣara n yisefka akked warurked n unagraw.\n\nMdel yal asnas i izemren ad yili iseqdac anagraw n yifuyla (ula d aseɣẓan amgel-avirus), syen ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen. Ma aya ur d-yewwi ara tifrat, ḍfer isurifen i yellan ddaw-a.

ƔUR-K: Kra n yibenkan/yiḥricen yettwaserkben llan ttuseqdacen yakan!

Ma tɛeddaḍ ɣef waya, yezmer ad d-yawi igmaḍ ur tebɣiḍ ara, gar-asen arurked n unagraw.

Ad k-nwelleh s waṭas ad tmedleḍ yal asnas i izemren ad yili iseqdac ibenkan/iḥricen-a.

Ibenk yettwafernen yesɛa iḥricen.\n\nAmsal n yibenk yezmer ad d-yawi arurked n unagraw akked/neɣ lexṣara n yisefka. Fren aḥric deg yibenk-a, neɣ kkes meṛṛa iḥricen-is akken VeraCrypt ad t-imesel s tɣellist.

Ibenk yettwafernen, ur nelli n unagraw, yesɛa iḥricen.

Iblaɣen iwgelhanen n VeraCrypt i yettwaḥerzen deg yibenkan zemren ad d-nulfun deg yibenkan ur nesɛi ara iḥricen (ula deg yiḍebsiyen iqquranen akked yiḍebsiyen SSD). Ibenk yesɛan iḥricen yezmer ad yettwawgelhen meṛṛa deg umḍiq-is (s yiwet n tsarut tagejdayt) kan ma d aḍebsi ideg yettwasbedd Windows, i seg yettenkar.

Ma tebɣiḍ ad twgelhneḍ ibenk yettwafernen ur nelli n unagraw s yiwet n tsarut tagejdayt, ilaq ad tekkseḍ meṛṛa iḥricen-is di tazwara akken VeraCrypt ad t-imesel s tɣellist (amsal n yibenk yesɛan iḥricen yezmer ad d-yawi arurked n unagraw akked/neɣ lexṣara n yisefka). Tzemreḍ daɣen ad twgelhneḍ yal aḥric n uḍebsi iman-is (yal aḥric ad yettwawgelhen s tsarut tagejdayt yemgaraden).

Tamawt: Ma tebɣiḍ ad tekkseḍ meṛṛa iḥricen seg uḍebsi GPT, yezmer ad teḥwiǧeḍ ad t-teselketeḍ ɣer uḍebsi MBR (s useqdec, amedya, n ufecku Computer Management) akken ad tekkseḍ iḥricen uffiren.

Ɣur-k: Ma twgelhneḍ ibenk meṛṛa (mačči aḥric kan deg-s), inagrawen n wammud ad t-ḥesben d amaynut, d ilem, ur yettwamsal ara (acku ur yesɛu ara tafelwit n yiḥricen). Zemren ad t-wennzen s yiman-nsen (neɣ ad k-steqsin ma tebɣiḍ ad tgeḍ aya), ayen i izemren ad yessexṣer ableɣ. Rnu ɣer-s, ur tezmireḍ ara ad tserkbeḍ ableɣ d anurif s wudem i yezgan yetteddu (amedya, mi ara ibeddel wuṭṭun n uḍebsi), neɣ ad as-tefkeḍ tabzimt n ubleɣ anurif.

Akken ad tḥerzeḍ iman-ik seg waya, tzemreḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ aḥric deg yibenk, syen ad twgelhneḍ aḥric-nni deg umḍiq-is.

Tebɣiḍ s tidet ad twgelhneḍ ibenk meṛṛa?

D AYEN ILAQEN: Cfu belli ableɣ-a ur yezmir ARA ad yettwaserkeb/ad tkecmeḍ ɣur-s s usekkil n umeɣri %c:, i as-yettunefken tura!

Akken ad tserkbeḍ ableɣ-a, sit ɣef « Serkeb ibenkan s wudem awurman » deg usfaylu agejdan n VeraCrypt (neɣ, deg usfaylu agejdan n VeraCrypt, sit ɣef « Fren ibenk », syen fren aḥric/ibenk-a, sit ɣef « Serkeb »). Ableɣ ad yettwaserkeb s usekkil-nniḍen n umeɣri, ara tferneḍ seg tebdart deg usfaylu agejdan n VeraCrypt.

Asekkil n umeɣri aneṣli %c: ilaq ad yettuseqdec kan ma teḥwiǧeḍ ad tekkseḍ awgelhen seg uḥric/yibenk (amedya, ma ur teḥwaǧeḍ ara awgelhen). Deg tegnit-a, sit s tqeffalt tayeffust ɣef usekkil n umeɣri %c: deg tebdart 'Computer' (neɣ 'My Computer'), syen fren 'Format'. Ma ulac, asekkil n umeɣri %c: ur ilaq ara ad t-tesqedceḍ akk (anagar ma tekkseḍ-it, am wakken d-yettwasegza, amedya, deg tuttriwin yezgan n VeraCrypt, syen tefkiḍ-t i uḥric/yibenk-nniḍen).

Awgelhen deg umḍiq n yiblaɣen ur nelli n unagraw ur yettusefrak ara deg lqem n unagraw n wammud i tseqdaceḍ tura (yettusefrak kan deg Windows Vista akked yileqman n Windows i d-yeḍfaren).\n\nSebba-s d akken lqem-a n Windows ur yessefrak ara asmeẓẓi n unagraw n yifuyla (ilaq ad yettusmeẓẓi unagraw n yifuyla akken ad tili tallunt i tsenṭit n ubleɣ akked tsenṭit n uḥraz).

Aḥric yettwafernen iban-d ur yesɛi ara anagraw n yifuyla NTFS. Ala iḥricen yesɛan anagraw n yifuyla NTFS i izemren ad ttwawgelhnen deg umḍiq-nsen.\n\nTamawt: Sebba-s d akken Windows ur yessefrak ara asmeẓẓi n tewsatin-nniḍen n yinagrawen n yifuyla (ilaq ad yettusmeẓẓi unagraw n yifuyla akken ad tili tallunt i tsenṭit n ubleɣ akked tsenṭit n uḥraz).

Aḥric yettwafernen iban-d ur yesɛi ara anagraw n yifuyla NTFS. Ala iḥricen yesɛan anagraw n yifuyla NTFS i izemren ad ttwawgelhnen deg umḍiq-nsen.\n\nMa tebɣiḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ ableɣ awgelhan n VeraCrypt deg uḥric-a, fren taxtiṛit « Snulfu-d ableɣ awgelhan, syen msel-it » (deg umḍiq n textiṛit « Wgelhen aḥric deg umḍiq-is »).
Tuccḍa: Aḥric meẓẓiy aṭas. VeraCrypt ur yezmir ara ad t-ywgelhen deg umḍiq-is.

Akken ad twgelhneḍ isefka deg uḥric-a, ḍfer isurifen-a:

1) Snulfu-d ableɣ n VeraCrypt deg uḥric/yibenk ilem, syen serkeb-it.

2) Nɣel meṛṛa ifuyla seg uḥric i tebɣiḍ ad twgelhneḍ di tazwara ɣer ubleɣ n VeraCrypt yettwaserkben (i d-yenulfan, yettwaserkben deg usurif 1). S wakka, ad d-tesnulfuḍ anɣel n uḥraz n yisefka, iwgelhan s VeraCrypt.

3) Snulfu-d ableɣ n VeraCrypt deg uḥric i tebɣiḍ ad twgelhneḍ di tazwara, ḍmen belli (deg umallal n VeraCrypt) tferneḍ taxtiṛit « Snulfu-d ableɣ awgelhan, syen msel-it » (deg umḍiq n textiṛit « Wgelhen aḥric deg umḍiq-is »). Ẓer belli meṛṛa isefka yettwaḥerzen deg uḥric ad ttwasefḍen. Mi d-yenulfa ubleɣ, serkeb-it.

4) Nɣel meṛṛa ifuyla seg ubleɣ n uḥraz n VeraCrypt yettwaserkben (i d-yenulfan, yettwaserkben deg usurif 1) ɣer ubleɣ n VeraCrypt yettwaserkben i d-yenulfan (yettwaserkben) deg usurif 3.

Mi tfukkeḍ isurifen-a, isefka ad ilin wgelhnen, rnu ɣer-s ad yili unɣel n uḥraz awgelhan n yisefka.

VeraCrypt yezmer ad ywgelhen deg umḍiq kan aḥric, ableɣ asmussaw, neɣ aḍebsi n unagraw meṛṛa.\n\nMa tebɣiḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ ableɣ awgelhan n VeraCrypt deg yibenk yettwafernen ur nelli n unagraw, fren taxtiṛit « Snulfu-d ableɣ awgelhan, syen msel-it » (deg umḍiq n textiṛit « Wgelhen aḥric deg umḍiq-is »).
Tuccḍa: VeraCrypt yezmer ad ywgelhen deg umḍiq kan aḥric, ableɣ asmussaw, neɣ aḍebsi n unagraw meṛṛa. Ḍmen belli abrid yettunefken d ameɣtu.

Tuccḍa: Ur yezmir ara ad yesmeẓẓi anagraw n yifuyla (ilaq ad yettusmeẓẓi unagraw n yifuyla akken ad tili tallunt i tsenṭit n ubleɣ akked tsenṭit n uḥraz).

Timentilin akked tifratin i izemren ad ilint:

- Ulac tallunt tilellit s wazal ilaqen deg ubleɣ. Ḍmen belli ulac asnas-nniḍen i yettarun deg unagraw n yifuyla.

- Anagraw n yifuyla yexṣer. Ɛreḍ ad t-tesneqdeḍ, ad tseɣtiḍ yal tuccḍa (sit s tqeffalt tayeffust ɣef usekkil n umeɣri i t-yerzan deg tebdart 'Computer', syen fren Properties > Tools > 'Check Now', ḍmen belli taxtiṛit 'Automatically fix file system errors' termed, sit ɣef Start).

Ma isurifen i yellan sufella ur d-wwin ara tifrat, ḍfer isurifen i yellan ddaw-a.

Tuccḍa: Ulac tallunt tilellit s wazal ilaqen deg ubleɣ, ihi anagraw n yifuyla ur yezmir ara ad yettusmeẓẓi (ilaq ad yettusmeẓẓi unagraw n yifuyla akken ad tili tallunt i tsenṭit n ubleɣ akked tsenṭit n uḥraz).

Kkes ifuyla ur teḥwaǧeḍ ara, Err Recycle Bin d ilem akken ad teslelliḍ ɣerṣum 256 KiB n tallunt, syen ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen. Ẓer belli s sebba n wugur deg Windows, azal n tallunt tilellit i d-yeskan Windows Explorer yezmer ur yameɣtu ara alamma tɛawdeḍ asekkar n unagraw n wammud. Ma wallus n usekkar n unagraw ur d-yewwi ara tifrat, anagraw n yifuyla yezmer yexṣer. Ɛreḍ ad t-tesneqdeḍ, ad tseɣtiḍ yal tuccḍa (sit s tqeffalt tayeffust ɣef usekkil n umeɣri i t-yerzan deg tebdart 'Computer', syen fren Properties > Tools > 'Check Now', ḍmen belli taxtiṛit 'Automatically fix file system errors' termed, sit ɣef Start).

Ma isurifen i yellan sufella ur d-wwin ara tifrat, ḍfer isurifen i yellan ddaw-a.

Tuccḍa: Anuḍaf n VeraCrypt ur yettwaf ara.\n\nNɣel ifuyla 'veracrypt.sys' akked 'veracrypt-x64.sys' ɣer ukaram ideg yella usnas agejdan n VeraCrypt (VeraCrypt.exe).

Ma tɛerḍeḍ ad tsekkreḍ VeraCrypt deg weskar aninig (d anamek, war ma tesbeddeḍ-t), yerna lqem-nniḍen n VeraCrypt yettwasbedd yakan, ilaq ad t-tekkseḍ di tazwara (neɣ ad t-tmucceḍeḍ s useqdec n umsebdad n VeraCrypt). Akken ad t-tekkseḍ, ḍfer isurifen-a: Deg Windows Vista neɣ lqem i t-id-yeḍfaren, fren 'Start Menu' > Computer > 'Uninstall or change a program' > VeraCrypt > Uninstall; deg Windows XP, fren 'Start Menu' > Settings > 'Control Panel' > 'Add Or Remove Programs' > VeraCrypt > Remove.

Akka daɣen, ma tɛerḍeḍ ad tsekkreḍ VeraCrypt deg weskar aninig (d anamek, war ma tesbeddeḍ-t), yerna lqem-nniḍen n VeraCrypt iteddu yakan deg weskar aninig, ilaq ad talseḍ asekkar n unagraw di tazwara, syen ad tsekkreḍ ala lqem-a amaynut.
Tuccḍa: Ur yeddi ara uwennez n ulguritm n uwgelhen.

Teḍra-d tuccḍa meqqren, ilaq ad yeḥbes VeraCrypt. Ma sebba-s d abug deg VeraCrypt, nebɣa ad t-nseɣti. Akken ad aɣ-tɛiwneḍ, tzemreḍ ad aɣ-d-tazneḍ aneqqis n tuccḍa i d-yenulfan s wudem awurman, yesɛan iferdisen-a:

Tebɣiḍ ad aɣ-d-tazneḍ aneqqis n tuccḍa i yellan sufella?

Teḍra-d tuccḍa meqqren deg unagraw-ik, ayen i d-yessuturen ad yeḥbes VeraCrypt.\n\nẒer belli tuccḍa-a ur d-tekki ara seg VeraCrypt (ihi ineflayen n VeraCrypt ur zmiren ara ad tt-seɣtin). Senqed anagraw-ik ma yesɛa uguren (amedya, tawila n unagraw, tuqqna ɣer uzeṭṭa, isuddisen n warrum yexṣren).

Teḍra-d tuccḍa meqqren deg unagraw-ik, ayen i d-yessuturen ad yeḥbes VeraCrypt.\n\nMa ugur-a mazal-it, tzemreḍ ad tɛerḍeḍ ad tessenseḍ neɣ ad tekkseḍ isnasen i izemren ad ilin d sebba-s, am yiseɣẓanen imgel-avirus neɣ n tɣellist n Internet, ifecka n « usnerni », n « usemnaḍ » neɣ n « ubeddel n yiɣewwaren » n unagraw, atg. Ma aya ur d-yewwi ara tifrat, tzemreḍ ad tɛerḍeḍ ad talseḍ asebded n unagraw-ik n wammud (ugur-a yezmer daɣen ad d-yekki seg yiseɣẓanen imḍurren).
Tuccḍa meqqren n VeraCrypt

VeraCrypt yufa-d belli anagraw n wammud yeɣli melmi kan. Llant aṭas n tmentilin i izemren ad ilin d sebba n uɣelluy n unagraw (amedya, asuddis n warrum yexṣren, abug deg unuḍaf n yibenk, atg.)\n\nTebɣiḍ VeraCrypt ad isenqed ma yella d abug deg VeraCrypt i izemren ad yili d sebba n uɣelluy n unagraw?
Tebɣiḍ VeraCrypt ad ikemmel tifin n yiɣelluyen n unagraw?
VeraCrypt ur yufi ara afaylu n uḍeffi ameẓyan n tkatut n uɣelluy n unagraw.
Tebɣiḍ ad tekkseḍ afaylu n uḍeffi n tkatut n uɣelluy n Windows akken ad teslelliḍ tallunt deg uḍebsi?

Akken ad isleḍ aɣelluy n unagraw, VeraCrypt yeḥwaǧ ad isbedd di tazwara Microsoft Debugging Tools for Windows.\n\nMi ara tsiteḍ ɣef IH, amsebdad n Windows ad d-isider akemmus n usebded n Microsoft Debugging Tools (16 MiB) seg uqeddac n Microsoft, syen ad t-isbedd (amsebdad n Windows ad yettwawelleh seg uqeddac veracrypt.org ɣer tansa URL n uqeddac n Microsoft, ayen ara yeḍemnen belli tameẓlit-a ad teddu ɣas ma Microsoft ibeddel adeg n ukemmus n usebded).
Mi ara tsiteḍ ɣef IH, VeraCrypt ad isleḍ aɣelluy n unagraw. Aya yezmer ad yeṭṭef kra n tesdatin.
Ḍmen belli amutti n twennaṭ 'PATH' yesɛa abrid ɣer 'kd.exe' (Kernel Debugger).

Iban-d belli ahat s waṭas VeraCrypt mačči d netta i d sebba n uɣelluy n unagraw. Llant aṭas n tmentilin i izemren ad ilin d sebba n uɣelluy n unagraw (amedya, asuddis n warrum yexṣren, abug deg unuḍaf n yibenk, atg.)
Igmaḍ n tesleḍt skanayen-d belli amucceḍ n unuḍaf-a yezmer ad yefru ugur-a:

Akken ad aɣ-tɛiwneḍ ad nẓer ma yella ubug deg VeraCrypt, tzemreḍ ad aɣ-d-tazneḍ aneqqis n tuccḍa i d-yenulfan s wudem awurman, yesɛan iferdisen-a:
- Lqem n wahil
- Lqem n unagraw n wammud
- Tawsit n CPU
- Taggayt n tuccḍa
- Isem akked lqem n unuḍaf
- Akufi n teɣriwin n unagraw

Ma tferneḍ « Ih », tansa URL-a (i yesɛan aneqqis n tuccḍa meṛṛa) ad tettwaldi deg yiminig-ik n Internet n lexṣas.
Tebɣiḍ ad aɣ-d-tazneḍ aneqqis n tuccḍa i yellan sufella?

Snulfu-d ameɣri ameẓẓul i uḥric-a yettwasɣezfen, syen ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen.

Ableɣ n VeraCrypt yezmer ad yili deg ufaylu (iwumi neqqar afaylu n VeraCrypt i uḥraz n yisefka), i izemren ad yili deg uḍebsi aqquran, deg tsarut USB, atg. Afaylu n VeraCrypt i uḥraz n yisefka am yal afaylu amagnu (yezmer, amedya, ad yettwasmutti neɣ ad yettwakkes am yal afaylu amagnu). Sit ɣef « Fren afaylu » akken ad tferneḍ isem n ufaylu i uḥraz n yisefka akked wadeg ideg tebɣiḍ ad d-yenulfu.\n\nƔUR-K: Ma tferneḍ afaylu yellan yakan, VeraCrypt ur t-yettwgelhin ARA; afaylu ad yettwakkes, ad yettwasemselsi s ufaylu amaynut n VeraCrypt i uḥraz n yisefka. Tzemreḍ ad twgelhneḍ ifuyla yellan yakan (syen akkin) s usmutti-nsen ɣer ufaylu n VeraCrypt i uḥraz n yisefka i tebɣiḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ tura.

Fren adeg n ubleɣ aniri ara d-yenulfun (deg ubleɣ-a ara d-yenulfu ubleɣ uffir syen akkin).\n\nAbleɣ n VeraCrypt yezmer ad yili deg ufaylu (iwumi neqqar afaylu n VeraCrypt i uḥraz n yisefka), i izemren ad yili deg uḍebsi aqquran, deg tsarut USB, atg. Afaylu n VeraCrypt i uḥraz n yisefka yezmer ad yettwasmutti neɣ ad yettwakkes am yal afaylu amagnu. Sit ɣef « Fren afaylu » akken ad tferneḍ isem n ufaylu i uḥraz n yisefka akked wadeg ideg tebɣiḍ ad d-yenulfu. Ma tferneḍ afaylu yellan yakan, VeraCrypt ur t-yettwgelhin ARA; ad yettwakkes, ad yettwasemselsi s ufaylu amaynut i uḥraz n yisefka. Tzemreḍ ad twgelhneḍ ifuyla yellan yakan (syen akkin) s usmutti-nsen ɣer ufaylu n VeraCrypt i uḥraz n yisefka i tebɣiḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ tura.

Iblaɣen iwgelhanen n VeraCrypt i yettwaḥerzen deg yibenkan zemren ad d-nulfun deg yiḥricen n yiḍebsiyen iqquranen, deg yiḍebsiyen SSD, deg tsura USB, akked yal ibenk-nniḍen n uḥraz yettusefraken. Iḥricen zemren daɣen ad ttwawgelhnen deg umḍiq-nsen.

Rnu ɣer-s, iblaɣen iwgelhanen n VeraCrypt i yettwaḥerzen deg yibenkan zemren ad d-nulfun deg yibenkan ur nesɛi ara iḥricen (ula deg yiḍebsiyen iqquranen akked yiḍebsiyen SSD).

Tamawt: Ibenk yesɛan iḥricen yezmer ad yettwawgelhen meṛṛa deg umḍiq-is (s yiwet n tsarut) kan ma d aḍebsi ideg yettwasbedd Windows, i seg yettenkar.

Ableɣ n VeraCrypt i yettwaḥerzen deg yibenk yezmer ad d-yenulfu deg uḥric n uḍebsi aqquran, deg uḍebsi SSD, deg tsarut USB, akked yibenkan-nniḍen n uḥraz.\n\nƔUR-K: Ẓer belli aḥric/ibenk ad yettwamsal, meṛṛa isefka i yellan deg-s tura ad ṛuḥen.

Fren adeg n ubleɣ aniri ara d-yenulfun (deg ubleɣ-a ara d-yenulfu ubleɣ uffir syen akkin).

Iblaɣen iniriyen zemren ad d-nulfun deg yiḥricen n yiḍebsiyen iqquranen, deg yiḍebsiyen SSD, deg tsura USB, akked yal ibenk-nniḍen n uḥraz yettusefraken. Iblaɣen iniriyen zemren daɣen ad d-nulfun deg yibenkan ur nesɛi ara iḥricen (ula deg yiḍebsiyen iqquranen akked yiḍebsiyen SSD).

ƔUR-K: Ẓer belli aḥric/ibenk ad yettwamsal, meṛṛa isefka i yellan deg-s tura ad ṛuḥen.
\nFren adeg n ubleɣ n VeraCrypt ideg tebɣiḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ ableɣ uffir.

ƔUR-K: Afaylu/ibenk ideg yella ubleɣ yettuseqdec yakan!

Ma tɛeddaḍ ɣef waya, yezmer ad d-yawi igmaḍ ur tebɣiḍ ara, gar-asen arurked n unagraw. Ilaq ad tmedleḍ meṛṛa isnasen i izemren ad ilin seqdacen afaylu/ibenk-a (amedya, isnasen imgel-avirus neɣ n uḥraz) uqbel aserkeb n ubleɣ.

Ad tkemmleḍ aserkeb?
Tuccḍa: Ur yezmir ara ad yserkeb ableɣ. Afaylu/ibenk ideg yella ubleɣ yettuseqdec yakan. Ula d aɛraḍ n userkeb war anekcum uslig ur yeddi ara.
Afaylu ur yezmir ara ad yettwaldi.
Adeg n ubleɣ
Ifuyla imeqqranen
Tebɣiḍ ad tḥerzeḍ ifuyla yugaren 4 GiB deg ubleɣ-a n VeraCrypt?
Ilmend n ufran-ik sufella, VeraCrypt ad yefren anagraw n yifuyla n lexṣas iwulmen i ubleɣ n VeraCrypt (ad tezmireḍ ad tferneḍ anagraw n yifuyla deg usurif i d-iteddun).

Imi tessnufluyeḍ-d ableɣ aniri, yelha ad tferneḍ « Ala ». Ma tferneḍ « Ih », anagraw n yifuyla n lexṣas ad yili d NTFS, ur iwulmen ara i yiblaɣen iniriyen am FAT/exFAT (amedya, tiddi tafellayt i izemren ad yesɛu ubleɣ uffir ad tili meqqret ugar s waṭas ma ubleɣ aniri yettwamsal s FAT/exFAT). S umata, FAT d afran n lexṣas i yiblaɣen uffiren akked yiblaɣen imagnuyen (ihi iblaɣen FAT ur d-ttawin ara ccek). Maca, ma useqdac yebɣa ad iḥrez ifuyla yugaren 4 GiB (ayen ur yessirig ara unagraw n yifuyla FAT), FAT ur yettili ara d afran n lexṣas.
Tebɣiḍ s tidet ad tferneḍ « Ih »?
Askar n usnulfu n ubleɣ

D abrid arurad akk i usnulfu n ubleɣ n VeraCrypt deg uḥric neɣ deg yibenk (awgelhen deg umḍiq, i d taxtiṛit-nniḍen, ẓẓay acku agbur n yal agzum ilaq ad yettwaɣra di tazwara, ad yettwawgelhen, syen ad yettwaru). Meṛṛa isefka i yellan tura deg uḥric/yibenk yettwafernen ad ṛuḥen (isefka ur ttwawgelhanen ARA; ad ttwarun yisefka igacuranen deg umḍiq-nsen). Ma tebɣiḍ ad twgelhneḍ isefka yellan yakan deg uḥric, fren taxtiṛit-nniḍen.
Aḥric yettwafernen meṛṛa akked meṛṛa isefka i yellan deg-s ad ttwawgelhnen deg umḍiq-nsen. Ma aḥric d ilem, ilaq ad tferneḍ taxtiṛit-nniḍen (ableɣ ad d-yenulfu s urured ugar).

Agbur n uḥric/yibenk yettwasefḍ akken iwata.
Agbur n uḥric ideg yella unagraw aneṣli (i seg d-yenɣel unagraw uffir) yettwasefḍ akken iwata.
Ḍmen belli lqem n Windows ara tesbeddeḍ (deg uḥric yettwasefḍen) d win n Windows i tseqdaceḍ tura. Aya ilaq acku sin yinagrawen ad cerken yiwen n uḥric n usekkar.

Aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw yettwawgelhen akken iwata.\n\nTamawt: Ma llan iblaɣen n VeraCrypt ur nelli n unagraw i teḥwaǧeḍ ad ttwaserkben s wudem awurman yal tikkelt ara yekker Windows, tzemreḍ ad tesɣewreḍ aya s userkeb n yal yiwen deg-sen, syen s ufran n « Inurifen » > « Rnu ableɣ yettwaserkben ɣer yinurifen n unagraw »).
Aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw yettwazmek akken iwata.
\n\nAbleɣ n VeraCrypt yenulfa-d, yewjed i useqdec. Ma tebɣiḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ ableɣ-nniḍen n VeraCrypt, sit ɣef « Uḍfir ». Ma ulac, sit ɣef « Ffeɣ ».

Ableɣ uffir n VeraCrypt yenulfa-d akken iwata (anagraw n wammud uffir ad yili deg ubleɣ-a uffir).

D AYEN ILAQEN: AKKEN AD TSERKBEḌ ABLEƔ-A AMAYNUT N VERACRYPT, AD TKECMEḌ ƔER YISEFKA I YELLAN DEG-S, SIT ƔEF « Serkeb ibenkan s wudem awurman » DEG USFAYLU AGEJDAN N VERACRYPT. Mi tesnekcmeḍ awal uffir ameɣtu (akked/neɣ tefkiḍ ifuyla n tsura imeɣta), ableɣ ad yettwaserkeb s usekkil n umeɣri ara tferneḍ seg tebdart deg usfaylu agejdan n VeraCrypt (ad tezmireḍ ad tkecmeḍ ɣer yisefka iwgelhanen s usekkil n umeɣri yettwafernen).

CFU ƔEF YISURIFEN I YELLAN SUFELLA NEƔ ARU-TEN. ILAQ AD TEN-TḌEFREḌ YAL TIKKELT ARA TEBƔUḌ AD TSERKBEḌ ABLEƔ, AD TKECMEḌ ƔER YISEFKA I YELLAN DEG-S. Tzemreḍ daɣen, deg usfaylu agejdan n VeraCrypt, ad tsiteḍ ɣef « Fren ibenk », syen ad tferneḍ aḥric/ableɣ-a, ad tsiteḍ ɣef « Serkeb ».

Aḥric/ableɣ yettwawgelhen akken iwata (yesɛa tura ableɣ n VeraCrypt iwgelhan meṛṛa), yewjed i useqdec.

D AYEN ILAQEN: Alamma tefkiḍ asekkil n umeɣri i ubleɣ yettwazemken, ur tezmireḍ ara ad tkecmeḍ ɣer yisefka i yellan deg-s.

Ɣur-k: Akken ad tkecmeḍ ɣer yisefka yettwazemken, ilaq ad yettunefk usekkil n umeɣri i ubleɣ yettwazemken. Maca, ulac asekkil n umeɣri ilellin tura.\n\nSlelli asekkil n umeɣri (amedya, s tukksa n tuqqna n tsarut USB neɣ n uḍebsi aqquran aniri, atg.), syen sit ɣef IH.

Adobe Reader (neɣ afecku yemṣadan) ilaq akken ad twaliḍ neɣ ad tsiggezeḍ amnir n useqdac n VeraCrypt. Adobe Reader (aseɣẓan baṭel) yezmer ad d-yettwasider seg: www.adobe.com\n\nTebɣiḍ ad twaliḍ tumlin s tuqqna deg umḍiq-is?
Ma tferneḍ taxtiṛit-a, amallal ad k-iɛiwen di tazwara ad d-tesnulfuḍ ableɣ n VeraCrypt amagnu, syen ableɣ uffir n VeraCrypt deg-s. Iseqdacen ur nesɛi ara tirmit ilaq ad fernen taxtiṛit-a yal tikkelt.
Ma tferneḍ taxtiṛit-a, ad d-tesnulfuḍ ableɣ uffir deg ubleɣ n VeraCrypt yellan yakan. Ad yettwaḥseb belli tesnulfaḍ-d yakan ableɣ n VeraCrypt iwulmen i uḥraz n ubleɣ uffir.
Askar n usnulfu n ubleɣ
Ableɣ uffir yenulfa-d

Ableɣ uffir n VeraCrypt yenulfa-d akken iwata, yewjed i useqdec. Ma ttwaḍefrent meṛṛa tinaḍin, yerna ttwaḍefrent daɣen tiwtilin akked yiḥader i d-yettwabedren deg uḥric "Security Requirements and Precautions Pertaining to Hidden Volumes" deg umnir n useqdac n VeraCrypt, ilaq ad yili d ayen ur nezmir ara ad yettwaseknen belli ableɣ uffir yella, ɣas ma ableɣ aniri yettwaserkeb.\n\nƔUR-K: MA UR TEMMESTNEḌ ARA ABLEƔ UFFIR (I WUGAR N TELƔUT ƔEF WAMEK, WALI AḤRIC "PROTECTION OF HIDDEN VOLUMES AGAINST DAMAGE" DEG UMNIR N USEQDAC N VERACRYPT), UR TTARU ARA DEG UBLEƔ ANIRI. MA ULAC, TZEMREḌ AD TARUḌ ƔEF UBLEƔ UFFIR, AD T-TESSEXṢREḌ!

Tsekkreḍ anagraw n wammud uffir. Akken ahat twalaḍ, anagraw n wammud uffir iban-d yettwasbedd deg yiwen uḥric akked unagraw n wammud aneṣli. Maca, s tidet, yettwasbedd deg uḥric i yellan deffir-s (deg ubleɣ uffir). Meṛṛa timhal n tɣuri akked tira ttuwellehent seg uḥric n unagraw aneṣli ɣer ubleɣ uffir war ma iban-d ubeddel-a.

Anagraw n wammud neɣ isnasen ur ẓerren ara belli isefka yettwarun deg uḥric n unagraw, yettwaɣran seg-s, ttwarun s tidet deg uḥric i yellan deffir-s, ttwaɣran seg-s (seg/ɣer ubleɣ uffir). Meṛṛa isefka-a ttwawgelhanen, ttwazemken srid mi ara ttuseqdacen am yal tikkelt (s tsarut n uwgelhen yemgaraden ɣef tin ara yettuseqdec i unagraw n wammud n useɣleḍ).


Sit ɣef « Uḍfir » akken ad tkemmleḍ.

Ableɣ aniri yenulfa-d, yettwaserkeb d ameɣri %hc:. Tura ilaq ad tenɣleḍ ɣer ubleɣ-a aniri kra n yifuyla i d-ibannen sɛan isefka uffiren, maca s tidet ur tebɣiḍ ARA ad ten-teffreḍ. Ad ilin i yal win ara k-iḥettmen ad d-temleḍ awal uffir n uḥric amezwaru i yellan deffir uḥric n unagraw, ideg ara ilin ubleɣ aniri akked ubleɣ uffir (i yesɛan anagraw n wammud uffir). Ad tezmireḍ ad d-temleḍ awal uffir n ubleɣ-a aniri, ma d tilin n ubleɣ uffir (akked unagraw n wammud uffir) ad teqqim d tuffirt.\n\nD AYEN ILAQEN: Ifuyla ara tenɣleḍ ɣer ubleɣ aniri ur ilaq ara ad ṭṭfen ugar n %s. Ma ulac, yezmer ur tettɣimi ara tallunt tilellit s wazal ilaqen deg ubleɣ aniri i ubleɣ uffir (ur tezmireḍ ara ad tkemmleḍ). Mi tfukkeḍ asenɣel, sit ɣef « Uḍfir » (ur kkes ara aserkeb n ubleɣ).

Ableɣ aniri yenulfa-d akken iwata, yettwaserkeb d ameɣri %hc:. Tura ilaq ad tenɣleḍ ɣer ubleɣ-a kra n yifuyla i d-ibannen sɛan isefka uffiren, maca s tidet ur tebɣiḍ ARA ad ten-teffreḍ. Ifuyla ad ilin i yal win ara k-iḥettmen ad d-temleḍ awal-ik uffir. Ad d-temleḍ ala awal uffir n ubleɣ-a aniri, mačči win n ubleɣ uffir. Ifuyla i teḥwaǧeḍ s tidet ad ten-tḥerzeḍ ad ilin deg ubleɣ uffir, ara d-yenulfun syen akkin. Mi tfukkeḍ asenɣel, sit ɣef « Uḍfir ». Ur kkes ara aserkeb n ubleɣ.\n\nTamawt: Mi ara tsiteḍ ɣef « Uḍfir », bitmap n yiguza n ubleɣ aniri ad yettwasleḍ akken ad tettwassen tiddi n teɣzut n tallunt tilellit ur nebḍi ara, i taggara-s temṣada akked taggara n ubleɣ. Taɣzut-a ad teḥrez ableɣ uffir, ihi ad terr tilist i tiddi-s tafellayt. Tasleḍt n bitmap n yiguza teḍemmen belli ableɣ uffir ur yettaru ara ɣef yisefka yellan deg ubleɣ aniri.
Agbur n ubleɣ aniri
\n\nDeg yisurifen i d-iteddun, ad tesɣewreḍ tixtiṛiyin n ubleɣ aniri (ideg ara d-yenulfu ubleɣ uffir syen akkin).
\n\nDeg yisurifen i d-iteddun, ad d-tesnulfuḍ ayen iwumi neqqar ableɣ aniri n VeraCrypt deg uḥric amezwaru i yellan deffir uḥric n unagraw (am wakken d-yettwasegza deg yiwen n yisurifen yezrin).
Ableɣ aniri

Deg yisurifen i d-iteddun, ad tesɣewreḍ tixtiṛiyin akked wawal uffir n ubleɣ uffir, ara yeḥerzen anagraw n wammud uffir.\n\nTamawt: Bitmap n yiguza n ubleɣ aniri yettwasleḍ akken ad tettwassen tiddi n teɣzut n tallunt tilellit ur nebḍi ara, i taggara-s temṣada akked taggara n ubleɣ aniri. Taɣzut-a ad teḥrez ableɣ uffir, ihi ad terr tilist i tiddi-s tafellayt. Tiddi tafellayt i izemren ad yesɛu ubleɣ uffir tettwasbadu, yettwasenqed belli tugar tiddi n uḥric n unagraw (aya ilaq acku meṛṛa agbur n uḥric n unagraw ilaq ad yettwanɣel ɣer ubleɣ uffir). Aya yeḍemmen belli isefka ara yettwarun deg teɣzut n ubleɣ uffir ur ttarun ara ɣef yisefka i yellan tura deg ubleɣ aniri.

D AYEN ILAQEN: Cfu ɣef yilguritmen ara tferneḍ deg usurif-a. Ilaq ad tferneḍ ilguritmen-nni kan i unagraw n useɣleḍ. Ma ulac, ur tezmireḍ ara ad tkecmeḍ ɣer unagraw uffir! (Anagraw n useɣleḍ ilaq ad yettwawgelhen s yiwen ulguritm n uwgelhen akked unagraw uffir.)\n\nTamawt: Sebba-s d akken anagraw n useɣleḍ akked unagraw uffir ad cerken yiwen n umsali n usekkar, i yessefraken yiwen kan n ulguritm i yefren useqdac (yal alguritm yesɛa lqem uslig n umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt).
\n\nBitmap n yiguza n ubleɣ yettwasleḍ, tiddi tafellayt i izemren ad yesɛu ubleɣ uffir tettwasbadu. Deg yisurifen i d-iteddun, ad tesɣewreḍ tixtiṛiyin, tiddi akked wawal uffir n ubleɣ uffir.
Ableɣ uffir

Ableɣ uffir yettwammesten tura seg lexṣara alamma yettwakkes userkeb n ubleɣ aniri.\n\nƔUR-K: Ma yella uɛraḍ n uḥraz n yisefka deg teɣzut n ubleɣ uffir, VeraCrypt ad yebdu amesten mgal tira n ubleɣ meṛṛa (ama aḥric aniri, ama win uffir) alamma yettwakkes userkeb-is. Aya yezmer ad yessexṣer anagraw n yifuyla n ubleɣ aniri, ayen i izemren (ma yettuɣal-d) ad yesḍeɛf tazmert n tnekra n tilin n ubleɣ uffir s wudem ara yettwamnen. Ihi, ilaq ad tɛerḍeḍ s wayen akk tzemreḍ ad teǧǧeḍ tira deg teɣzut n ubleɣ uffir. Isefka ara yettwaɛerḍen ad ttwaḥerzen deg teɣzut n ubleɣ uffir ur ttwaḥrazen ara, ad ṛuḥen. Windows yezmer ad d-yesken aya d tuccḍa n tira ("Delayed Write Failed" neɣ "The parameter is incorrect").

Yal ableɣ uffir deg yiblaɣen i d-yettwaserkben tura yettwammesten seg lexṣara alamma yettwakkes userkeb.\n\nƔUR-K: Ma yella uɛraḍ n uḥraz n yisefka deg teɣzut yettwammestnen n ubleɣ uffir deg yiwen seg yiblaɣen-a, VeraCrypt ad yebdu amesten mgal tira n ubleɣ meṛṛa (ama aḥric aniri, ama win uffir) alamma yettwakkes userkeb-is. Aya yezmer ad yessexṣer anagraw n yifuyla n ubleɣ aniri, ayen i izemren (ma yettuɣal-d) ad yesḍeɛf tazmert n tnekra n tilin n ubleɣ uffir s wudem ara yettwamnen. Ihi, ilaq ad tɛerḍeḍ s wayen akk tzemreḍ ad teǧǧeḍ tira deg teɣzut n ubleɣ uffir. Isefka ara yettwaɛerḍen ad ttwaḥerzen deg teɣzuyin yettwammestnen n yiblaɣen uffiren ur ttwaḥrazen ara, ad ṛuḥen. Windows yezmer ad d-yesken aya d tuccḍa n tira ("Delayed Write Failed" neɣ "The parameter is incorrect").

ƔUR-K: Yella uɛraḍ n uḥraz n yisefka deg teɣzut n ubleɣ uffir n ubleɣ yettwaserkben d %c:! VeraCrypt yegdel aḥraz n yisefka-a akken ad immesten ableɣ uffir. Aya yezmer yessexṣer anagraw n yifuyla n ubleɣ aniri, Windows yezmer yesken-d tuccḍa n tira ("Delayed Write Failed" neɣ "The parameter is incorrect"). Ableɣ meṛṛa (ama aḥric aniri, ama win uffir) ad yettwammesten mgal tira alamma yettwakkes userkeb-is. Ma mačči d tikkelt tamezwarut i yegdel VeraCrypt aḥraz n yisefka deg teɣzut n ubleɣ uffir n ubleɣ-a, tazmert n tnekra n tilin n ubleɣ-a uffir s wudem ara yettwamnen tezmer ad tiḍɛif (s sebba n tenmegliwin yeqqnen gar-asent, ur numid ara, i izemren ad ilint deg unagraw n yifuyla n ubleɣ aniri). Ihi, yelha ad d-tesnulfuḍ ableɣ amaynut n VeraCrypt (s usensi n Amsal arurad), ad tesmuttiḍ ifuyla seg ubleɣ-a ɣer ubleɣ amaynut; ableɣ-a ilaq ad yettwasefḍ s tɣellist (ama aḥric aniri, ama win uffir). Ad k-nwelleh s waṭas ad talseḍ asekkar n unagraw n wammud tura.
Temleḍ-d belli tebɣiḍ ad tḥerzeḍ ifuyla yugaren 4 GiB deg ubleɣ. Aya yessutur amsal n ubleɣ s NTFS/exFAT/ReFS, ayen ur nezmir ara ad yili.

Ẓer belli mi ara iteddu unagraw n wammud uffir, iblaɣen n VeraCrypt ur neffir ara ur zmiren ara ad ttwamsalen s NTFS/exFAT/ReFS. Sebba-s d akken ableɣ ilaq ad yettwaserkeb i kra n wakud war amesten mgal tira akken anagraw n wammud ad t-imesel s NTFS (ma d amsal s FAT, d VeraCrypt i t-ixedmen, mačči d anagraw n wammud, war aserkeb n ubleɣ). I wugar n yisalan itiknikanen, wali ddaw-a. Tzemreḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ ableɣ NTFS/exFAT/ReFS ur neffir ara seg unagraw n wammud n useɣleḍ.

Ɣef sebba n tɣellist, mi ara iteddu unagraw n wammud uffir, iblaɣen uffiren zemren ad d-nulfun kan deg weskar « usrid » (acku iblaɣen iniriyen ilaq ad ttwaserkben yal tikkelt i tɣuri kan). Akken ad d-tesnulfuḍ ableɣ uffir s tɣellist, ḍfer isurifen-a:

1) Sekker anagraw n useɣleḍ.

2) Snulfu-d ableɣ n VeraCrypt amagnu, syen nɣel ɣer-s kra n yifuyla i d-ibannen sɛan isefka uffiren, maca s tidet ur tebɣiḍ ARA ad ten-teffreḍ (ableɣ ad yuɣal d ableɣ aniri).

3) Sekker anagraw uffir, syen sekker amallal n usnulfu n ubleɣ n VeraCrypt. Ma ableɣ yella deg ufaylu, smutti-t ɣer uḥric n unagraw neɣ ɣer ubleɣ-nniḍen uffir (ma ulac, ableɣ uffir amaynut ad yettwaserkeb i tɣuri kan, ur yezmir ara ad yettwamsal). Ḍfer tinaḍin n umallal akken ad tferneḍ askar « usrid » n usnulfu n ubleɣ uffir.

4) Deg umallal, fren ableɣ i d-tesnulfaḍ deg usurif 2, syen ḍfer tinaḍin akken ad d-tesnulfuḍ ableɣ uffir deg-s.

Ɣef sebba n tɣellist, mi ara iteddu unagraw n wammud uffir, inagrawen n yifuyla idiganen ur nwgelhen ara akked yiblaɣen n VeraCrypt ur neffir ara ttwaserkben i tɣuri kan (ulac isefka i izemren ad ttwarun deg yinagrawen-a n yifuyla neɣ deg yiblaɣen-a n VeraCrypt).\n\nTira n yisefka tettwasireg deg yal anagraw n yifuyla i yellan deg ubleɣ uffir n VeraCrypt (ma yella ubleɣ uffir ur yelli ara deg ufaylu i uḥraz n yisefka yettwaḥerzen deg unagraw n yifuyla ur nwgelhen ara, neɣ deg unagraw-nniḍen n yifuyla n tɣuri kan).

Llant kraḍ n tmentilin tigejdanin i useqdec n yisegman-a n umesten:

- Aya yessirig asnulfu n twennaṭ taɣelsant i userkeb n yiblaɣen uffiren n VeraCrypt. Ẓer belli nwelleh s wudem unṣib ad ttwaserkben yiblaɣen uffiren kan mi ara iteddu unagraw n wammud uffir. (I wugar n telɣut, wali aḥric anaddaw 'Security Requirements and Precautions Pertaining to Hidden Volumes' deg tumlin.)

- Deg kra n tegnatin, yezmer ad yettwassen belli deg yiwen wakud, anagraw n yifuyla ur yettwaserkeb ara deg yiwet n tikkelt n uselkem n unagraw n wammud (neɣ belli yiwen ufaylu deg unagraw n yifuyla ur yettwaḥrez ara neɣ ur yettusekcem ara seg tikkelt-nni n uselkem n unagraw n wammud) (amedya, s tesleḍt akked usnemhel n yiɣmisen n unagraw n yifuyla, izemzakuden n yifuyla, iɣmisen n yisnasen, iɣmisen n tuccḍiwin, atg.). Aya yezmer ad d-yesken belli anagraw n wammud uffir yettwasbedd deg uselkim. Isegman-a n umesten geddlen uguren-a.

- Aya yegdel lexṣara n yisefka, yessirig taguni taɣezfant s tɣellist. Mi ara d-yuɣal Windows seg tguni taɣezfant, iḥesseb belli meṛṛa inagrawen n yifuyla yettwaserkben llan deg waddad ideg llan mi yekcem unagraw ɣer tguni taɣezfant. VeraCrypt yeḍemmen aya s umesten mgal tira n yal anagraw n yifuyla i izemren ad yettusekcem ama seg unagraw n useɣleḍ, ama seg unagraw uffir. War amesten-a, anagraw n yifuyla yezmer ad yexser mi ara t-yserkeb yiwen unagraw, ma wayeḍ yella deg tguni taɣezfant.

Tamawt: Ma teḥwaǧeḍ ad tesiwḍeḍ ifuyla s tɣellist seg unagraw n useɣleḍ ɣer unagraw uffir, ḍfer isurifen-a:
1) Sekker anagraw n useɣleḍ.
2) Ḥrez ifuyla deg ubleɣ ur nwgelhen ara neɣ deg ubleɣ aniri/amagnu n VeraCrypt.
3) Sekker anagraw uffir.
4) Ma tḥerzeḍ ifuyla deg ubleɣ n VeraCrypt, serkeb-it (ad yettwaserkeb s wudem awurman i tɣuri kan).
5) Nɣel ifuyla ɣer uḥric n unagraw uffir neɣ ɣer ubleɣ-nniḍen uffir.

ƔUR-K: MEṚṚA IFUYLA I YELLAN TURA DEG %s '%s'%s YETTWAFERNEN AD TTWASEFḌEN, AD ṚUḤEN (UR TTWAWGELHANEN ARA)!\n\nTebɣiḍ s tidet ad tkemmleḍ amsal?
ƔUR-K: Ur tezmireḍ ara ad tserkbeḍ ableɣ neɣ ad tkecmeḍ ɣer yifuyla i yellan deg-s alamma yettwawgelhen meṛṛa.\n\nTebɣiḍ s tidet ad tebduḍ awgelhen n %s '%s'%s yettwafernen?
ƔUR-K: Ur tezmireḍ ara ad tserkbeḍ ableɣ neɣ ad tkecmeḍ ɣer yifuyla i yellan deg-s alamma yettwazmek meṛṛa.\n\nTebɣiḍ s tidet ad tebduḍ azmak n %s '%s'%s yettwafernen?

ƔUR-K: Ẓer belli ma teqqes trisit s wudem ur netturaǧu ara mi ara iteddu uwgelhen/uzmak n yisefka yellan yakan deg umḍiq-nsen, neɣ ma yeɣli unagraw n wammud s sebba n tuccḍa deg useɣẓan neɣ n lexṣara deg warrum mi ara VeraCrypt yettwgelhin/yettzemik isefka yellan yakan deg umḍiq-nsen, kra n yiḥricen n yisefka ad xesren neɣ ad ṛuḥen. Ihi, uqbel ad tebduḍ awgelhen/azmak, ḍmen belli tesɛiḍ ineɣlan n uḥraz n yifuyla i tebɣiḍ ad twgelhneḍ/ad tzemkeḍ.\n\nTesɛiḍ anɣel n uḥraz am wa?
ƔUR-K: MEṚṚA IFUYLA I YELLAN TURA DEG UḤRIC '%s'%s (D ANAMEK, DEG UḤRIC AMEZWARU I YELLAN DEFFIR UḤRIC N UNAGRAW) AD TTWASEFḌEN, AD ṚUḤEN (UR TTWAWGELHANEN ARA)!\n\nTebɣiḍ s tidet ad tkemmleḍ amsal?

Awal uffir, PIM akked/neɣ ifuyla n tsura beddlen akken iwata.\n\nD AYEN ILAQEN: Ḍmen belli teɣriḍ aḥric 'Changing Passwords and Keyfiles' deg yixef 'Security Requirements and Precautions' deg umnir n useqdac n VeraCrypt.

D AYEN ILAQEN: Ma ur tesneɣṣeḍ ara aḍebsi-ik n usellek n VeraCrypt, aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw-ik mazal yezmer ad yettwazmek s wawal uffir aqbur (s usekker seg uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt d usekcem n wawal uffir aqbur). Ilaq ad d-tesnulfuḍ aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt amaynut, syin ad tesneɣṣeḍ win aqbur.\n\nTebɣiḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt amaynut?

Ẓer belli aḍebsi-ik n usellek n VeraCrypt mazal yesseqdac alguritm aqbur. Ma twalaḍ alguritm aqbur ur yeḍmin ara taɣellist, ilaq ad d-tesnulfuḍ aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt amaynut, syin ad tesneɣṣeḍ win aqbur.\n\nTebɣiḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt amaynut?

Ẓer belli VeraCrypt ur ibeddel ara akk agbur n ufaylu n tsarut. Tzemreḍ ad tferneḍ ugar n yiwen ufaylu n tsarut (amizzwer ur yesɛi ara azal). Ma terniḍ akaram, akk ifuyla ur neffir ara i yellan deg-s ad ttwasqedcen d ifuyla n tsura. Sit ɣef 'Rnu ifuyla n tiddest' akken ad tferneḍ ifuyla n tsura yettwaḥerzen deg tiddas n tɣellist neɣ deg tkarḍiwin s uceṛṛun (neɣ akken ad tketreḍ ifuyla n tsura ɣer tiddas n tɣellist neɣ tkarḍiwin s uceṛṛun).
Ifuyla n tsura ttwarnan/ttwakksen akken iwata.
Afaylu n tsarut yettwasifeḍ.
Alguritm n usuddim n tsarut n tsenṭit yettwasbadu akken iwata.

Sekcem awal uffir akked/neɣ ifuyla n tsura n ubleɣ ur nelli ara d win n unagraw, ideg tebɣiḍ ad tkemmleḍ akala n uwgelhen/uzmak deg umḍiq.\n\nTamawt: Mi ara tsateḍ ɣef Uḍfir, VeraCrypt ad yeɛreḍ ad d-yaf akk iblaɣen ur nelli ara d wid n unagraw, ideg yettwaḥbes ukala n uwgelhen/uzmak, u ideg tasenṭit n ubleɣ n VeraCrypt tezmer ad tettwazmek s wawal uffir akked/neɣ ifuyla n tsura i d-tefkiḍ. Ma yettwaf ugar n yiwen ubleɣ akka, ilaq ad tferneḍ yiwen seg-sen deg umecwar uḍfir.

Fren yiwen seg yiblaɣen yettwabedren. Tabdart tegber yal ableɣ iwumi yezmer ad yili unekcum, ur nelli ara d win n unagraw, ideg yettwaḥbes ukala n uwgelhen/uzmak, u ideg tasenṭit n ubleɣ tettwazmek akken iwata s wawal uffir akked/neɣ ifuyla n tsura i d-tefkiḍ.
Sekcem awal uffir akked/neɣ ifuyla n tsura n ubleɣ n VeraCrypt ur nelli ara d win n unagraw i tebɣiḍ ad t-tezmekḍ.

D ayen yesɛan aṭas n wazal ad tferneḍ awal uffir iǧehden. Ilaq ad tɛeddiḍ i wawal uffir i yegbren yiwen n wawal kan i yezmer ad yettwaf deg umawal (neɣ asdukkel n 2, 3, neɣ 4 n wawalen akka). Ur ilaq ara ad yegber ismawen neɣ izemz n tlalit. Ur ilaq ara ad yishil i tifin. Awal uffir iǧehden d asdukkel agacuran n yisekkilen imeqqranen d yimeẓyanen, izwilen d yisekkilen imeẓliyen, am @ ^ = $ * + atg. Ad k-nweṣṣi ad tferneḍ awal uffir i yegbren 20 n yisekkilen neɣ ugar (simmal iɣezzif, simmal yelha). Teɣzi tafellayt i izemren ad tili d 128 n yisekkilen.
Fren awal uffir i ubleɣ uffir.
Fren awal uffir i unagraw n wammud uffir (i ubleɣ uffir).

D AYEN ILAQEN: Awal uffir i tferneḍ i unagraw n wammud uffir deg umecwar-a ilaq ad yemgired aṭas ɣef sin n wawalen uffiren nniḍen (ɣef wawal uffir n ubleɣ aniri d wawal uffir n unagraw n wammud n useɣleḍ).

Sekcem awal uffir n ubleɣ ideg tebɣiḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ ableɣ uffir.\n\nMi ara tsateḍ ɣef Uḍfir, VeraCrypt ad yeɛreḍ ad yesserkeb ableɣ. Akken kan ara yettwaserkeb ubleɣ, bitmap n yiguza-s ad yettwasenqed akken ad tettwaf teɣzi n temnaḍt taslellit ur nebḍi ara (ma tella) i yesɛan taggara yemṣadan akked taggara n ubleɣ. PIM (Personal Iterations Multiplier, aseggat udmawan n wallusen) d azal i yesenqaden amḍan n wallusen i yesseqdac usuddim n tsarut n tsenṭit akka:
 Allusen = 15000 + (PIM x 1000).

Ma yeqqim d ilem neɣ yettwasbadu ɣer 0, VeraCrypt ad iseqdec azal amezwer (485) i yeḍemnen taɣellist talɛayant.

Ma awal uffir yesɛa ddaw n 20 n yisekkilen, PIM ur yezmir ara ad yili ddaw n 485 akken ad yeqqim uswir adday n tɣellist.
Ma awal uffir yesɛa 20 n yisekkilen neɣ ugar, PIM yezmer ad yettwasbadu ɣer yal azal.

\n\nƔUR-K: Ttwafen ifuyla uffiren deg ubrid n unadi n yifuyla n tsura. Ifuyla uffiren am wigi ur zmiren ara ad ttwasqedcen d ifuyla n tsura. Ma tesriḍ ad ten-tesqedceḍ d ifuyla n tsura, kkes-asen imyerr 'Hidden' (sit s teqeffalt tayefust ɣef yal yiwen seg-sen, fren 'Properties', kkes ticreḍt n 'Hidden', syin sit ɣef OK). Tamawt: Ifuyla uffiren ttbanen-d kan ma termed textiṛit i ten-yerzan (Computer > Organize > 'Folder and search options' > View).

Ma tɛerḍeḍ ad tmestneḍ ableɣ uffir i yegbren anagraw uffir, ḍmen belli tseqdaceḍ taneɣruft tamagnut US n unasiw mi ara taruḍ awal uffir n ubleɣ uffir. Aya d ayen ilaqen acku awal uffir ilaq ad yettwaru deg twennaḍt uqbel asekkar (uqbel ad yekker Windows), anda tineɣrufin n unasiw n Windows ur nelli ara d US ur ttawjudent ara.

VeraCrypt ur d-yufi ula d yiwen ubleɣ ideg yettwaḥbes ukala n uwgelhen/uzmak n ubleɣ ur nelli ara d win n unagraw, u ideg tasenṭit n ubleɣ tezmer ad tettwazmek s wawal uffir akked/neɣ ifuyla n tsura i d-tefkiḍ.\n\nḌmen belli awal uffir akked/neɣ ifuyla n tsura ṣḥiḥen, u aḥric/ableɣ ur t-yesseqdac ara unagraw neɣ isnasen (ula d iseɣẓanen mgal ivirusen).
Aḥric/ibenk yettwafernen yettwawgelhen yakan s lekmal-is.\nTikbabin n tsenṭit = 0x%.8X
Aḥric/ibenk yettwafernen ur isseqdac ara awgelhen deg umḍiq.\nTikbabin n tsenṭit = 0x%.8X

\n\nTamawt: Ma tɛerḍeḍ ad tserkbeḍ aḥric i yellan deg uḍebsi awgelhan n unagraw war asesteb uqbel asekkar, neɣ ad tserkbeḍ aḥric awgelhan n unagraw n wammud ur nettazzal ara, tzemreḍ ad tgeḍ aya s ufran n 'Anagraw' > 'Serkeb war asesteb uqbel asekkar'.

Deg uskar-a, ur tezmireḍ ara ad tserkbeḍ aḥric i yellan deg uḍebsi i yesɛan kra n uḥric-is deg taɣult n tsarut n uwgelhen urmid n unagraw.\n\nUqbel ad tizmireḍ ad tserkbeḍ aḥric-a deg uskar-a, ilaq ad tsekkreḍ anagraw n wammud yettwasbedden deg uḍebsi nniḍen (awgelhan neɣ ur nettwawgelhen ara), neɣ ad tsekkreḍ anagraw n wammud ur nettwawgelhen ara.
VeraCrypt ur yezmir ara ad yezmek aḥric iman-is deg uḍebsi n unagraw yettwawgelhen s lekmal-is (tzemreḍ ad tezmekḍ kan aḍebsi n unagraw s lekmal-is).

Ɣur-k: Acku aḍebsi yegber amsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt, yezmer ad yili d aḍebsi n unagraw yettwawgelhen s lekmal-is. Ma yella akka, ẓer belli VeraCrypt ur yezmir ara ad yezmek aḥric iman-is deg uḍebsi n unagraw yettwawgelhen s lekmal-is (tzemreḍ ad tezmekḍ kan aḍebsi n unagraw s lekmal-is). Ma yella akka, tzemreḍ ad tkemmleḍ tura, maca ad d-tawiḍ izen n tuccḍa 'Awal uffir ur iṣeḥḥa ara' ticki.

Sbadu teɣzi n ufaylu n uḥraz n yisefka i tebɣiḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ.

Ma tesnulfaḍ-d afaylu n uḥraz asmussaw (afaylu s tallunin tilemmin), aɣewwar-a ad isbadu teɣzi-s tafellayt i izemren ad tili.

Ẓer belli teɣzi taddayt i izemren ad tili n ubleɣ FAT d 292 KiB. Teɣzi taddayt i izemren ad tili n ubleɣ exFAT d 424 KiB. Teɣzi taddayt i izemren ad tili n ubleɣ NTFS d 3792 KiB. Teɣzi taddayt i izemren ad tili n ubleɣ ReFS d 642 MiB.
Sbadu teɣzi n ubleɣ aniri ara d-tesnulfuḍ (ad d-tesnulfuḍ di tazwara ableɣ aniri, syin ableɣ uffir deg-s). Teɣzi taddayt i izemren ad tili n ubleɣ ideg tebɣiḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ ableɣ uffir d 340 KiB.

Sbadu teɣzi n ubleɣ uffir ara d-tesnulfuḍ. Teɣzi taddayt i izemren ad tili n ubleɣ uffir d 40 KiB (neɣ 3664 KiB ma yettwamsel s NTFS). Teɣzi tafellayt i tzemreḍ ad tesbaduḍ i ubleɣ uffir tettwabeǧǧeḍ nnig.

Afaylu n uḥraz asmussaw d afaylu NTFS s tallunin tilemmin i yettwaḥeṛṛan seg tazwara, i teɣzi-s taɣarant (tallunt n uḍebsi i yesseqdac s tidet) tettimɣur mi ara rnun yisefka imaynuten ɣur-s.

ƔUR-K: Timellit n yiblaɣen i yettwaḥerzen deg yifuyla s tallunin tilemmin tenqes aṭas ɣef tin n yiblaɣen imagnuten. Iblaɣen i yettwaḥerzen deg yifuyla s tallunin tilemmin sɛan daɣen taɣellist yenneqsen, acku yezmer ad yettwafen anwa d igezmen n ubleɣ ur nettwasqedcen ara. Ẓer daɣen belli ma ttwarun yisefka deg ufaylu n uḥraz s tallunin tilemmin mi ulac tallunt tilellit s wazal ilaqen deg unagraw n yifuyla i t-yeḥerzen, anagraw n yifuyla awgelhan yezmer ad yexser.

Windows ur yessaweḍ ara ad yamsel ableɣ s NTFS/exFAT/ReFS.\n\nFren anaw nniḍen n unagraw n yifuyla (ma yella wamek), syin ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen. Tzemreḍ daɣen ad teǧǧeḍ ableɣ war amsal (fren 'Ulac' d anagraw n yifuyla), ad teffɣeḍ seg umallal-a, ad tserkbeḍ ableɣ, syin ad tesqedceḍ allal n unagraw neɣ allal n win nniḍen akken ad tamsleḍ ableɣ yettwaserkben (ableɣ ad yeqqim d awgelhan).
Windows ur yessaweḍ ara ad yamsel ableɣ s NTFS/exFAT/ReFS.\n\nTebɣiḍ ad tamsleḍ ableɣ s FAT deg umḍiq-is?

Teɣzi n ugazi yettwafernen meẓẓiyet aṭas i teɣzi-a n ubleɣ. Ad tettwasqedec teɣzi n ugazi meqqren ugar deg umḍiq-is.
Tuccḍa: Ur yezmir ara ad d-yawi teɣzi n ubleɣ!\n\nḌmen belli ableɣ yettwafernen ur t-yesseqdac ara unagraw neɣ asnas.

Iblaɣen uffiren ur ilaq ara ad d-ttwasnulfun daxel n yifuyla n uḥraz ismussawen (ifuyla s tallunin tilemmin). Akken ad tili tazmert n tnekra n tilin n yisefka s wudem ara yettwamnen, ableɣ uffir ilaq ad d-yettwasnulfu daxel n ufaylu n uḥraz ur nelli ara d asmussaw.
Amallal n usnulfu n yiblaɣen n VeraCrypt yezmer ad d-yesnulfu ableɣ uffir kan daxel n ubleɣ FAT/exFAT neɣ NTFS.
Deg Windows 2000, amallal n usnulfu n yiblaɣen n VeraCrypt yezmer ad d-yesnulfu ableɣ uffir kan daxel n ubleɣ FAT.

Tamawt: Anagraw n yifuyla FAT/exFAT iwulem ugar i yiblaɣen iniriyen wala anagraw n yifuyla NTFS (amedya, ahat teɣzi tafellayt i izemren ad tili n ubleɣ uffir tili meqqret aṭas ugar ma yella ableɣ aniri yettwamsel s FAT/exFAT).

Ẓer belli anagraw n yifuyla FAT/exFAT iwulem ugar i yiblaɣen iniriyen wala anagraw n yifuyla NTFS. Amedya, ahat teɣzi tafellayt i izemren ad tili n ubleɣ uffir ad timɣur aṭas ma yettwamsel ubleɣ aniri s FAT/exFAT (acku anagraw n yifuyla NTFS iḥerrez yal tikkelt isefka igensanen di tlemmast n ubleɣ s tidet, ihi ableɣ uffir yezmer ad yili kan deg uzgen wis sin n ubleɣ aniri).\n\nTetḥeqqeḍ tebɣiḍ ad tamsleḍ ableɣ aniri s NTFS?
Tebɣiḍ ad tamsleḍ ableɣ s FAT deg umḍiq-is?

Tamawt: Ableɣ-a ur yezmir ara ad yettwamsel s FAT, acku yugar teɣzi tafellayt n ubleɣ i yessefrak unagraw n yifuyla FAT32 i teɣzi n yigezmen yettwasqedcen (2 TiB i yigezmen n 512 n yiṭamḍanen d 16 TiB i yigezmen n 4096 n yiṭamḍanen).
Tuccḍa: Aḥric n unagraw n wammud uffir (aḥric amezwaru deffir uḥric n unagraw) ilaq ad yugar aḥric n unagraw s 5% ma drus (aḥric n unagraw d win ideg yettwasbedd unagraw n wammud i yettazzalen tura).

Tuccḍa: Aḥric n unagraw n wammud uffir (aḥric amezwaru deffir uḥric n unagraw) ilaq ad yugar aḥric n unagraw s 110% ma drus (teɣzi-s ad tili 2.1 n tikkal n tin n uḥric n unagraw). Aḥric n unagraw d win ideg yettwasbedd unagraw n wammud i yettazzalen tura. Sebba-s d anagraw n yifuyla NTFS i iḥerrezen yal tikkelt isefka igensanen di tlemmast n ubleɣ s tidet, ihi ableɣ uffir (i ilaq ad yegber anɣel yemṣadan akk d uḥric n unagraw) yezmer ad yili kan deg uzgen wis sin n uḥric.

Tuccḍa: Ma yettwamsel ubleɣ aniri s NTFS, ilaq ad yugar aḥric n unagraw s 110% ma drus (teɣzi-s ad tili 2.1 n tikkal n tin n uḥric n unagraw). Sebba-s d anagraw n yifuyla NTFS i iḥerrezen yal tikkelt isefka igensanen di tlemmast n ubleɣ s tidet, ihi ableɣ uffir (i ilaq ad yegber anɣel yemṣadan akk d uḥric n unagraw) yezmer ad yili kan deg uzgen wis sin n ubleɣ aniri.\n\nTamawt: Ableɣ aniri ilaq ad yili deg yiwen n uḥric akked unagraw n wammud uffir (deg uḥric amezwaru deffir uḥric n unagraw).

Tuccḍa: Ulac aḥric deffir uḥric n unagraw.\n\nẒer belli uqbel ad tizmireḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ anagraw n wammud uffir, ilaq ad as-d-tesnulfuḍ aḥric deg uḍebsi n unagraw. Ilaq ad yili d aḥric amezwaru deffir uḥric n unagraw, u ilaq ad t-yugar s 5% ma drus (aḥric n unagraw d win ideg yettwasbedd unagraw n wammud i yettazzalen tura). Maca, ma yettwamsel ubleɣ aniri s NTFS (ur t-sexlaḍ ara d uḥric n unagraw), aḥric n unagraw n wammud uffir ilaq ad yugar aḥric n unagraw s 110% ma drus (teɣzi-s ad tili 2.1 n tikkal n tin n uḥric n unagraw), acku anagraw n yifuyla NTFS iḥerrez yal tikkelt isefka igensanen di tlemmast n ubleɣ s tidet, ihi ableɣ uffir, i ilaq ad yegber anɣel yemṣadan akk d uḥric n unagraw, yezmer ad yili kan deg uzgen wis sin n uḥric.

Tamawt: Asbeddi n yinagrawen n wammud deg sin n yiblaɣen n VeraCrypt i yellan daxel n yiwen n uḥric ur iwulem ara i useqdec (ihi ur yettwasefrak ara), acku aseqdec n unagraw n wammud aniri ad yesri aṭas n tikkal tira n yisefka deg temnaḍt n unagraw n wammud uffir (u ma tettwaḥbes tira-a s tmahilt n umesten n ubleɣ uffir, aya ad d-yeglu s uɣelluy n unagraw, d tuccḍiwin 'Blue Screen').
I telɣut ɣef usnulfu d usefrek n yiḥricen, wali tumlin i d-yettunefken akked unagraw-ik n wammud, neɣ nermes agraw n tallalt tatiknikant n win ik-izzenzen aselkim-ik akken ad k-iɛiwen.
Tuccḍa: Anagraw n wammud i yettazzalen tura ur yettwasbedd ara deg uḥric n usekkar (aḥric urmid amezwaru). Aya ur yettwasefrak ara.

Teskneḍ-d belli tebɣiḍ ad tḥerzeḍ ifuyla i yugaren 4 GiB deg ubleɣ-a n VeraCrypt. Maca, tferneḍ anagraw n yifuyla FAT, ideg ur zmiren ara ad ttwaḥerzen yifuyla i yugaren 4 GiB.\n\nTetḥeqqeḍ tebɣiḍ ad tamsleḍ ableɣ s FAT?

Tuccḍa: VeraCrypt ur isefrak ara azmak deg umḍiq n yiblaɣen iqburen ur nelli ara d wid n unagraw, i d-yettwasnulfan s VeraCrypt 1.0b neɣ lqem aqbur ugar.\n\nTamawt: Mazal tzemreḍ ad tezmekḍ ifuyla i yettwaḥerzen deg ubleɣ s unɣal/usmutti-nsen ɣer yal ableɣ ur nettwawgelhen ara.

Tuccḍa: VeraCrypt ur yezmir ara ad yezmek deg umḍiq ableɣ uffir n VeraCrypt.\n\nTamawt: Mazal tzemreḍ ad tezmekḍ ifuyla i yettwaḥerzen deg ubleɣ s unɣal/usmutti-nsen ɣer yal ableɣ ur nettwawgelhen ara.

Ɣur-k: Ẓer belli VeraCrypt ur yezmir ara ad yezmek deg umḍiq ableɣ i yegbren ableɣ uffir n VeraCrypt (ableɣ uffir ad yettwasemselsi s yisefka i yettemcabin ɣer yisefka igacuranen).

Sentem belli ableɣ i tebɣiḍ ad tezmekḍ ur yegbir ula d yiwen ubleɣ uffir.

Tamawt: Ma ableɣ yegber ableɣ uffir, maca ur teḥricḍ ara ɣef ruḥan n ubleɣ uffir, tzemreḍ ad tferneḍ Kemmel (ableɣ aniri ad yettwazmek s tɣellist).
Ableɣ ur yegbir ula d yiwen ubleɣ uffir. Kemmel.
Ableɣ yegber ableɣ uffir. Semmet.

Tuccḍa: Ur yezmir ara ad yekcem ɣer ubleɣ!\n\nḌmen belli ableɣ yettwafernen yella, ur yettwaserkeb ara u ur t-yesseqdac ara unagraw neɣ asnas, tesɛiḍ tasiregt n tɣuri/tira i ubleɣ, u ur yettwamesten ara mgal tira.
Tuccḍa: Ur yezmir ara ad d-yawi tiɣerwan n ubleɣ.

Tuccḍa: Ur yezmir ara ad yekcem ɣer ubleɣ akked/neɣ ad d-yawi talɣut ɣef ubleɣ.\n\nḌmen belli ableɣ yettwafernen yella, ur t-yesseqdac ara unagraw neɣ isnasen, tesɛiḍ tasiregt n tɣuri/tira i ubleɣ, u ur yettwamesten ara mgal tira.

Tuccḍa: Ur yezmir ara ad yekcem ɣer ubleɣ akked/neɣ ad d-yawi talɣut ɣef ubleɣ. Ḍmen belli ableɣ yettwafernen yella, ur t-yesseqdac ara unagraw neɣ isnasen, tesɛiḍ tasiregt n tɣuri/tira i ubleɣ, u ur yettwamesten ara mgal tira.\n\nMa ugur mazal-it, aḍfar n yisurifen-a ddaw yezmer ad k-iɛiwen.

Tuccḍa teḥbes VeraCrypt ur yessaweḍ ara ad yewgelhen aḥric. Ɛreḍ ad teṣeggemeḍ uguren akk i d-yettwammalen yakan, syin ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen. Ma uguren mazal-iten, aḍfar n yisurifen-a ddaw yezmer ad k-iɛiwen.

Tuccḍa teḥbes VeraCrypt ur yessaweḍ ara ad ikemmel akala n uwgelhen/uzmak n uḥric/ubleɣ.\n\nƐreḍ ad teṣeggemeḍ uguren akk i d-yettwammalen yakan, syin ɛreḍ ad tkemmleḍ akala tikkelt-nniḍen ma yella wamek. Ẓer belli ableɣ ur yezmir ara ad yettwaserkeb alamma yettwawgelhen s lekmal-is neɣ yettwazmek s lekmal-is.
Tuccḍa teḥbes VeraCrypt ur yessaweḍ ara ad yezmek ableɣ. Ɛreḍ ad teṣeggemeḍ uguren akk i d-yettwammalen yakan, syin ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen ma yella wamek.

Tuccḍa: Ur yezmir ara ad yekkes aserkeb n ubleɣ aniri!

Aserkeb n ubleɣ ur yezmir ara ad yettwakkes ma yegber ifuyla neɣ ikaramen i yesseqdac wahil neɣ unagraw.

Mdel yal ahil i izemren ad iseqdec ifuyla neɣ ikaramen deg ubleɣ, syin sit ɣef Ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen.
Tuccḍa: Ur yezmir ara ad d-yawi talɣut ɣef ubleɣ aniri!\nAsnulfu n ubleɣ ur yezmir ara ad ikemmel.
Tuccḍa: Ur yezmir ara ad yekcem ɣer ubleɣ aniri! Asnulfu n ubleɣ ur yezmir ara ad ikemmel.
Tuccḍa: Ur yezmir ara ad yesserkeb ableɣ aniri! Asnulfu n ubleɣ ur yezmir ara ad ikemmel.
Tuccḍa: Ur yezmir ara ad d-yawi bitmap n yiguza n ubleɣ! Asnulfu n ubleɣ ur yezmir ara ad ikemmel.

Fren yiwen seg yiskaren. Ma ur teẓriḍ ara anwa ara tferneḍ, seqdec askar amezwer.
Fren taxtiṛit-a ma tebɣiḍ ad tesbeddeḍ VeraCrypt deg unagraw-a.
Tamawt: Tzemreḍ ad tmucceḍeḍ war azmak, ula ma aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw yettwawgelhen neɣ tseqdaceḍ anagraw n wammud uffir.

Ma tferneḍ taxtiṛit-a, akk ifuyla ad d-ttwassfen seg ukemmus-a, maca ulac ara yettwasbedden deg unagraw. Ur tt-ferren ara ma tebɣiḍ ad twgelhneḍ aḥric n unagraw neɣ aḍebsi n unagraw. Afran n textiṛit-a yezmer ad yenfeɛ, amedya, ma tebɣiḍ ad tsekkreḍ VeraCrypt deg wayen i wumi neqqar askar aninig. VeraCrypt ur ilaq ara ad yettwasbedd deg unagraw n wammud ideg ara yettwasekker. Mi ara d-ttwassfen akk yifuyla, tzemreḍ ad tsekkreḍ srid afaylu i d-yettwassfen 'VeraCrypt.exe' (syin VeraCrypt ad yeddu deg uskar aninig).

Ma akaram i d-yettwasbadun ulac-it, ad d-yettwasnulfu s wudem awurman.
Ifuyla n wahil VeraCrypt ad ttwamucceḍen deg wadeg ideg yettwasbedd VeraCrypt. Ma tesriḍ ad tferneḍ adeg nniḍen, kkes VeraCrypt di tazwara.
Tebɣiḍ ad twaliḍ tizmilin n lqem amiran (lqem urkid aneggaru) n VeraCrypt?
Ma werǧin tesqedceḍ VeraCrypt yakan, ad k-nweṣṣi ad teɣreḍ ixef Beginner's Tutorial deg umnir n useqdac n VeraCrypt. Tebɣiḍ ad twaliḍ amnir-a?

Amsebdad n VeraCrypt iteddu tura deg unagraw-a, iteddu ad isbedd neɣ ad imucceḍ VeraCrypt, neɣ ihegga i waya. Uqbel ad tkemmleḍ, rǧu alamma ifuk neɣ mdel-it. Ma ur tezmireḍ ara ad t-tmedleḍ, ales asekkar n uselkim-ik uqbel ad tkemmleḍ.

Tukksa ur teddi ara.
Akemmus-a n usedger yexser. Ɛreḍ ad t-id-tsidreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen (yif-it seg usmel unṣib n VeraCrypt deg https://veracrypt.jp).

VeraCrypt yettwamucceḍ akken iwata. Maca, uqbel ad tebduḍ aseqdec-is, ilaq ad yales usekkar n uselkim.\n\nTebɣiḍ ad talseḍ asekkar-is tura?

Amucceḍ n VeraCrypt ur yeddi ara!\n\nD AYEN ILAQEN: Uqbel ad tessenseḍ neɣ ad talseḍ asekkar n unagraw, ad k-nweṣṣi s waṭas ad tesqedceḍ System Restore (Windows Start menu > All programs > Accessories > System Tools > System Restore) akken ad terreḍ anagraw-ik ɣer yired n tririt s yisem 'VeraCrypt installation'. Ma System Restore ur yewjid ara, ilaq ad tɛerḍeḍ ad tesbeddeḍ tikkelt-nniḍen lqem aneṣli neɣ lqem amaynut n VeraCrypt uqbel ad tessenseḍ neɣ ad talseḍ asekkar n unagraw.

VeraCrypt yettwakkes akken iwata.\n\nSit ɣef 'Fak' akken ad tekkseḍ amsebdad n VeraCrypt d ukaram %s. Ẓer belli akaram ur yettwakkas ara ma yegber ifuyla ur yesbedd ara umsebdad n VeraCrypt u ur d-yesnulfa ara VeraCrypt.

Anuḍaf n yibenk n VeraCrypt ur yezmir ara ad yettwakkes seg tkatut.\n\nMdel di tazwara akk isfuyla n VeraCrypt yeldin. Ma aya ur d-yefki ara tifrat, ales asekkar n Windows, syin ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen.
Ilaq ad yettwakkes userkeb n yiblaɣen n VeraCrypt meṛṛa uqbel asebded neɣ tukksa n VeraCrypt.

Lqem aqbur ur nelli ara d amiran n VeraCrypt yettwasbedd tura deg unagraw-a. Ilaq ad yettwakkes uqbel ad tizmireḍ ad tesbeddeḍ lqem-a amaynut n VeraCrypt.\n\nAkken kan ara tmedleḍ tankult-a n yizen, allal n tukksa n lqem aqbur ad yekker. Ẓer belli ulac ableɣ ara yettwazemken mi ara tekkseḍ VeraCrypt. Mi ara tekkseḍ lqem aqbur n VeraCrypt, sekker tikkelt-nniḍen amsebdad n lqem amaynut n VeraCrypt.
Asebded n yinekcam n useklas ur yeddi ara
Asebded n unuḍaf n yibenk ur yeddi ara. Ales asekkar n Windows, syin ɛreḍ ad tesbeddeḍ VeraCrypt tikkelt-nniḍen.
Asekkar n unuḍaf n yibenk n VeraCrypt

Tukksa n unuḍaf n yibenk ur teddi ara. Ẓer belli, ɣef sebba n wugur deg Windows, yezmer ad ilaq ad teffɣeḍ seg tɣimit neɣ ad talseḍ asekkar n unagraw uqbel ad yezmer unuḍaf n yibenk ad yettwakkes (neɣ ad yettwasbedd tikkelt-nniḍen).

Tukksa n ujerred n temkarḍit n usefrek n Usenqed n Yimiḍanen n Yiseqdacen ur teddi ara.

Tamawt ɣef uskar aninig:\n\nẒer belli anagraw n wammud yesra inuḍaf ad ttwajerden ɣur-s uqbel ad zmiren ad kkren. Ihi, anuḍaf n VeraCrypt mačči d aninig s lekmal-is (u ur yezmir ara ad yili akka), ma d isnasen n VeraCrypt d iniganen s lekmal-nsen, d anamek ur ilaq ara ad ttwasbedden neɣ ad ttwajerden deg unagraw n wammud. Ẓer daɣen belli VeraCrypt yesra anuḍaf akken ad d-yefk awgelhen/azmak srid deg useqdec, war ma yella wayen ara yeg useqdac yal tikkelt.

Ẓer belli ma tferneḍ ad tsekkreḍ VeraCrypt deg uskar aninig (deg umḍiq n usekker n unɣel n VeraCrypt yettwasbedden), anagraw ad k-d-isuter tasiregt n usekker n VeraCrypt (asuter UAC) yal tikkelt ara tɛerḍeḍ ad t-tsekkreḍ.

Sebba-s d akken mi ara tsekkreḍ VeraCrypt deg uskar aninig, VeraCrypt yesra ad yessali ɣer tkatut yerna ad yessekker anuḍaf n yibenk n VeraCrypt. VeraCrypt yesra anuḍaf n yibenk akken ad d-yefk awgelhen/azmak srid deg useqdec, war ma yella wayen ara yeg useqdac yal tikkelt, u iseqdacen war tiseglutin n unedbal ur zmiren ara ad sekkren inuḍaf n yibenkan deg Windows. Ihi, anagraw ad k-d-isuter tasiregt n usekker n VeraCrypt s tseglutin n unedbal (asuter UAC).

Ẓer belli ma tesbeddeḍ VeraCrypt deg unagraw (deg umḍiq n usekker n VeraCrypt deg uskar aninig), anagraw UR k-d-isutur ARA tasiregt n usekker n VeraCrypt (asuter UAC) yal tikkelt ara tɛerḍeḍ ad t-tsekkreḍ.

Tetḥeqqeḍ tebɣiḍ ad d-tessfeḍ ifuyla?

Ɣur-k: Tummant-a n umallal n usnulfu n yiblaɣen tesɛa tiseglutin n unedbal.

Iblaɣen inurifen n unagraw ttwaḥerzen.\n\nAkken ad tremdeḍ aserkeb n yiblaɣen inurifen n unagraw mi ara yekker unagraw, fren 'Iɣewwaren' > 'Iblaɣen inurifen n unagraw' > 'Serkeb iblaɣen inurifen n unagraw mi ara yekker Windows'.
Ableɣ i terniḍ ɣer yinurifen mačči d aḥric, mačči daɣen d ableɣ asmussaw. Ihi, VeraCrypt ur yezmir ara ad yesserkeb ableɣ-a anurif ma ibeddel umḍan n yibenk.

Ableɣ i terniḍ ɣer yinurifen d aḥric ur d-iɛqil ara Windows.\n\nVeraCrypt ur yezmir ara ad yesserkeb ableɣ-a anurif ma ibeddel umḍan n yibenk. Sbadu anaw n uḥric ɣer wanaw i d-yeɛqel Windows (seqdec anaḍ SETID n wallal 'diskpart' n Windows). Syin rnu aḥric ɣer yinurifen tikkelt-nniḍen.

Tawuri n ugilal n VeraCrypt tettwasens neɣ tettwaswel akken ad teffeɣ mi ulac iblaɣen yettwaserkben (neɣ VeraCrypt iteddu deg uskar aninig). Aya yezmer ad isḥbes aserkeb awurman n yiblaɣen-ik inurifen mi ara qqnen yibenkan i ten-yeḥerzen.\n\nTamawt: Akken ad tremdeḍ tawuri n ugilal n VeraCrypt, fren Iɣewwaren > Ismenyifen, syin creḍ taxxamt 'Yermed' deg uḥric 'Tawuri n ugilal n VeraCrypt'.
Afaylu n uḥraz i yellan deg unagraw n yifuyla anmeggag i yettwabḍan ɣef uẓeṭṭa ur yezmir ara ad yettwaserkeb s wudem awurman mi ara yeqqen yibenk i t-yeḥerzen.
Ibenk i d-yettwabeǧǧeḍen ddaw mačči d aḥric, mačči daɣen d ableɣ asmussaw. Ihi, ableɣ i yellan deg yibenk ur yezmir ara ad yettwaserkeb s wudem awurman mi ara yeqqen yibenk.

Sbadu anaw n uḥric i d-yettwabeǧǧeḍen ddaw ɣer wanaw i d-yeɛqel Windows (seqdec anaḍ SETID n wallal 'diskpart' n Windows). Syin kkes aḥric seg yinurifen, rnu-t tikkelt-nniḍen. Aya ad yeǧǧ ableɣ i yellan deg yibenk ad yettwaserkeb s wudem awurman mi ara yeqqen yibenk.
Ibenk i d-yettwabeǧǧeḍen ddaw mačči d aḥric, mačči daɣen d ableɣ asmussaw. Ihi, ur yezmir ara ad as-tettunefk tebzimt.

Sbadu anaw n uḥric i d-yettwabeǧǧeḍen ddaw ɣer wanaw i d-yeɛqel Windows (seqdec anaḍ SETID n wallal 'diskpart' n Windows). Syin kkes aḥric seg yinurifen, rnu-t tikkelt-nniḍen. Aya ad yeǧǧ VeraCrypt ad yefk tabzimt i uḥric.

Ɣef sebba n talast n Windows, afaylu n uḥraz i yellan deg unagraw n yifuyla anmeggag i yettwabḍan ɣef uẓeṭṭa ur yezmir ara ad yettwaserkeb d ableɣ anurif n unagraw (maca yezmer ad yettwaserkeb d ableɣ anurif ur nelli ara d win n unagraw mi ara yekcem useqdac ɣer tɣimit).

ƔUR-K: Tasenṭit n ubleɣ-a texser! VeraCrypt iseqdec s wudem awurman anɣel n uḥraz n tsenṭit n ubleɣ i yellan daxel n ubleɣ.\n\nIlaq ad tṣeggemeḍ tasenṭit n ubleɣ s ufran n 'Ifecka' > 'Err-d tasenṭit n ubleɣ'.

Anɣel n uḥraz n tsenṭit n ubleɣ yettwasnulfa-d akken iwata.

D AYEN ILAQEN: Tiririt n tsenṭit n ubleɣ s useqdec n unɣel-a n uḥraz ad d-terr daɣen awal uffir amiran n ubleɣ. Rnu ɣer waya, ma ifuyla n tsura ilaqen i userkeb n ubleɣ, d ifuyla-nni n tsura ara ilaqen i userkeb n ubleɣ tikkelt-nniḍen mi ara d-tettwarr tsenṭit n ubleɣ.

ƔUR-K: Anɣel-a n uḥraz n tsenṭit n ubleɣ yezmer ad yettwasqedec i tririt n tsenṭit n ubleɣ-a KAN. Ma tesqedceḍ anɣel-a n uḥraz n tsenṭit akken ad d-terreḍ tasenṭit n ubleɣ nniḍen, ad tizmireḍ ad tserkbeḍ ableɣ, maca UR tezmireḍ ARA ad tezmekḍ ula d asefku i yettwaḥerzen deg ubleɣ (acku ad tbeddleḍ tasarut-is tagejdayt).

Tasenṭit n ubleɣ tettwarr-d akken iwata.\n\nD AYEN ILAQEN: Ẓer belli yezmer ad yili wawal uffir aqbur yettwarr-d daɣen. Rnu ɣer waya, ma ifuyla n tsura llan ilaqen i userkeb n ubleɣ mi d-yettwasnulfa unɣel n uḥraz, d ifuyla-nni n tsura i ilaqen tura i userkeb n ubleɣ tikkelt-nniḍen.

Ɣef sebba n tɣellist, ilaq ad tesnekcmeḍ awal uffir iṣeḥḥan (akked/neɣ ad d-tefkeḍ ifuyla n tsura iṣeḥḥan) n ubleɣ.\n\nTamawt: Ma ableɣ yegber ableɣ uffir, ilaq ad tesnekcmeḍ di tazwara awal uffir iṣeḥḥan (akked/neɣ ad d-tefkeḍ ifuyla n tsura iṣeḥḥan) n ubleɣ aniri. Syin, ma tferneḍ ad tgeḍ anɣel n uḥraz n tsenṭit n ubleɣ uffir, ilaq ad tesnekcmeḍ awal uffir iṣeḥḥan (akked/neɣ ad d-tefkeḍ ifuyla n tsura iṣeḥḥan) n ubleɣ uffir.

Tetḥeqqeḍ tebɣiḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ anɣel n uḥraz n tsenṭit n ubleɣ i %s?

Mi ara tsateḍ ɣef Ih, ad k-d-yettwasuter yisem n ufaylu i unɣel n uḥraz n tsenṭit.

Tamawt: Tasenṭit n ubleɣ amagnu d tin n ubleɣ uffir ad ttwaɛawdent uwgelhen s tissent tamaynut, ad ttwaḥerzent deg ufaylu n uḥraz. Ma ulac ableɣ uffir daxel n ubleɣ-a, tamnaḍt yettwaḥeṛṛan i tsenṭit n ubleɣ uffir deg ufaylu n uḥraz ad tettwaččar s yisefka igacuranen (akken ad teqqim tezmert n tnekra n tilin n yisefka s wudem ara yettwamnen). Mi ara d-terreḍ tasenṭit n ubleɣ seg ufaylu n uḥraz, ilaq ad tesnekcmeḍ awal uffir iṣeḥḥan (akked/neɣ ad d-tefkeḍ ifuyla n tsura iṣeḥḥan) i yellan d imeɣta mi d-yettwasnulfa unɣel n uḥraz n tsenṭit n ubleɣ. Awal uffir (akked/neɣ ifuyla n tsura) ad isbadu daɣen s wudem awurman anaw n tsenṭit n ubleɣ ara d-terreḍ, d tamagnut neɣ d tuffirt (ẓer belli VeraCrypt isbadu anaw s uɛraḍ d tuccḍa).

Tetḥeqqeḍ tebɣiḍ ad d-terreḍ tasenṭit n ubleɣ n %s?

ƔUR-K: Tiririt n tsenṭit n ubleɣ ad d-terr daɣen awal uffir n ubleɣ i yellan d ameɣtu mi d-yettwasnulfa unɣel n uḥraz. Rnu ɣer waya, ma ifuyla n tsura llan ilaqen i userkeb n ubleɣ mi d-yettwasnulfa unɣel n uḥraz, d ifuyla-nni n tsura ara ilaqen i userkeb n ubleɣ tikkelt-nniḍen deffir tririt n tsenṭit n ubleɣ.

Mi ara tsateḍ ɣef Ih, ad tferneḍ afaylu n uḥraz n tsenṭit.

Ur yezmir ara ad isenqed belli aḍebsi n usellek yettwakles akken iwata.

Ma teskelseḍ aḍebsi n usellek, ssufeɣ CD/DVD, sekcem-it tikkelt-nniḍen, syin ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen. Ma aya ur d-yefki ara tifrat, ɛreḍ aseɣẓan nniḍen n ukalas ɣef CD/DVD akked/neɣ amidya nniḍen.

Ma tɛerḍeḍ ad tesneqdeḍ aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt i d-yettwasnulfan i tsarut tagejdayt, awal uffir, tissent, atg., yemgaraden, ẓer belli aḍebsi n usellek am wagi ur yezmir ara ad iɛeddi asenqed-a. Akken ad d-tesnulfuḍ aḍebsi n usellek amaynut yemṣadan s lekmal-is akked twila-k tamirant, fren 'Anagraw' > 'Snulfu-d aḍebsi n usellek'.
Tugna n uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt tettwasenqed akken iwata.

Asenqed n tugna n uḍebsi n usellek ur yeddi ara.\n\nMa tɛerḍeḍ ad tesneqdeḍ tugna n uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt i d-yettwasnulfan i tsarut tagejdayt, awal uffir, tissent, atg., yemgaraden, ẓer belli tugna n uḍebsi n usellek am ta ur tezmir ara ad tɛeddi asenqed-a. Akken ad d-tesnulfuḍ tugna tamaynut n uḍebsi n usellek temṣadan s lekmal-is akked twila-k tamirant, fren 'Anagraw' > 'Snulfu-d aḍebsi n usellek'.
Tuccḍa deg usnulfu n uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt.

Aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt ur yezmir ara ad d-yettwasnulfu mi ara iteddu unagraw n wammud uffir.\n\nAkken ad d-tesnulfuḍ aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt, sekker anagraw n wammud n useɣleḍ, syin fren 'Anagraw' > 'Snulfu-d aḍebsi n usellek'.

Ur yezmir ara ad isenqed belli aḍebsi n usellek yettwakles akken iwata.

Ma teskelseḍ aḍebsi n usellek, ssufeɣ CD/DVD, sekcem-it tikkelt-nniḍen, syin sit ɣef Uḍfir akken ad tɛerḍeḍ tikkelt-nniḍen. Ma aya ur d-yefki ara tifrat, ɛreḍ amidya nniḍen%s.

Ma ur teskilseḍ ara yakan aḍebsi n usellek, eg aya, syin sit ɣef Uḍfir.

Ma tɛerḍeḍ ad tesneqdeḍ aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt i d-yettwasnulfan uqbel ad tsekkreḍ amallal-a, ẓer belli aḍebsi n usellek am wagi ur yezmir ara ad yettwasqedec, acku yettwasnulfa-d i tsarut tagejdayt nniḍen. Ilaq ad teskelseḍ aḍebsi n usellek amaynut i d-yettwarwen.

ƔUR-K: Ad k-nweṣṣi s waṭas ad tɛeddiḍ i yisiɣzaf n yifuyla i yettwasqedcen i yifuyla imsellekmen (am .exe, .sys, neɣ .dll) d yisiɣzaf nniḍen i d-yettawin uguren am wigi. Aseqdec n yisiɣzaf-a yettaǧǧa Windows d yiseɣẓanen mgal ivirusen ad d-tteddun deg ufaylu n uḥraz, ayen i yettḍurrun timellit n ubleɣ, u yezmer daɣen ad d-yeglu s wuguren nniḍen meqqren.

Ad k-nweṣṣi s waṭas ad tekkseḍ asiɣzef n ufaylu neɣ ad t-tbeddleḍ (amedya, ɣer '.hc').

Tetḥeqqeḍ tebɣiḍ ad tesqedceḍ asiɣzef n ufaylu i d-yettawin uguren?

ƔUR-K: Afaylu-a n uḥraz yesɛa asiɣzef n ufaylu i yettwasqedcen i yifuyla imsellekmen (am .exe, .sys, neɣ .dll), neɣ asiɣzef nniḍen i d-yettawin uguren am wigi. Ahat aya ad yeǧǧ Windows d yiseɣẓanen mgal ivirusen ad d-tteddun deg ufaylu n uḥraz, ayen ara iḍurren timellit n ubleɣ, u yezmer daɣen ad d-yeglu s wuguren nniḍen meqqren.\n\nAd k-nweṣṣi s waṭas ad tekkseḍ asiɣzef n ufaylu n uḥraz neɣ ad t-tbeddleḍ (amedya, ɣer '.hc') deffir tukksa n userkeb n ubleɣ.

ƔUR-K: Yettban-d belli ur tesbeddeḍ ula d yiwen Service Pack deg usebded-ik n Windows. Ur ilaq ara ad taruḍ ɣef yiḍebsiyen IDE i yugaren 128 GiB deg Windows XP ideg ur tesbeddeḍ ara Service Pack 1 neɣ win i t-id-yeḍfaren! Ma tgeḍ aya, isefka deg uḍebsi zemren ad xesren (ama d ableɣ n VeraCrypt neɣ ala). Ẓer belli aya d talast n Windows, mačči d abug deg VeraCrypt.

ƔUR-K: Yettban-d belli ur tesbeddeḍ ara Service Pack 3 neɣ win i t-id-yeḍfaren deg usebded-ik n Windows. Ur ilaq ara ad taruḍ ɣef yiḍebsiyen IDE i yugaren 128 GiB deg Windows 2000 ideg ur tesbeddeḍ ara Service Pack 3 neɣ win i t-id-yeḍfaren! Ma tgeḍ aya, isefka deg uḍebsi zemren ad xesren (ama d ableɣ n VeraCrypt neɣ ala). Ẓer belli aya d talast n Windows, mačči d abug deg VeraCrypt.\n\nTamawt: Yezmer daɣen ad tesriḍ ad tremdeḍ asefrek n LBA n 48 n yibiten deg useklas ; i wugar n telɣut, wali http://support.microsoft.com/kb/305098/EN-US

ƔUR-K: Asefrek n LBA ATAPI n 48 n yibiten yensa deg unagraw-ik. Ihi, ur ilaq ara ad taruḍ ɣef yiḍebsiyen IDE i yugaren 128 GiB! Ma tgeḍ aya, isefka deg uḍebsi zemren ad xesren (ama d ableɣ n VeraCrypt neɣ ala). Ẓer belli aya d talast n Windows, mačči d talast n VeraCrypt.

Akken ad tremdeḍ asefrek n LBA n 48 n yibiten, rnu azal n useklas 'EnableBigLba' deg tsarut n useklas HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\atapi\Parameters, sbadu-t ɣer 1.

I wugar n telɣut, wali http://support.microsoft.com/kb/305098

Tuccḍa: Ifuyla i yugaren 4 GiB ur zmiren ara ad ttwaḥerzen deg unagraw n yifuyla FAT32. Ihi, iblaɣen n VeraCrypt i yettwaḥerzen deg yifuyla (ifuyla n uḥraz) deg unagraw n yifuyla FAT32 ur zmiren ara ad ugaren 4 GiB.\n\nMa tesriḍ ableɣ meqqren ugar, snulfu-t-id deg unagraw n yifuyla NTFS (neɣ, ma tseqdaceḍ Windows Vista SP1 neɣ lqem i t-id-yeḍfaren, deg unagraw n yifuyla exFAT), neɣ, deg umḍiq n usnulfu n ubleɣ i yettwaḥerzen deg ufaylu, wgelhen aḥric neɣ ibenk s lekmal-is.

Ɣur-k: Windows XP ur isefrak ara ifuyla i yugaren 2048 GiB (ad d-yesken izen "Not enough storage is available"). Ihi, ur tezmireḍ ara ad d-tesnulfuḍ ableɣ n VeraCrypt i yettwaḥerzen deg ufaylu (afaylu n uḥraz) i yugaren 2048 GiB deg Windows XP.\n\nẒer belli mazal tzemreḍ ad twgelhneḍ aḍebsi s lekmal-is neɣ ad d-tesnulfuḍ ableɣ n VeraCrypt deg uḥric i yugaren 2048 GiB deg Windows XP.
ƔUR-K: Ma tebɣiḍ ad tizmireḍ ad ternuḍ ugar n yisefka/yifuyla ɣer ubleɣ aniri ɣer zdat, ilaq ad txemmeḍ ad tferneḍ teɣzi meẓẓiyen i ubleɣ uffir.\n\nTetḥeqqeḍ tebɣiḍ ad tkemmleḍ s teɣzi i d-tesbaduḍ?
Ulac ableɣ yettwafernen.\n\nSit ɣef 'Fren ibenk' neɣ 'Fren afaylu' akken ad tferneḍ ableɣ n VeraCrypt.

Ulac aḥric yettwafernen.

Sit ɣef 'Fren ibenk' akken ad tferneḍ aḥric ur nettwaserkeb ara i yesran s umata asesteb uqbel asekkar (amedya, aḥric i yellan deg uḍebsi awgelhan n unagraw n wammud nniḍen ur nettazzal ara, neɣ aḥric awgelhan n unagraw n wammud nniḍen).

Tamawt: Aḥric yettwafernen ad yettwaserkeb d ableɣ amagnu n VeraCrypt war asesteb uqbel asekkar. Aya yenfeɛ, amedya, i temhalin n uḥraz neɣ n useggem.

ƔUR-K: Ma ifuyla n tsura imezwar ttwasbadun yerna ttwaremden, iblaɣen ur nesseqdac ara ifuyla-a n tsura ur zmiren ara ad ttwaserkben. Ihi, mi ara tremdeḍ ifuyla n tsura imezwar, cfu ad tekkseḍ ticreḍt n 'Seqdec ifuyla n tsura' (ddaw n wurti n usekcem n wawal uffir) yal tikkelt ara tserkbeḍ iblaɣen am wigi.\n\nTetḥeqqeḍ tebɣiḍ ad tḥerzeḍ ifuyla n tsura/iberdan yettwafernen d imezwar?

Tuccḍa: Anegzum-a yettwaḥeṛṛ. Fren anegzum nniḍen.
Tuccḍa: Anegzum yettwasqedec yakan.
ƔUR-K: Yiwen neɣ ugar n yinegzumen s unasiw n VeraCrypt i yetteddun deg unagraw meṛṛa ur tteddun ara!\n\nḌmen belli isnasen nniḍen d unagraw n wammud ur seqdacen ara inegzumen-nni n VeraCrypt.

Asnulfu n ufaylu n tissubtert yettwaseḥbes.\n\nẒer belli, ɣef sebba n wuguren n Windows, ifuyla n tissubtert ur zmiren ara ad ilin deg yiblaɣen n VeraCrypt ur nelli ara d wid n unagraw (ula d iblaɣen inurifen n unagraw). VeraCrypt isefrak asnulfu n yifuyla n tissubtert kan deg uḥric/uḍebsi awgelhan n unagraw.

Tuccḍa neɣ aramṣada teḥbes VeraCrypt ur yezmir ara ad yewgelhen afaylu n tguni taɣezfant. Ihi, taguni taɣezfant tettwaseḥbes.\n\nTamawt: Mi ara yeddu uselkim ɣer tguni taɣezfant (neɣ ad yekcem ɣer uskar n uḥraz n tezmert), agbur n tkatut n unagraw-is yettwaru deg ufaylu n uḥraz n tguni taɣezfant i yellan deg uḍebsi n unagraw. VeraCrypt ur yezmir ara ad isḥbes tisura n uwgelhen d yigburen n yifuyla imḥulfan yeldin deg RAM ad ttwaḥerzen war awgelhen deg ufaylu n uḥraz n tguni taɣezfant.

Taguni taɣezfant tettwaseḥbes.\n\nVeraCrypt ur isefrak ara taguni taɣezfant deg yinagrawen n wammud uffiren i yesseqdacen aḥric n usekkar nniḍen. Ẓer belli aḥric n usekkar yettwabḍa gar unagraw n useɣleḍ d unagraw uffir. Ihi, akken ad isḥbes asuffeɣ n yisefka d wuguren mi ara d-yuɣal uselkim seg tguni taɣezfant, VeraCrypt ilaq ad isḥbes anagraw uffir ur yettaru ara ɣer uḥric n usekkar yettwabḍan, u ur ikeččem ara ɣer tguni taɣezfant.
Ableɣ n VeraCrypt yettwaserkben d %c: yettwakkes-as userkeb.
Iblaɣen n VeraCrypt yettwakkes-asen userkeb.
Iblaɣen n VeraCrypt yettwakkes-asen userkeb, tazarkatut n wawalen uffiren tettwasfeḍ.
Aserkeb yettwakkes akken iwata

ƔUR-K: Ma tettwasens tawuri n ugilal n VeraCrypt, timahilin-a ad ttwassensent:

1) Inegzumen s unasiw
2) Tukksa tawurmant n userkeb (amedya, mi ara teffɣeḍ seg tɣimit, mi ara yettwakkes yibenk i yeḥerzen ableɣ s tuccḍa, mi ara tfukk tallit n uraǧu, atg.)
3) Aserkeb awurman n yiblaɣen inurifen
4) Ilɣa (amedya, mi ara yettwaseḥbes uḍurru n ubleɣ uffir)
5) Tignit deg temnaḍt n yilɣa

Tamawt: Tzemreḍ ad tesḥebseḍ tawuri n ugilal melmi tebɣiḍ s usiti s teqeffalt tayefust ɣef tignit n VeraCrypt deg temnaḍt n yilɣa, syin s ufran n 'Ffeɣ'.

Tetḥeqqeḍ tebɣiḍ ad tessenseḍ tawuri n ugilal n VeraCrypt i lebda?
ƔUR-K: Ma taxtiṛit-a tensa, iblaɣen i yegbren ifuyla/ikaramen yeldin ur yezmir ara ad yettwakkes userkeb-nsen s wudem awurman.\n\nTetḥeqqeḍ tebɣiḍ ad tessenseḍ taxtiṛit-a?

ƔUR-K: Iblaɣen i yegbren ifuyla/ikaramen yeldin UR yettwakkas ARA userkeb-nsen s wudem awurman.\n\nAkken ad tɛeddiḍ i waya, rmed taxtiṛit-a deg usfaylu-a n udiwenni: 'Ḥettem tukksa tawurmant n userkeb ɣas ma yella ubleɣ yesɛa ifuyla neɣ ikaramen yeldin'

ƔUR-K: Mi ara tenqes tezmert n tbatrit n uselkim aziraz, Windows yezmer ur d-yettazen ara iznan iwulmen i yisnasen yetteddun mi ara yekcem uselkim ɣer uskar n uḥraz n tezmert. Ihi, VeraCrypt yezmer ur yessaweḍ ara ad yekkes aserkeb n yiblaɣen s wudem awurman deg tegnatin-a.
Tesɣewseḍ akala n uwgelhen/uzmak n uḥric/ubleɣ. Akala ur yemmid ara yakan.\n\nTebɣiḍ ad tkemmleḍ akala tura?
Tesɣewseḍ akala n uwgelhen neɣ n uzmak n uḥric/uḍebsi n unagraw. Akala ur yemmid ara yakan.\n\nTebɣiḍ ad tebduḍ (ad tkemmleḍ) akala tura?
Tebɣiḍ ad k-d-yettwasuter ma tebɣiḍ ad tkemmleḍ ikalan n uwgelhen/uzmak yettwasɣewsen tura n yiḥricen/yiblaɣen ur nelli ara d wid n unagraw?
Ih, kemmel asuter
Ala, ur d-ssutur ara

D AYEN ILAQEN: Cfu belli tzemreḍ ad tkemmleḍ akala n uwgelhen/uzmak n yal aḥric/ableɣ ur nelli ara d win n unagraw, s ufran n 'Iblaɣen' > 'Kemmel akala i yeḥebsen' seg ufeggag n wumuɣen n usfaylu agejdan n VeraCrypt.

Tesɣewseḍ akala n uwgelhen neɣ n uzmak n uḥric/uḍebsi n unagraw. Maca, asesteb uqbel asekkar ur yeddi ara (neɣ yettwazgel).\n\nTamawt: Ma tezmekḍ aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw deg twennaḍt uqbel asekkar, yezmer ad tesriḍ ad tfakkeḍ akala s ufran n 'Anagraw' > 'Zmek aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw i lebda' seg ufeggag n wumuɣen n usfaylu agejdan n VeraCrypt.

ƔUR-K: Ma yeffeɣ VeraCrypt tura, timahilin-a ad ttwassensent:

1) Inegzumen s unasiw
2) Tukksa tawurmant n userkeb (amedya, mi ara teffɣeḍ seg tɣimit, mi ara yettwakkes yibenk i yeḥerzen ableɣ s tuccḍa, mi ara tfukk tallit n uraǧu, atg.)
3) Aserkeb awurman n yiblaɣen inurifen
4) Ilɣa (amedya, mi ara yettwaseḥbes uḍurru n ubleɣ uffir)

Tamawt: Ma ur tebɣiḍ ara ad yeddu VeraCrypt deg ugilal, sens tawuri n ugilal n VeraCrypt deg Yismenyifen (u ma ilaq, sens asekkar awurman n VeraCrypt deg Yismenyifen).

Tetḥeqqeḍ tebɣiḍ ad yeffeɣ VeraCrypt?
Ad teffɣeḍ?
VeraCrypt ur yesɛi ara talɣut s wazal ilaqen akken ad isbadu ma ilaq ad yewgelhen neɣ ad yezmek.

VeraCrypt ur yesɛi ara talɣut s wazal ilaqen akken ad isbadu ma ilaq ad yewgelhen neɣ ad yezmek.\n\nTamawt: Ma tezmekḍ aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw deg twennaḍt uqbel asekkar, yezmer ad tesriḍ ad tfakkeḍ akala s usiti ɣef Zmek.

Tamawt: Mi ara twgelhneḍ deg umḍiq aḥric/ableɣ ur nelli ara d win n unagraw, u tuccḍa teḥbes-ik yal tikkelt ur tezmireḍ ara ad tfakkeḍ akala, ur tezmireḍ ara ad tserkbeḍ ableɣ (u ad tkecmeḍ ɣer yisefka i yellan deg-s) alamma TEZMEKḌ ableɣ s lekmal-is (d anamek ad terreḍ akala ɣer deffir).

Ma tesriḍ ad tgeḍ aya, ḍfer isurifen-a:
1) Ffeɣ seg umallal-a.
2) Deg usfaylu agejdan n VeraCrypt, fren 'Iblaɣen' > 'Kemmel akala i yeḥebsen'.
3) Fren 'Zmek'.

Tebɣiḍ ad tesḥebseḍ u ad tesmezgreḍ akala n uwgelhen/uzmak n uḥric/ubleɣ?\n\nTamawt: Cfu belli ableɣ ur yezmir ara ad yettwaserkeb alamma yettwawgelhen neɣ yettwazmek s lekmal-is. Ad tizmireḍ ad tkemmleḍ akala n uwgelhen/uzmak, ad ikemmel seg umḍiq ideg yeḥbes. Tzemreḍ ad tgeḍ aya, amedya, s ufran n 'Iblaɣen' > 'Kemmel akala i yeḥebsen' seg ufeggag n wumuɣen n usfaylu agejdan n VeraCrypt.

Tebɣiḍ ad tesḥebseḍ u ad tesmezgreḍ akala n uwgelhen n uḥric/uḍebsi n unagraw?\n\nTamawt: Ad tizmireḍ ad tkemmleḍ akala, ad ikemmel seg umḍiq ideg yeḥbes. Tzemreḍ ad tgeḍ aya, amedya, s ufran n 'Anagraw' > 'Kemmel akala i yeḥebsen' seg ufeggag n wumuɣen n usfaylu agejdan n VeraCrypt. Ma tebɣiḍ ad tesḥebseḍ akala n uwgelhen i lebda neɣ ad t-terreḍ ɣer deffir, fren 'Anagraw' > 'Zmek aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw i lebda'.

Tebɣiḍ ad tesḥebseḍ u ad tesmezgreḍ akala n uzmak n uḥric/uḍebsi n unagraw?\n\nTamawt: Ad tizmireḍ ad tkemmleḍ akala, ad ikemmel seg umḍiq ideg yeḥbes. Tzemreḍ ad tgeḍ aya, amedya, s ufran n 'Anagraw' > 'Kemmel akala i yeḥebsen' seg ufeggag n wumuɣen n usfaylu agejdan n VeraCrypt. Ma tebɣiḍ ad terreḍ akala n uzmak ɣer deffir (u ad tebduḍ awgelhen), fren 'Anagraw' > 'Wgelhen aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw'.
Tuccḍa: Aḥbas n ukala n uwgelhen/uzmak n uḥric/uḍebsi n unagraw ur yeddi ara.
Tuccḍa: Aḥbas n ukala n wesfaḍ ur yeddi ara.
Tuccḍa: Aɛiwed n ukala n uwgelhen/uzmak n uḥric/uḍebsi n unagraw seg umḍiq ideg yeḥbes ur yeddi ara.
Tuccḍa: Asenker n ukala n wesfaḍ ur yeddi ara.

Ulac akala n uwgelhen/uzmak n uḥric/uḍebsi n unagraw i yeḥebsen ara tkemmleḍ.\n\nTamawt: Ma tebɣiḍ ad tkemmleḍ akala i yeḥebsen n uwgelhen/uzmak n uḥric/ubleɣ ur nelli ara d win n unagraw, fren 'Iblaɣen' > 'Kemmel akala i yeḥebsen'.

ƔUR-K: Tawuri n ugilal n VeraCrypt tensa. Mi ara teffɣeḍ seg VeraCrypt, ur k-d-yettwammal ara ma yettwaseḥbes uḍurru n ubleɣ uffir.

Tamawt: Tzemreḍ ad tesḥebseḍ tawuri n ugilal melmi tebɣiḍ s usiti s teqeffalt tayefust ɣef tignit n VeraCrypt deg temnaḍt n yilɣa, syin s ufran n 'Ffeɣ'.

Ad tremdeḍ tawuri n ugilal n VeraCrypt?
