Asenqed n unagraw n yifuyla deg ubleɣ n VeraCrypt yettwaserkben d %s...
Aɛraḍ n useggem n unagraw n yifuyla deg ubleɣ n VeraCrypt yettwaserkben d %s...

Ɣur-k: Ableɣ-a yettwawgelhen s yalguritm n uwgelhen aqbur.\n\nAkk ilguritmen n uwgelhen s yiḥedran n 64 n yibiten (amedya, Blowfish, CAST-128, neɣ Triple DES) d iqburen, ur ttusemterren ara tura. Ad yili wamek ara tserkbeḍ ableɣ-a s yileqman i d-iteddun n VeraCrypt. Maca, ur ttilin ara ugar n yiseggemen deg uselkem n yilguritmen-a iqburen n uwgelhen. Ad k-nweṣṣi ad d-tesnulfuḍ ableɣ amaynut n VeraCrypt yettwawgelhen s yalguritm n uwgelhen s yiḥedran n 128 n yibiten (amedya, AES, Serpent, Twofish, atg.), u ad tesmuttiḍ akk ifuyla seg ubleɣ-a ɣer ubleɣ amaynut.

Anagraw-ik ur yettwaswel ara i userkeb awurman n yiblaɣen imaynuten. Yezmer ur yili ara wamek ara tserkbeḍ iblaɣen n VeraCrypt i yellan deg yibenkan. Aserkeb awurman yezmer ad yettwarmed s uselkem n wanaḍ-a d uɛiwed n usekkar n unagraw.\n\nmountvol.exe /E

Mudd asekkil n umeɣri i uḥric/yibenk uqbel ad tkemmleḍ ('Control Panel' > 'System and Maintenance' > 'Administrative Tools' - 'Create and format hard disk partitions').\n\nẒer belli aya d ayen i yesra unagraw n wammud.
Serkeb ableɣ n VeraCrypt
Kkes aserkeb n yiblaɣen n VeraCrypt meṛṛa
VeraCrypt ur yessaweḍ ara ad d-yawi tiseglutin n unedbal.

Anagraw n wammud yugi anekcum.\n\nSebba izemren ad tili: Anagraw n wammud yesra ad tesɛuḍ tasiregt n tɣuri/tira (neɣ tiseglutin n unedbal) i kra n yikaramen, yifuyla d yibenkan, akken ad k-yettwasireg ad tɣerḍ u ad taruḍ isefka seg-sen/ɣur-sen. S umata, aseqdac war tiseglutin n unedbal yesɛa tasiregt ad d-yesnulfu, ad iɣer u ad ibeddel ifuyla deg ukaram-is Documents.

Tuccḍa: Aḍebsi yesseqdac teɣzi n yigezmen ur nettwasefrak ara.\n\nTura ur yezmir ara ad d-yili usnulfu n yiblaɣen deg yiḥricen/yibenkan ɣef yiḍebsiyen i yesseqdacen igezmen i yugaren 4096 n yiṭamḍanen. Maca, ẓer belli tzemreḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ iblaɣen deg yifuyla (ifuyla n uḥraz) ɣef yiḍebsiyen am wigi.
Tura ur yezmir ara ad yettwawgelhen unagraw yettwasbedden deg uḍebsi i yesseqdacen teɣzi n yigezmen yemgaraden ɣef 512 n yiṭamḍanen.

Amsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt yesra 32 KibiBytes ma drus n tallunt tilellit di tazwara n uḍebsi n unagraw (amsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt ilaq ad yettwaḥrez deg temnaḍt-nni). S lḥif, aḍebsi-ik ur yessaweḍ ara ɣer tewtilt-a.\n\nUR d-ttazen ARA aya d aneqqis n ubug/wugur deg VeraCrypt. Akken ad tefruḍ ugur-a, ilaq ad talseḍ beṭṭu n uḍebsi-ik d iḥricen, u ad teǧǧeḍ 32 KibiBytes imezwura n uḍebsi d ilelliyen (deg tuget n tegnatin, ilaq ad tekkseḍ aḥric amezwaru u ad t-id-tesnulfuḍ tikkelt-nniḍen). Ad k-nweṣṣi ad tesqedceḍ amsefrak n yiḥricen n Microsoft i yewjden, amedya, mi ara tesbeddeḍ Windows.
Tamahilt-a ur tettwasefrak ara deg lqem n unagraw n wammud i tseqdaceḍ tura.
VeraCrypt ur isefrak ara awgelhen n uḥric/uḍebsi n unagraw deg lqem n unagraw n wammud i tseqdaceḍ tura.

Uqbel ad tizmireḍ ad twgelhneḍ aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw deg Windows Vista, ilaq ad tesbeddeḍ Service Pack 1 neɣ win i t-id-yeḍfaren i Windows Vista (ulac Service Pack am wagi i yettwasbedden deg unagraw-a yakan).\n\nTamawt: Service Pack 1 i Windows Vista yefra ugur i d-yettawin lixṣaṣ n tkatut tazadurt tilellit deg usekkar n unagraw.

VeraCrypt ur isefrak ara tura awgelhen n uḥric/uḍebsi n unagraw deg Windows Vista war Service Pack yettwasbedden. Uqbel ad tmucceḍeḍ VeraCrypt, sbedd Service Pack 1 neɣ win i t-id-yeḍfaren i Windows Vista.
Tuccḍa: Tamahilt-a tesra VeraCrypt ad yettwasbedd deg unagraw (tsekkreḍ VeraCrypt deg uskar aninig).\n\nSbedd VeraCrypt, syin ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen.

ƔUR-K: Yettban-d belli Windows ur yettwasbedd ara deg uḍebsi seg ideg yekker. Aya ur yettwasefrak ara.

Ilaq ad tkemmleḍ kan ma tetḥeqqeḍ belli Windows yettwasbedd deg uḍebsi seg ideg yekker.

Tebɣiḍ ad tkemmleḍ?

ƔUR-K: Amsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt yettwasbedd yakan deg uḍebsi-ik n unagraw!

Yezmer ad yili unagraw nniḍen deg uselkim-ik yettwawgelhen yakan.

ƔUR-K: MA TKEMMLEḌ AWGELHEN N UNAGRAW I YETTAZZALEN TURA, YEZMER UR YETTILI ARA WAMEK ARA D-KKREN YINAGRAWEN NNIḌEN, U ISEFKA I TEN-YERZAN UR ZMIREN ARA AD TTWAKCEMEN.

Tetḥeqqeḍ tebɣiḍ ad tkemmleḍ?

Tiririt n umsali aneṣli n unagraw ur teddi ara.\n\nSeqdec aḍebsi-ik n usellek n VeraCrypt ('Repair Options' > 'Restore original system loader') neɣ amidya n usebded n Windows akken ad tesmeselsiḍ amsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt s umsali n unagraw n Windows.
Amsali aneṣli n unagraw ur yettwaḥraz ara deg uḍebsi n usellek (sebba i izemren ad tili: afaylu n uḥraz ixuṣṣ).

Tira n yigezmi MBR ur teddi ara.\n\nBIOS-ik yezmer ad yili yettwaswel akken ad imesten igezmi MBR. Senqed iɣewwaren n BIOS-ik (sit ɣef F2, Delete, neɣ Esc, mi ara tsekkreḍ aselkim-ik) i umesten n MBR/mgal ivirusen.

ƔUR-K: Asenqed n udsil n umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt ur yeddi ara!
Yezmer ad yili ucengu ibeddel aḍebsi-ik (aẓdam "Evil Maid").

Alɣu-a yezmer daɣen ad d-iban ma terreḍ-d amsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt s uḍebsi n usellek i d-yettwarwen s lqem nniḍen n VeraCrypt.

Ilaq ad tbeddleḍ awal-ik uffir imiren, ayen ara d-yerren daɣen amsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt iṣeḥḥan. Yettwasemter ad talseḍ asebded n VeraCrypt u ad teḍfreḍ tiɣawsiwin ara isḥebsen anekcum ɣer tmacint-a i wid ur tettamneḍ ara.
Lqem ilaqen n umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt ur yettwasbedd ara tura. Aya yezmer ad isḥbes aḥraz n kra n yiɣewwaren.

Tamawt: Deg kra n tegnatin, yezmer ad tebɣuḍ ad tḥebseḍ amdan (acengu) i k-yettwalin tsekkreḍ aselkim ur yettissin ara belli tseqdaceḍ VeraCrypt. Tixtiṛiyin i d-yettwabeǧǧeḍen nnig ad k-aǧǧent ad tgeḍ aya s usagen n ugdil n umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt. Ma tremdeḍ taxtiṛit tamezwarut, amsali n usekkar ur d-ibeggeḍ ara iḍrisen (ula mi ara tesnekcmeḍ awal uffir ur neṣḥiḥ ara). Aselkim ad d-iban am wakken "yeḥbes", maca tzemreḍ ad taruḍ awal-ik uffir. Rnu ɣer waya, izen yugnen yezmer ad d-yettwabeǧǧeḍ akken ad isɣleḍ acengu. Amedya, iznan n tuccḍa ikerkasen am "Missing operating system" (i d-ibeggeḍ s umata umsali n usekkar n Windows ma ur d-yufi ara aḥric n usekkar n Windows). Maca, ilaq ad teẓreḍ belli ma acengu yezmer ad yesleḍ agbur n uḍebsi aqquran, mazal yezmer ad d-yaf belli yegber amsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt.

ƔUR-K: Cfu belli ma tremdeḍ taxtiṛit-a, amsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt ur d-ibeggeḍ ara iḍrisen (ula mi ara tesnekcmeḍ awal uffir ur neṣḥiḥ ara). Aselkim ad d-iban am wakken "yeḥbes" (ur d-yettarra ara), maca tzemreḍ ad taruḍ awal-ik uffir (taḥnaccaṭ UR tettḥerrik ARA, u ulac asterisk ara d-yettwabeǧǧeḍen mi ara tsateḍ ɣef teqeffalt).\n\nTetḥeqqeḍ tebɣiḍ ad tremdeḍ taxtiṛit-a?
Aḥric/aḍebsi-ik n unagraw yettban-d yettwawgelhen s lekmal-is.
VeraCrypt ur isefrak ara awgelhen n uḍebsi n unagraw i yettwaselkten ɣer uḍebsi asmussaw.

Aḍebsi n unagraw yegber iḥricen yettwasiɣezfen (imeẓẓulen).

Tzemreḍ ad twgelhneḍ aḍebsi n unagraw s lekmal-is i yegbren iḥricen yettwasiɣezfen (imeẓẓulen) kan deg Windows Vista d yileqman n Windows i t-id-yeḍfaren. Deg Windows XP, tzemreḍ ad twgelhneḍ aḍebsi n unagraw s lekmal-is ma yegber kan iḥricen izwaranen.

Tamawt: Mazal tzemreḍ ad twgelhneḍ aḥric n unagraw deg umḍiq n uḍebsi n unagraw s lekmal-is (rnu ɣer waya, tzemreḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ iblaɣen n VeraCrypt deg yiḥricen ur nelli ara d wid n unagraw ɣef uḍebsi).

ƔUR-K: Acku tseqdaceḍ Windows XP/2003, mi ara tebduḍ awgelhen n uḍebsi, UR ilaq ARA ad d-tesnulfuḍ fell-as iḥricen yettwasiɣezfen (imeẓẓulen), tzemreḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ kan iḥricen izwaranen. Yal aḥric yettwasiɣezfen (ameẓẓul) deg uḍebsi ur yezmir ara ad yettwakcem mi ara tebduḍ awgelhen (aḍebsi ur yegbir ara tura iḥricen am wigi).

Tamawt: Ma talast-a ur k-twulem ara, tzemreḍ ad tuɣaleḍ ɣer deffir u ad tferneḍ ad twgelhneḍ kan aḥric n unagraw deg umḍiq n uḍebsi s lekmal-is (rnu ɣer waya, tzemreḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ iblaɣen n VeraCrypt deg yiḥricen ur nelli ara d wid n unagraw ɣef uḍebsi).

Neɣ, ma talast-a ur k-twulem ara, tzemreḍ ad txemmeḍ ad tmucceḍeḍ ɣer Windows Vista neɣ lqem n Windows i t-id-yeḍfaren (tzemreḍ ad twgelhneḍ aḍebsi n unagraw s lekmal-is i yegbren iḥricen yettwasiɣezfen/imeẓẓulen kan deg Windows Vista neɣ lqem i t-id-yeḍfaren).

Aḍebsi-ik n unagraw yegber aḥric ur nelli ara d amagnu.\n\nMa tseqdaceḍ aselkim aziraz, ahat aḍebsi-ik n unagraw yegber aḥric uzzig n tririt n unagraw. Mi ara yettwawgelhen uḍebsi n unagraw s lekmal-is (ula d aḥric n tririt), anagraw-ik yezmer ur yekker ara ma aselkim-ik yesseqdac BIOS ur nettwafṣel ara akken iwata. Daɣen, ur yettili ara wamek ara tesqedceḍ aḥric n tririt alamma yettwazmek uḍebsi n unagraw. Ihi, ad k-nweṣṣi ad twgelhneḍ kan aḥric n unagraw.

Tebɣiḍ ad twgelhneḍ aḥric n unagraw deg umḍiq n uḍebsi s lekmal-is?\n\nẒer belli tzemreḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ iblaɣen n VeraCrypt deg yiḥricen ur nelli ara d wid n unagraw ɣef uḍebsi (rnu ɣer uwgelhen n uḥric n unagraw).

Acku aḍebsi-ik n unagraw yegber yiwen n uḥric kan i yeṭṭfen aḍebsi s lekmal-is, yif-it (i tɣellist ugar) ad twgelhneḍ aḍebsi s lekmal-is, ula d tallunt tilellit i d-yeqqimen i yezgan tezzin i uḥric am wagi.\n\nTebɣiḍ ad twgelhneḍ aḍebsi n unagraw s lekmal-is?
Anagraw-ik yettwaswel akken ad iḥrez ifuyla ikudanen deg uḥric ur nelli ara d win n unagraw.\n\nIfuyla ikudanen zemren ad ttwaḥerzen kan deg uḥric n unagraw.
Ifuyla n umaɣnu-ik n useqdac ur ttwaḥerzen ara deg uḥric n unagraw.\n\nIfuyla n umaɣnu n useqdac zemren ad ttwaḥerzen kan deg uḥric n unagraw.
Llan ifuyla n tissubtert deg yiḥricen ur nelli ara d wid n unagraw.\n\nIfuyla n tissubtert zemren ad ilin kan deg uḥric n unagraw.

Tebɣiḍ ad teswelḍ Windows tura akken ad d-yesnulfu ifuyla n tissubtert kan deg uḥric n Windows?\n\nẒer belli ma tsateḍ ɣef 'Ih', aselkim ad yales asekkar. Syin sekker VeraCrypt, ɛreḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ anagraw n wammud uffir tikkelt-nniḍen.

Ma ulac, tazmert n tnekra n tilin n unagraw n wammud uffir s wudem ara yettwamnen tezmer ad tettwaḍurr.\n\nTamawt: Ma acengu yesleḍ agbur n yifuyla am wigi (i yellan deg uḥric ur nelli ara d win n unagraw), yezmer ad d-yaf belli tesqedceḍ amallal-a deg uskar n usnulfu n unagraw uffir (ayen i izemren ad d-yesken tilin n unagraw n wammud uffir deg uselkim-ik). Ẓer daɣen belli ifuyla am wigi i yellan deg uḥric n unagraw ad ten-yesfeḍ VeraCrypt s tɣellist deg ukala n usnulfu n unagraw n wammud uffir.

ƔUR-K: Deg ukala n usnulfu n unagraw n wammud uffir, ilaq ad talseḍ asebded n unagraw i yettazzalen tura s lekmal-is (akken ad d-tesnulfuḍ anagraw n useɣleḍ s tɣellist).

Tamawt: Anagraw n wammud i yettazzalen tura d yigbur n uḥric n unagraw s lekmal-is ad ttwanɣlen ɣer ubleɣ uffir (akken ad d-yettwasnulfu unagraw uffir).


Tetḥeqqeḍ ad tizmireḍ ad tesbeddeḍ Windows s umidya n usebded n Windows (neɣ s uḥric n tenfa)?

Ɣef sebba n tɣellist, ma anagraw n wammud i yettazzalen tura yesra armad, ilaq ad yettwarmed uqbel ad tkemmleḍ. Ẓer belli anagraw n wammud uffir ad d-yettwasnulfu s unɣal n yigbur n uḥric n unagraw ɣer ubleɣ uffir (ihi ma anagraw-a n wammud ur yermid ara, anagraw n wammud uffir daɣen ur yermid ara). I wugar n telɣut, wali aḥric "Security Requirements and Precautions Pertaining to Hidden Volumes" deg umnir n useqdac n VeraCrypt.

D ayen ilaqen: Uqbel ad tkemmleḍ, ḍmen belli teɣriḍ aḥric "Security Requirements and Precautions Pertaining to Hidden Volumes" deg umnir n useqdac n VeraCrypt.


Anagraw n wammud i yettazzalen tura yessaweḍ ɣer tewtilt i d-yettwabedren nnig?

Anagraw-ik yesseqdac aḥric n usekkar nniḍen. VeraCrypt ur isefrak ara taguni taɣezfant deg yinagrawen n wammud uffiren i yesseqdacen aḥric n usekkar nniḍen (inagrawen n useɣleḍ zemren ad kecmen ɣer tguni taɣezfant war uguren).

Ẓer belli aḥric n usekkar ad yettwabḍu gar unagraw n useɣleḍ d unagraw uffir. Ihi, akken ad isḥbes asuffeɣ n yisefka d wuguren mi ara d-yuɣal uselkim seg tguni taɣezfant, VeraCrypt ilaq ad isḥbes anagraw uffir ur yettaru ara ɣer uḥric n usekkar yettwabḍan, u ur ikeččem ara ɣer tguni taɣezfant.


Tebɣiḍ ad tkemmleḍ? Ma tferneḍ 'Ala', ad d-ttwabeǧǧḍent tinaḍin n tukksa n uḥric n usekkar nniḍen.

Aḥric n usekkar nniḍen yezmer ad yettwakkes uqbel asebded n Windows. Akken ad tgeḍ aya, ḍfer isurifen-a:

1) Sekker seg uḍebsi-ik n usebded n Windows.

2) Deg ugdil n umsebdad n Windows, sit ɣef 'Install now' > 'Custom (advanced)'.

3) Sit ɣef 'Drive Options'.

4) Fren aḥric agejdan n unagraw, kkes-it s usiti ɣef 'Delete' d 'OK'.

5) Fren aḥric 'System Reserved', sit ɣef 'Extend', simɣur teɣzi-s akken ad yezmer unagraw n wammud ad yettwasbedd deg-s.

6) Sit ɣef 'Apply' d 'OK'.

7) Sbedd Windows deg uḥric 'System Reserved'.


Ma acengu yesteqsa-k acuɣer tekkseḍ aḥric n usekkar nniḍen, tzemreḍ ad terreḍ belli tebɣiḍ ad tḥebseḍ yal asuffeɣ izemren ad yili n yisefka ɣer uḥric n usekkar ur nettwawgelhen ara.

Tamawt: Tzemreḍ ad tesiggezeḍ aḍris-a s usiti ɣef teqeffalt 'Siggez' ddaw. Ma tḥerzeḍ anɣel n uḍris-a neɣ tesiggezḍ-t (d ayen yettwasemterren s waṭas, ala ma tasaggazt-ik teḥerrez inɣalen n yisemliyen i tessigiz deg uḍebsi-s agensan), ilaq ad tesneɣṣeḍ akk inɣalen-is deffir tukksa n uḥric n usekkar nniḍen (ma ulac, ma yettwaf unɣel am wagi, yezmer ad d-yesken belli yella unagraw n wammud uffir deg uselkim-a).

Ɣur-k: Tella tallunt ur nettwaḥeṛṛ ara gar uḥric n unagraw d uḥric amezwaru deffir-s. Mi ara d-tesnulfuḍ anagraw n wammud uffir, ur ilaq ara ad d-tesnulfuḍ iḥricen imaynuten deg tallunt-nni ur nettwaḥeṛṛ ara. Ma ulac, anagraw n wammud uffir ur yezmir ara ad yekker (alamma tekkseḍ iḥricen-nni imaynuten i d-tesnulfaḍ).
Alguritm-a ur yettwasefrak ara tura i uwgelhen n unagraw.
Alguritm-a ur yettwasefrak ara i uskar TrueCrypt.
PIM (Personal Iterations Multiplier) ur yettwasefrak ara i uskar TrueCrypt.
Awal uffir ilaq ad yegber 20 n yisekkilen neɣ ugar akken ad tesqedceḍ PIM i d-yettwasbadun.\nAwalen uffiren iwezlan ugar zemren ad ttwasqedcen kan ma PIM d 485 neɣ ugar.
Awal uffir n usesteb uqbel asekkar ilaq ad yegber 20 n yisekkilen neɣ ugar akken ad tesqedceḍ PIM i d-yettwasbadun.\nAwalen uffiren iwezlan ugar zemren ad ttwasqedcen kan ma PIM d 98 neɣ ugar.
Ifuyla n tsura ur ttusefraken ara tura i uwgelhen n unagraw.
Ɣur-k: VeraCrypt ur yessaweḍ ara ad d-yerr taneɣruft taneṣlit n unasiw. Aya yezmer ad k-yeǧǧ ad tesnekcmeḍ awal uffir s tuccḍa.

Tuccḍa: Ur yezmir ara ad isbadu taneɣruft n unasiw i VeraCrypt ɣer tneɣruft tamagnut US n unasiw.\n\nẒer belli awal uffir ilaq ad yettwaru deg twennaḍt uqbel asekkar (uqbel ad yekker Windows), anda tineɣrufin n unasiw n Windows ur nelli ara d US ur ttawjudent ara. Ihi, awal uffir ilaq ad yettwaru yal tikkelt s tneɣruft tamagnut US n unasiw.

Acku VeraCrypt ibeddel taneɣruft n unasiw i kra n wakud ɣer tneɣruft tamagnut US n unasiw, ur yezmir ara ad yili usekcem n yisekkilen s usiti ɣef teqeffalin mi teṭṭfeḍ taqeffalt Alt tayefust. Maca, tzemreḍ ad tesnekcmeḍ tuget n yisekkilen-a s usiti ɣef teqeffalin iwulmen mi teṭṭfeḍ taqeffalt Shift.
VeraCrypt isḥebs abeddel n tneɣruft n unasiw.

Tamawt: Awal uffir ilaq ad yettwaru deg twennaḍt uqbel asekkar (uqbel ad yekker Windows), anda tineɣrufin n unasiw n Windows ur nelli ara d US ur ttawjudent ara. Ihi, awal uffir ilaq ad yettwaru yal tikkelt s tneɣruft tamagnut US n unasiw. Maca, ilaq ad teẓreḍ belli UR tesriḍ ARA anasiw US ilaw. VeraCrypt iḍemmen s wudem awurman ad tizmireḍ ad taruḍ awal uffir s tɣellist (tura d twennaḍt uqbel asekkar), ɣas UR tesɛiḍ ARA anasiw US ilaw.

Uqbel ad tizmireḍ ad twgelhneḍ aḥric/aḍebsi, ilaq ad d-tesnulfuḍ aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt (VRD), i yesɛan iswiya-a:

- Ma yexser umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt, tasarut tagejdayt neɣ isefka nniḍen yesɛan azal ameqqran, VRD ad k-yeǧǧ ad ten-id-terreḍ (maca ẓer belli ilaq mazal ad tesnekcmeḍ awal uffir iṣeḥḥan).

- Ma yexser Windows ur yezmir ara ad yekker, VRD ad k-yeǧǧ ad tezmekḍ aḥric/aḍebsi i lebda uqbel ad yekker Windows.

- VRD ad yegber anɣel n uḥraz n yigbur amiran n tfuɣalt tamezwarut n uḍebsi (i yegbren s umata amsali n unagraw neɣ amsefrak n usekkar), u ad k-yeǧǧ ad t-id-terreḍ ma ilaq.

Tugna ISO n uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt ad d-tettwasnulfu deg wadeg i d-yettwasbadun ddaw.

Mi ara tsateḍ ɣef OK, Microsoft Windows Disc Image Burner ad yekker. Seqdec-it akken ad teskelseḍ tugna ISO n uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt ɣef CD neɣ DVD.\n\nMi ara tgeḍ aya, uɣal ɣer umallal n usnulfu n yiblaɣen n VeraCrypt, ḍfer tinaḍin-is.

Tugna n uḍebsi n usellek tettwasnulfa-d, tettwaḥrez deg ufaylu-a:
%s

Tura ilaq ad tt-teskelseḍ ɣef CD neɣ DVD.

%lsMi ara teskelseḍ aḍebsi n usellek, sit ɣef Uḍfir akken ad tesneqdeḍ belli yettwakles akken iwata.

Tugna n uḍebsi n usellek tettwasnulfa-d, tettwaḥrez deg ufaylu-a:
%s

Tura ilaq ad teskelseḍ tugna ɣef CD/DVD neɣ ad tt-tesmuttiḍ ɣer wadeg aɣelsan i useqdec ticki.

%lsSit ɣef Uḍfir akken ad tkemmleḍ.

D AYEN ILAQEN: Ẓer belli afaylu ilaq ad yettwaru ɣef CD/DVD d tugna n uḍebsi ISO (mačči d afaylu iman-is). I telɣut ɣef wamek ara tgeḍ aya, wali tumlin n useɣẓan-ik n ukalas ɣef CD/DVD. Ma ur tesɛiḍ ara aseɣẓan n ukalas ɣef CD/DVD i izemren ad yaru tugna n uḍebsi ISO ɣef CD/DVD, sit ɣef useɣwen ddaw akken ad d-tsidreḍ aseɣẓan baṭel am wagi.\n\n
Sekker Microsoft Windows Disc Image Burner

ƔUR-K: Ma tesnulfaḍ-d aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt yakan, ur yezmir ara ad yettwasqedec tikkelt-nniḍen i uḥric/uḍebsi-a n unagraw, acku yettwasnulfa-d i tsarut tagejdayt nniḍen! Yal tikkelt ara twgelhneḍ aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw, ilaq ad as-d-tesnulfuḍ aḍebsi amaynut n usellek n VeraCrypt, ɣas tseqdaceḍ yiwen n wawal uffir.
Tuccḍa: Ur yezmir ara ad iḥrez iɣewwaren n uwgelhen n unagraw.
Ur yezmir ara ad yebdu asekyed aqbel n uwgelhen n unagraw.
Ur yezmir ara ad yebdu akala n usnulfu n unagraw n wammud uffir.
Askar n wesfaḍ

Ɣef kra n wanawen n yimidyaten n uḥraz, mi ara ttwasemselsin yisefka s yisefka nniḍen, yezmer ad yili wamek ara d-ttwarren yisefka yettwasemselsin s tetiknikin am usenqed s umikṛuskup n tezmert tadkirant. Aya yerza daɣen isefka i yettwasemselsin s talɣa-nsen tawgelhant (ayen i yettḍerrun mi ara yebdu VeraCrypt awgelhen n uḥric neɣ uḍebsi ur nettwawgelhen ara). Ilmend n kra n tezrawin d tezrigin n yinedbalen, tiririt n yisefka yettwasemselsin tezmer ad tettwaseḥbes (neɣ ad tuɣal tewɛer aṭas) s usemselsi n yisefka s yisefka i yettemcabin ɣer yisefka igacuranen d kra n yisefka ur nelli ara d igacuranen, kra n tikkal. Ihi, ma tɣileḍ acengu yezmer ad iseqdec tetiknikin-a akken ad d-yerr isefka i tebɣiḍ ad twgelhneḍ, tzemreḍ ad tferneḍ yiwen seg yiskaren n wesfaḍ (isefka yellan UR ṛuḥun ARA). Ẓer belli asfaḍ UR yettwag ARA deffir uwgelhen n uḥric/uḍebsi. Mi ara yettwawgelhen uḥric/uḍebsi s lekmal-is, ulac isefka ur nettwawgelhen ara i yettwarun ɣur-s. Yal isefka ara yettwarun ɣur-s ttwawgelhen di tazwara srid deg tkatut, syin kan i ttwarun yisefka (yettwawgelhnen) ɣef uḍebsi.

Ɣef kra n wanawen n yimidyaten n uḥraz, mi ara ttwasemselsin yisefka s yisefka nniḍen (amedya, mi ara ttwasfeḍen yisefka), yezmer ad yili wamek ara d-ttwarren yisefka yettwasemselsin s tetiknikin am usenqed s umikṛuskup n tezmert tadkirant. Ilmend n kra n tezrawin d tezrigin n yinedbalen, tiririt n yisefka yettwasemselsin tezmer ad tettwaseḥbes (neɣ ad tuɣal tewɛer aṭas) s usemselsi n yisefka s yisefka i yettemcabin ɣer yisefka igacuranen d kra n yisefka ur nelli ara d igacuranen, kra n tikkal. Ihi, ma tɣileḍ acengu yezmer ad iseqdec tetiknikin-a akken ad d-yerr isefka ara yettwasfeḍen, tzemreḍ ad tferneḍ yiwen seg yiskaren n wesfaḍ s waṭas n tikkal.\n\nTamawt: Simmal tuget n tikkal n wesfaḍ i tseqdaceḍ, simmal yettɛeṭṭil wesfaḍ n yisefka.
Asfaḍ iteddu

\nTamawt: Tzemreḍ ad tesḥebseḍ akala n wesfaḍ, ad tessenseḍ aselkim-ik, ad tsekkreḍ anagraw uffir tikkelt-nniḍen, syin ad tkemmleḍ akala (amallal-a ad yekker s wudem awurman). Maca, ma tesḥebseḍ-t, akala n wesfaḍ s lekmal-is ilaq ad yales seg tazwara.
\n\nTamawt: Ma tesḥebseḍ akala n wesfaḍ, syin tɛerḍeḍ ad t-tkemmleḍ, akala s lekmal-is ilaq ad yales seg tazwara.
Tebɣiḍ ad tḥebseḍ akala n wesfaḍ?
Ɣur-k: Agbur n uḥric/yibenk yettwafernen s lekmal-is ad yettwasfeḍ u ad iṛuḥ.
Agbur n uḥric ideg yella unagraw aneṣli s lekmal-is ad yettwasfeḍ.\n\nTamawt: Agbur n uḥric ara yettwasfeḍ s lekmal-is yettwanɣel ɣer uḥric-a n unagraw uffir.

ƔUR-K: Ẓer belli ma tferneḍ, amedya, askar n wesfaḍ s 3 n tikkal, akud ilaqen i uwgelhen n uḥric/uḍebsi yezmer ad yugar akud amagnu alamma d 4 n tikkal. Akka daɣen, ma tferneḍ askar n wesfaḍ s 35 n tikkal, yezmer ad t-yugar alamma d 36 n tikkal (yezmer ula ad yeṭṭef aṭas n yimalas).

Maca, ẓer belli asfaḍ UR yettwag ARA deffir uwgelhen n uḥric/uḍebsi s lekmal-is. Mi ara yettwawgelhen uḥric/uḍebsi s lekmal-is, ulac isefka ur nettwawgelhen ara i yettwarun ɣur-s. Yal isefka ara yettwarun ɣur-s ttwawgelhen di tazwara srid deg tkatut, syin kan i ttwarun yisefka (yettwawgelhnen) ɣef uḍebsi (ihi timellit UR tettwaḍurr ARA).

Tetḥeqqeḍ tebɣiḍ ad tesqedceḍ askar n wesfaḍ?
Ulac (d arurad ugar)
1 n tikkelt (isefka igacuranen)
3 n tikkal (US DoD 5220.22-M)
7 n tikkal (US DoD 5220.22-M)
35 n tikkal ("Gutmann")
256 n tikkal
Amḍan n yinagrawen n wammud
ƔUR-K: Iseqdacen war tirmit ur ilaq ara ad ɛerḍen ad wgelhnen Windows deg twila n usekkar n waṭas n yinagrawen.\n\nAd tkemmleḍ?

Mi ara d-tesnulfuḍ/tesqedceḍ anagraw n wammud uffir, VeraCrypt isefrak tiwila n usekkar n waṭas n yinagrawen kan ma llant tewtilin-a:

- Anagraw n wammud i yettazzalen tura ilaq ad yettwasbedd deg uḍebsi n usekkar, i ur ilaq ara ad yegber inagrawen n wammud nniḍen.

- Inagrawen n wammud yettwasbedden deg yiḍebsiyen nniḍen ur ilaq ara ad seqdcen amsali n usekkar i yellan deg uḍebsi ideg yettwasbedd unagraw n wammud i yettazzalen tura.

Tiwtilin-a llant?
VeraCrypt ur isefrak ara tawila-a n usekkar n waṭas n yinagrawen mi ara d-tesnulfuḍ/tesqedceḍ anagraw n wammud uffir.
Aḍebsi n usekkar

Anagraw n wammud i yettazzalen tura yettwasbedd deg uḍebsi n usekkar?\n\nTamawt: Tikwal, Windows ur yettwasbedd ara deg yiwen n uḍebsi akked umsali n usekkar n Windows (aḥric n usekkar). Ma akka i yella, fren 'Ala'.
VeraCrypt ur isefrak ara tura awgelhen n unagraw n wammud ur nekker ara seg uḍebsi ideg yettwasbedd.
Amḍan n yiḍebsiyen n unagraw

Acḥal n yiḍebsiyen i yegbren anagraw n wammud?\n\nTamawt: Amedya, ma tesɛiḍ anagraw n wammud (amedya Windows, Mac OS X, Linux, atg.) yettwasbedden deg uḍebsi-ik azwaran, d unagraw n wammud nniḍen yettwasbedden deg uḍebsi-ik wis sin, fren '2 neɣ ugar'.

VeraCrypt ur isefrak ara tura awgelhen n uḍebsi s lekmal-is i yegbren aṭas n yinagrawen n wammud.

Tifrat izemren ad ilint:

- Mazal tzemreḍ ad twgelhneḍ yiwen seg yinagrawen ma tuɣaleḍ ɣer deffir u tferneḍ ad twgelhneḍ kan yiwen n uḥric n unagraw (deg umḍiq n ufran n uwgelhen n uḍebsi n unagraw s lekmal-is).

- Neɣ, ad tizmireḍ ad twgelhneḍ aḍebsi s lekmal-is ma tesmuttiḍ kra n yinagrawen ɣer yiḍebsiyen nniḍen, ad teǧǧeḍ kan yiwen n unagraw deg uḍebsi i tebɣiḍ ad twgelhneḍ.
Aṭas n yinagrawen deg yiwen n uḍebsi

Llan inagrawen n wammud nniḍen yettwasbedden deg uḍebsi ideg yettwasbedd unagraw n wammud i yettazzalen tura?\n\nTamawt: Amedya, ma anagraw n wammud i yettazzalen tura yettwasbedd deg uḍebsi #0 i yegbren aṭas n yiḥricen, u yiwen seg yiḥricen yegber Windows, aḥric nniḍen yegber anagraw n wammud nniḍen (amedya Windows, Mac OS X, Linux, atg.), fren 'Ih'.
Amsali n usekkar ur nelli ara d win n Windows

Amsali n usekkar (neɣ amsefrak n usekkar) ur nelli ara d win n Windows yettwasbedd deg ukalas agejdan n usekkar (MBR)?\n\nTamawt: Amedya, ma tafuɣalt tamezwarut n uḍebsi n usekkar tegber GRUB, LILO, XOSL, neɣ amsefrak n usekkar (neɣ amsali n usekkar) nniḍen ur nelli ara d win n Windows, fren 'Ih'.
Asekkar n waṭas n yinagrawen

VeraCrypt ur isefrak ara tura tiwila n usekkar n waṭas n yinagrawen ideg amsali n usekkar ur nelli ara d win n Windows yettwasbedd deg Ukalas Agejdan n Usekkar.

Tifrat izemren ad ilint:

- Ma tseqdaceḍ amsefrak n usekkar akken ad tsekkreḍ Windows d Linux, smutti amsefrak n usekkar (s umata, GRUB) seg Ukalas Agejdan n Usekkar ɣer uḥric. Syin sekker amallal-a tikkelt-nniḍen, wgelhen aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw. Ẓer belli amsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt ad yuɣal d amsefrak-ik azwaran n usekkar, u ad k-yeǧǧ ad tsekkreḍ amsefrak aneṣli n usekkar (amedya GRUB) d amsefrak-ik wis sin n usekkar (s usiti ɣef Esc deg ugdil n umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt), ihi ad tizmireḍ ad tsekkreḍ Linux.

Ma anagraw n wammud i yettazzalen tura yettwasbedd deg uḥric n usekkar, mi ara t-twgelhneḍ, ilaq ad tesnekcmeḍ awal uffir iṣeḥḥan ɣas tebɣiḍ ad tsekkreḍ inagrawen n Windows nniḍen ur nettwawgelhen ara (acku ad bḍun yiwen n umsali/amsefrak awgelhan n usekkar n Windows).

Ma anagraw n wammud i yettazzalen tura ur yettwasbedd ara deg uḥric n usekkar (neɣ amsali/amsefrak n usekkar n Windows ur t-yesseqdac ula d yiwen n unagraw nniḍen), mi ara twgelhneḍ anagraw-a, ur tesriḍ ara ad tesnekcmeḍ awal uffir iṣeḥḥan akken ad tsekkreḍ inagrawen nniḍen ur nettwawgelhen ara -- ilaq kan ad tsateḍ ɣef teqeffalt Esc akken ad tsekkreḍ anagraw ur nettwawgelhen ara (ma llan aṭas n yinagrawen ur nettwawgelhen ara, ilaq daɣen ad tferneḍ anagraw ara tsekkreḍ deg wumuɣ n umsefrak n usekkar n VeraCrypt).

Tamawt: S umata, anagraw n Windows i yettwasbedden d amezwaru yella deg uḥric n usekkar.
Awgelhen n temnaḍt yettwamestnen seg unagraw

Ɣer taggara n waṭas n yiḍebsiyen, tella temnaḍt i yezgan teffer ɣef unagraw n wammud (timnaḍin-a ttusemmant s umata Host Protected Areas). Maca, kra n wahilen zemren ad ɣren u ad arun isefka seg/ɣer temnaḍin-a.

ƔUR-K: Kra n yimeṣnaɛ n yiselkimen zemren ad sqedcen timnaḍin-a akken ad ḥerzen ifecka d yisefka i RAID, tiririt n unagraw, asebded n unagraw, tawassna, neɣ iswiya nniḍen. Ma ilaq ad yili unekcum ɣer yifecka neɣ yisefka-a uqbel asekkar, tamnaḍt tuffirt UR ilaq ARA ad tettwawgelhen (fren 'Ala' nnig).

Tebɣiḍ VeraCrypt ad d-yaf u ad yewgelhen tamnaḍt tuffirt am ta (ma tella) ɣer taggara n uḍebsi n unagraw?
Anaw n uwgelhen n unagraw
Fren taxtiṛit-a ma tebɣiḍ kan ad twgelhneḍ aḥric n unagraw neɣ aḍebsi n unagraw s lekmal-is.

Yezmer ad yili win ara k-iḥettmen ad tezmekḍ anagraw n wammud. Llant aṭas n tegnatin ideg ur tezmireḍ ara ad tagiḍ (amedya, s usehwel). Ma tferneḍ taxtiṛit-a, ad d-tesnulfuḍ anagraw n wammud uffir i tilin-is ur ilaq ara ad tezmer ad tettwaseknen s ubeggen (ma tettwaḍfer kra n tinaḍin). Ihi, ur tesriḍ ara ad tezmekḍ neɣ ad d-tiniḍ awal uffir n unagraw n wammud uffir. I usegzi s telqayt, sit ɣef useɣwen ddaw.

Yezmer ad yili win ara k-iḥettmen ad tezmekḍ anagraw n wammud. Llant aṭas n tegnatin ideg ur tezmireḍ ara ad tagiḍ (amedya, s usehwel).\n\nS useqdec n umallal-a, tzemreḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ anagraw n wammud uffir i tilin-is ur ilaq ara ad tezmer ad tettwaseknen s ubeggen (ma tettwaḍfer kra n tinaḍin). Ihi, ur tesriḍ ara ad tezmekḍ neɣ ad d-tiniḍ awal uffir n unagraw n wammud uffir.
Anagraw n wammud uffir

Deg yisurifen i d-iteddun, ad d-tesnulfuḍ sin n yiblaɣen n VeraCrypt (aniri d uffir) deg uḥric amezwaru deffir uḥric n unagraw. Ableɣ uffir ad yegber anagraw n wammud uffir. VeraCrypt ad d-yesnulfu anagraw n wammud uffir s unɣal n yigbur n uḥric n unagraw (ideg yettwasbedd unagraw n wammud i yettazzalen tura) ɣer ubleɣ uffir. Ɣer ubleɣ aniri, ad tenɣleḍ kra n yifuyla i d-yettbanen d imḥulfan, maca deg tidet UR tebɣiḍ ARA ad ten-teffreḍ. Ad ilin i win akk ara k-iḥettmen ad d-tiniḍ awal uffir n uḥric n unagraw n wammud uffir. Tzemreḍ ad d-tiniḍ awal uffir n ubleɣ aniri i yellan deg uḥric n unagraw n wammud uffir (tilin n unagraw n wammud uffir ad teqqim d tuffirt).\n\nƔer taggara, deg uḥric n unagraw n wammud i yettazzalen tura, ad tesbeddeḍ anagraw n wammud amaynut, i wumi neqqar anagraw n useɣleḍ, u ad t-twgelhneḍ. Ur ilaq ara ad yegber isefka imḥulfan, u ad yili i win akk ara k-iḥettmen ad d-tiniḍ awal-ik uffir n usesteb uqbel asekkar. S umata, ad ilin kraḍ n wawalen uffiren. Sin seg-sen zemren ad d-ttwannan (n unagraw n useɣleḍ d ubleɣ aniri). Ma tesqedceḍ wis kraḍ, anagraw n wammud uffir ad yekker.
Tifin n yigezmen uffiren

Rǧu mi ara yettnadi VeraCrypt ɣef yigezmen uffiren i izemren ad ilin ɣer taggara n uḍebsi n unagraw. Ẓer belli aya yezmer ad yeṭṭef aṭas n wakud akken ad yemmed.\n\nTamawt: Deg tegnatin drus maḍi, deg kra n yiselkimen, anagraw yezmer ur d-yettarra ara deg ukala-a n tifin. Ma yeḍra waya, ales asekkar n uselkim, sekker VeraCrypt, ales isurifen yezrin, maca zeggel akala-a n tifin. Ẓer belli ugur-a mačči d abug deg VeraCrypt i t-id-yewwin.
Tamnaḍt ara yettwawgelhnen

Fren taxtiṛit-a ma tebɣiḍ ad twgelhneḍ aḍebsi s lekmal-is ideg yettwasbedd unagraw n Windows i yettazzalen tura. Aḍebsi s lekmal-is, ula d akk iḥricen-is, ad yettwawgelhen, ala tafuɣalt tamezwarut anda ara yili umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt. Win akk i yebɣan ad yekcem ɣer unagraw yettwasbedden deg uḍebsi, neɣ ɣer yifuyla i yellan deg uḍebsi, ilaq ad isekcem awal uffir iṣeḥḥan yal tikkelt uqbel ad yekker unagraw. Taxtiṛit-a ur tezmir ara ad tettwasqedec i uwgelhen n uḍebsi wis sin neɣ azɣaray ma Windows ur yettwasbedd ara deg-s u ur yekker ara seg-s.
Alqwaḍ n yisefka igacuranen
Tisura ttwarwent-d

VeraCrypt ur d-yufi ula d yiwen uneqqac CD/DVD yeqqnen ɣer uselkim-ik. VeraCrypt yesra aneqqac CD/DVD akken ad yekles aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt i izemren ad yessekker aselkim, i yegbren anɣel n uḥraz n tsura n uwgelhen, amsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt, amsali aneṣli n unagraw, atg.\n\nAd k-nweṣṣi s waṭas ad teskelseḍ aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt.
Ur sɛiɣ ara aneqqac CD/DVD, maca ad ḥerzeɣ tugna ISO n uḍebsi n usellek deg uḍebsi aziraz (amedya, tasarut USB).
Ad qqneɣ aneqqac CD/DVD ɣer uselkim-iw ticki. Seḥbes akala tura.
Ameklas CD/DVD yeqqen ɣer uselkim-iw tura. Kemmel, aru aḍebsi n usellek.

Ḍfer isurifen-a:

1) Qqen aḍebsi aziraz, am tsarut USB, ɣer uselkim-ik tura.

2) Nɣel afaylu n tugna n uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt (%s) ɣer uḍebsi aziraz.

Ma tesriḍ ad tesqedceḍ aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt ɣer zdat, ad tizmireḍ ad teqqneḍ aḍebsi-ik aziraz (i yegbren tugna n uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt) ɣer uselkim yesɛan aneqqac CD/DVD, u ad d-tesnulfuḍ aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt i izemren ad yessekker aselkim s ukalas n tugna ɣef CD neɣ DVD. D AYEN ILAQEN: Ẓer belli afaylu n tugna n uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt ilaq ad yettwaru ɣef CD/DVD d tugna n uḍebsi ISO (mačči d afaylu iman-is).
Akalas n uḍebsi n usellek
Aḍebsi n usellek yettwasnulfa-d
Asekyed aqbel n uwgelhen n unagraw
Aḍebsi n usellek yettwasenqed

Aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt yettwasenqed akken iwata. Kkes-it tura seg umeɣri, ḥrez-it deg wadeg aɣelsan.

Sit ɣef Uḍfir akken ad tkemmleḍ.

ƔUR-K: Deg yisurifen i d-iteddun, aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt ur ilaq ara ad yili deg umeɣri. Ma ulac, ur yettili ara wamek ara ttwakemmlen yisurifen akken iwata.\n\nKkes-it tura seg umeɣri, ḥrez-it deg wadeg aɣelsan. Syin sit ɣef OK.

Ɣur-k: Ɣef sebba n tlisa titiknikanin n twennaḍt uqbel asekkar, iḍrisen i d-ibeggeḍ VeraCrypt deg twennaḍt uqbel asekkar (uqbel ad yekker Windows) ur zmiren ara ad ttwasuqqlen. Agrudem n useqdac n umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt yella s teglizit s lekmal-is.\n\nAd tkemmleḍ?

Uqbel awgelhen n uḥric neɣ uḍebsi-ik n unagraw, VeraCrypt yesra ad isenqed belli kullec iteddu akken iwata.

Mi ara tsateḍ ɣef Sekyed, akk isger ilaqen (amedya, asger n usesteb uqbel asekkar, d amsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt) ad ttwasbedden, aselkim-ik ad yales asekkar. Syin ilaq ad tesnekcmeḍ awal-ik uffir deg ugdil n umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt ara d-ibanen uqbel ad yekker Windows. Mi ara yekker Windows, ad k-d-yettwammal s wudem awurman ugmuḍ n usekyed-a aqbel.

Ibenk-a ad yettwabeddel: Aḍebsi #%d


Ma tsateḍ ɣef Semmet tura, ulac ara yettwasbedden, u asekyed aqbel ur yettwag ara.

TIMAWIN YESƐAN AZAL -- ƔER NEƔ SIGGEZ (sit ɣef 'Siggez'):

Ẓer belli ula d yiwen ufaylu-ik ur yettwawgelhen ara uqbel ad talseḍ asekkar n uselkim-ik u ad tsekkreḍ Windows akken iwata. Ihi, ma teḍra tuccḍa, isefka-k UR ṛuḥun ARA. Maca, ma yella wayen ur neddi ara, tzemreḍ ad d-temlileḍ uguren deg usekkar n Windows. Ihi, ɣer (u ma yella wamek, siggez) tinaḍin-a ɣef wayen ara tgeḍ ma Windows ur yezmir ara ad yekker deffir uɛiwed n usekkar n uselkim.

Acu ara tgeḍ ma Windows ur yezmir ara ad yekker
------------------------------------------------

Tamawt: Tinaḍin-a d timeɣta kan ma ur tebdiḍ ara awgelhen.

- Ma Windows ur yekker ara mi ara tesnekcmeḍ awal uffir iṣeḥḥan (neɣ ma tesnekcmeḍ awal uffir iṣeḥḥan aṭas n tikkal maca VeraCrypt yeqqar-d belli awal uffir ur iṣeḥḥa ara), ur ttaggad ara. Ales asekkar n uselkim (sens-it, sekker-it), deg ugdil n umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt, sit ɣef teqeffalt Esc deg unasiw-ik (u ma tesɛiḍ aṭas n yinagrawen, fren anwa ara tsekkreḍ). Syin Windows ilaq ad yekker (ma ur yettwawgelhen ara), VeraCrypt ad k-d-yesteqsi s wudem awurman ma tebɣiḍ ad tekkseḍ asger n usesteb uqbel asekkar. Ẓer belli isurifen yezrin UR tteddun ARA ma aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw yettwawgelhen (ulac win izemren ad yessekker Windows neɣ ad yekcem ɣer yisefka yettwawgelhnen deg uḍebsi war awal uffir iṣeḥḥan, ɣas yeḍfer isurifen yezrin).

- Ma isurifen yezrin ur d-fkin ara tifrat neɣ ma agdil n umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt ur d-iban ara (uqbel ad yekker Windows), sekcem aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt deg umeɣri-ik CD/DVD, ales asekkar n uselkim-ik. Ma agdil n uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt ur d-iban ara (neɣ ma ur twalaḍ ara aferdis 'Repair Options' deg uḥric 'Keyboard Controls' n ugdil n uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt), yezmer ad yili BIOS-ik yettwaswel akken ad yeɛreḍ asekkar seg yiḍebsiyen iqquranen uqbel imeɣriyen CD/DVD. Ma akka i yella, ales asekkar n uselkim-ik, sit ɣef F2 neɣ Delete (akken kan ara twaliḍ agdil n usekkar n BIOS), rǧu alamma d-iban ugdil n twila n BIOS. Ma ulac agdil n twila n BIOS i d-ibanen, ales asekkar (wennez) n uselkim tikkelt-nniḍen, bdu asiti ɣef F2 neɣ Delete aṭas n tikkal akken kan ara talseḍ asekkar (ad twennzeḍ) n uselkim. Mi ara d-iban ugdil n twila n BIOS, swel BIOS-ik akken ad yessekker seg umeɣri CD/DVD di tazwara (i telɣut ɣef wamek ara tgeḍ aya, wali tumlin n BIOS/tkarḍa-ik tayemmat neɣ nermes agraw n tallalt tatiknikant n win ik-izzenzen aselkim-ik akken ad k-iɛiwen). Syin ales asekkar n uselkim-ik. Agdil n uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt ilaq ad d-iban tura. Deg ugdil n uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt, fren 'Repair Options' s usiti ɣef F8 deg unasiw-ik. Seg wumuɣ 'Repair Options', fren 'Restore original system loader'. Syin kkes aḍebsi n usellek seg umeɣri-ik CD/DVD, ales asekkar n uselkim-ik. Windows ilaq ad yekker akken tanumi (ma ur yettwawgelhen ara).\n\n

Ẓer belli isurifen yezrin UR tteddun ARA ma aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw yettwawgelhen (ulac win izemren ad yessekker Windows neɣ ad yekcem ɣer yisefka yettwawgelhnen deg uḍebsi war awal uffir iṣeḥḥan, ɣas yeḍfer isurifen yezrin).


Ẓer belli ɣas iṛuḥ-ak uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt u yufa-t ucengu, UR yezmir ARA ad yezmek aḥric neɣ aḍebsi n unagraw war awal uffir iṣeḥḥan.
Asekyed aqbel yemmed

Asekyed aqbel yemmed akken iwata.

ƔUR-K: Ẓer belli ma teqqes trisit s wudem ur netturaǧu ara deg uwgelhen n yisefka yellan deg umḍiq, neɣ ma yeɣli unagraw n wammud s tuccḍa n useɣẓan neɣ s wugur n warrum mi ara yettwag uwgelhen-a s VeraCrypt, kra n yiḥricen n yisefka ad xesren neɣ ad ṛuḥen. Ihi, uqbel ad tebduḍ awgelhen, ḍmen belli tesɛiḍ inɣalen n uḥraz n yifuyla i tebɣiḍ ad twgelhneḍ. Ma ulac, eg inɣalen n uḥraz n yifuyla tura (tzemreḍ ad tsateḍ ɣef Smezger, ad tḥerzeḍ inɣalen n yifuyla, syin ad tsekkreḍ VeraCrypt tikkelt-nniḍen melmi tebɣiḍ, u ad tferneḍ 'Anagraw' > 'Kemmel akala i yeḥebsen' akken ad tebduḍ awgelhen).

Mi ara theggiḍ, sit ɣef Wgelhen akken ad tebduḍ awgelhen.

Tzemreḍ ad tsateḍ ɣef Seḥbes kra neɣ Smezger melmi tebɣiḍ akken ad tesḥebseḍ akala n uwgelhen neɣ n uzmak, ad teffɣeḍ seg umallal-a, ad talseḍ asekkar neɣ ad tessenseḍ aselkim-ik, syin ad tkemmleḍ akala seg umḍiq ideg yeḥbes. Akken ur yettẓẓay ara unagraw mi ara yaru neɣ ad iɣer unagraw neɣ isnasen isefka seg uḍebsi n unagraw, VeraCrypt yettraǧu s wudem awurman alamma ttwarun neɣ ttwaɣran yisefka (wali Addad nnig), syin ikemmel awgelhen neɣ azmak s wudem awurman.

\n\nTzemreḍ ad tsateḍ ɣef Seḥbes kra neɣ Smezger melmi tebɣiḍ akken ad tesḥebseḍ akala n uwgelhen, ad teffɣeḍ seg umallal-a, ad talseḍ asekkar neɣ ad tessenseḍ aselkim-ik, syin ad tkemmleḍ akala seg umḍiq ideg yeḥbes. Ẓer belli ableɣ ur yezmir ara ad yettwaserkeb alamma yettwawgelhen s lekmal-is.

\n\nTzemreḍ ad tsateḍ ɣef Seḥbes kra neɣ Smezger melmi tebɣiḍ akken ad tesḥebseḍ akala n uzmak, ad teffɣeḍ seg umallal-a, ad talseḍ asekkar neɣ ad tessenseḍ aselkim, syin ad tkemmleḍ akala seg umḍiq ideg yeḥbes. Ẓer belli ableɣ ur yezmir ara ad yettwaserkeb alamma yettwazmek s lekmal-is.
Anagraw uffir yekker
Anagraw aneṣli

Windows yesnulfu-d (s umata war ma teẓriḍ neɣ tqebleḍ) ifuyla n uɣmis, ifuyla ikudanen, atg., deg uḥric n unagraw. Iḥerrez daɣen agbur n RAM deg yifuyla n tguni taɣezfant d tissubtert i yellan deg uḥric n unagraw. Ihi, ma acengu yesleḍ ifuyla i yettwaḥerzen deg uḥric ideg yella unagraw aneṣli (i unagraw uffir d anɣel yemṣadan akk yid-s), yezmer ad d-yaf, amedya, belli tesqedceḍ amallal n VeraCrypt deg uskar n usnulfu n unagraw uffir (ayen i izemren ad d-yesken tilin n unagraw n wammud uffir deg uselkim-ik).\n\nAkken ad isḥbes uguren am wigi, VeraCrypt ad yesfeḍ s tɣellist, deg yisurifen i d-iteddun, agbur n uḥric ideg yella unagraw aneṣli s lekmal-is. Syin, akken ad tili tezmert n tnekra n tilin n unagraw uffir s wudem ara yettwamnen, ilaq ad tesbeddeḍ anagraw amaynut deg uḥric u ad t-twgelhneḍ. Akka ad d-tesnulfuḍ anagraw n useɣleḍ, u akala n usnulfu n unagraw n wammud uffir s lekmal-is ad yemmed.

Anagraw n wammud uffir yettwasnulfa-d akken iwata. Maca, uqbel ad tebduḍ aseqdec-is (u ad tili tezmert n tnekra n tilin-is s wudem ara yettwamnen), ilaq ad tesfeḍ s tɣellist (s VeraCrypt) agbur n uḥric ideg yettwasbedd unagraw n wammud i yettazzalen tura s lekmal-is. Uqbel ad tgeḍ aya, ilaq ad talseḍ asekkar n uselkim, u deg ugdil n umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt (i d-yettbanen uqbel ad yekker Windows), ad tesnekcmeḍ awal uffir n usesteb uqbel asekkar n unagraw n wammud uffir. Syin, mi ara yekker unagraw uffir, amallal n VeraCrypt ad yekker s wudem awurman.\n\nTamawt: Ma tferneḍ ad tḥebseḍ akala n usnulfu n unagraw n wammud uffir tura, UR tezmireḍ ARA ad t-tkemmleḍ, u UR tezmireḍ ARA ad tkecmeḍ ɣer unagraw uffir (acku amsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt ad yettwakkes).

Tesɣewseḍ akala n usnulfu n unagraw n wammud uffir. Akala ur yemmid ara yakan. Akken ad t-tfakkeḍ, ilaq ad talseḍ asekkar n uselkim, u deg ugdil n umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt (i d-yettbanen uqbel ad yekker Windows), ad tesnekcmeḍ awal uffir n unagraw n wammud uffir.\n\nTamawt: Ma tferneḍ ad tḥebseḍ akala n usnulfu n unagraw n wammud uffir tura, UR tezmireḍ ARA ad t-tkemmleḍ.
Ales asekkar n uselkim, kemmel
Seḥbes i lebda akala n usnulfu n unagraw n wammud uffir
Ur tteg acemma tura, steqsi tikkelt-nniḍen ticki

MA YELLA WAMEK, SIGGEZ AḌRIS-A (sit ɣef 'Siggez' ddaw).


Amek d melmi ara tesqedceḍ aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt (deffir uwgelhen)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

I. Amek ara tsekkreḍ seg uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt

Akken ad tsekkreḍ seg uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt, sekcem-it deg umeɣri-ik CD/DVD, ales asekkar n uselkim-ik. Ma agdil n uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt ur d-iban ara (neɣ ma ur twalaḍ ara aferdis 'Repair Options' deg uḥric 'Keyboard Controls' n ugdil), yezmer ad yili BIOS-ik yettwaswel akken ad yeɛreḍ asekkar seg yiḍebsiyen iqquranen uqbel imeɣriyen CD/DVD. Ma akka i yella, ales asekkar n uselkim-ik, sit ɣef F2 neɣ Delete (akken kan ara twaliḍ agdil n usekkar n BIOS), rǧu alamma d-iban ugdil n twila n BIOS. Ma ulac agdil n twila n BIOS i d-ibanen, ales asekkar (wennez) n uselkim tikkelt-nniḍen, bdu asiti ɣef F2 neɣ Delete aṭas n tikkal akken kan ara talseḍ asekkar (ad twennzeḍ) n uselkim. Mi ara d-iban ugdil n twila n BIOS, swel BIOS-ik akken ad yessekker seg umeɣri CD/DVD di tazwara (i telɣut ɣef wamek ara tgeḍ aya, wali tumlin n BIOS/tkarḍa-ik tayemmat neɣ nermes agraw n tallalt tatiknikant n win ik-izzenzen aselkim-ik akken ad k-iɛiwen). Syin ales asekkar n uselkim-ik. Agdil n uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt ilaq ad d-iban tura. Tamawt: Deg ugdil n uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt, tzemreḍ ad tferneḍ 'Repair Options' s usiti ɣef F8 deg unasiw-ik.
II. Melmi d wamek ara tesqedceḍ aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt (deffir uwgelhen)\n\n

1) Ma agdil n umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt ur d-iban ara mi ara tsekkreḍ aselkim-ik (neɣ ma Windows ur yekker ara), amsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt yezmer ad yili yexser. Aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt ad k-yeǧǧ ad t-id-terreḍ, ihi ad d-terreḍ anekcum ɣer unagraw-ik d yisefka-k yettwawgelhnen (maca, ẓer belli ilaq mazal ad tesnekcmeḍ awal uffir iṣeḥḥan). Deg ugdil n uḍebsi n usellek, fren 'Repair Options' > 'Restore VeraCrypt Boot Loader'. Syin sit ɣef 'Y' akken ad tsentmeḍ tamhelt, kkes aḍebsi n usellek seg umeɣri CD/DVD, ales asekkar n uselkim-ik.\n\n

2) Ma tesnekcmeḍ awal uffir iṣeḥḥan aṭas n tikkal, maca VeraCrypt yeqqar-d belli awal uffir ur iṣeḥḥa ara, tasarut tagejdayt neɣ isefka nniḍen yesɛan azal ameqqran zemren ad ilin xesren. Aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt ad k-yeǧǧ ad ten-id-terreḍ, ihi ad d-terreḍ anekcum ɣer unagraw-ik d yisefka-k yettwawgelhnen (maca, ẓer belli ilaq mazal ad tesnekcmeḍ awal uffir iṣeḥḥan). Deg ugdil n uḍebsi n usellek, fren 'Repair Options' > 'Restore key data'. Syin sekcem awal-ik uffir, sit ɣef 'Y' akken ad tsentmeḍ tamhelt, kkes aḍebsi n usellek seg umeɣri CD/DVD, ales asekkar n uselkim-ik.\n\n

3) Ma amsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt yexser, tzemreḍ ad tɛeddiḍ i usekker-is s usekker srid seg uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt. Sekcem aḍebsi-ik n usellek deg umeɣri CD/DVD, syin sekcem awal-ik uffir deg ugdil n uḍebsi n usellek.\n\n

4) Ma Windows yexser ur yezmir ara ad yekker, aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt ad k-yeǧǧ ad tezmekḍ aḥric/aḍebsi i lebda uqbel ad yekker Windows. Deg ugdil n uḍebsi n usellek, fren 'Repair Options' > 'Permanently decrypt system partition/drive'. Sekcem awal uffir iṣeḥḥan, rǧu alamma yemmed uzmak. Syin tzemreḍ, amedya, ad tsekkreḍ seg CD/DVD n usebded n MS Windows akken ad tṣeggemeḍ asebded-ik n Windows.\n\n

Tamawt: Neɣ, ma Windows yexser (ur yezmir ara ad yekker) u tesriḍ ad t-tṣeggemeḍ (neɣ ad tkecmeḍ ɣer yifuyla deg-s), tzemreḍ ad tɛeddiḍ i uzmak n uḥric/uḍebsi n unagraw s uḍfar n yisurifen-a: Ma tesɛiḍ aṭas n yinagrawen n wammud yettwasbedden deg uselkim-ik, sekker win ur nesri ara asesteb uqbel asekkar. Ma ur tesɛiḍ ara aṭas n yinagrawen n wammud yettwasbedden deg uselkim-ik, tzemreḍ ad tsekkreḍ seg CD/DVD n WinPE neɣ BartPE, neɣ ad teqqneḍ aḍebsi-ik n unagraw d aḍebsi wis sin neɣ azɣaray ɣer uselkim nniḍen, syin ad tsekkreḍ anagraw n wammud yettwasbedden deg uselkim-nni. Mi ara tsekkreḍ anagraw, sekker VeraCrypt, sit ɣef 'Fren ibenk', fren aḥric n unagraw i yettwaḍurren, sit ɣef 'OK', fren 'Anagraw' > 'Serkeb war asesteb uqbel asekkar', sekcem awal-ik uffir n usesteb uqbel asekkar, sit ɣef 'OK'. Aḥric ad yettwaserkeb d ableɣ amagnu n VeraCrypt (isefka ad ttwazemken/ttwawgelhnen srid deg RAM mi ara yili unekcum, am wakken tanumi).
Ẓer belli ɣas iṛuḥ-ak uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt u yufa-t ucengu, UR yezmir ARA ad yezmek aḥric neɣ aḍebsi n unagraw war awal uffir iṣeḥḥan.

D A Y E N I L A Q E N -- SIGGEZ AḌRIS-A MA YELLA WAMEK (sit ɣef 'Siggez' ddaw).


Tamawt: Aḍris-a ad d-yettwabeggeḍ s wudem awurman yal tikkelt ara tessnekreḍ anagraw uffir alamma tebdiḍ asnulfu n unagraw n useɣleḍ.

Amek ara d-tesnulfuḍ anagraw n useɣleḍ s tɣellist
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Akken ad tizmireḍ ad tnekreḍ tilin n unagraw uffir s wudem ara yettwamnen, ilaq ad d-tesnulfuḍ tura anagraw n wammud n useɣleḍ. I waya, ḍfer imecwaren-a:

1) Ɣef sebba n tɣellist, sens aselkim-ik, teǧǧeḍ-t yensa xerṣum kra n tesdatin (ma yella ugar, ad yif). Ayagi ilaq akken ad tettwasfeḍ tkatut, i yesɛan isefka imḥulfan. Syen, ssiɣ aselkim maca ur ssekkar ara anagraw uffir.\n\n

2) Sbedd Windows ɣef uḥric i yettwasfeḍ ugbur-is (d anamek, ɣef uḥric ideg yella yettwasbedd unagraw aneṣli, iɣef d-yettwanɣel unagraw uffir).

D AYEN ILAQEN: MI ARA TEBDUḌ ASEBDED N UNAGRAW N USEƔLEḌ, *UR* TETTIZMIREḌ ARA AD TESSEKKREḌ ANAGRAW UFFIR (acku amsebdad n unagraw Windows ad yesfeḍ amsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt). AYAGI D AMAGNU, YETTWARǦA. UR TTAGGAD ARA. AD TIZMIREḌ AD TESSEKKREḌ ANAGRAW UFFIR TIKKELT-NNIḌEN AKKEN KAN ARA TEBDUḌ AWGELHEN N UNAGRAW N USEƔLEḌ (acku VeraCrypt ad yesbedd s wudem awurman amsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt ɣef uḍebsi n unagraw).

D ayen ilaqen: Teɣzi n uḥric n unagraw n useɣleḍ ilaq ad teqqim d tin n ubleɣ uffir (tawtilt-a tettwaḥrez tura). Daɣen, ur ilaq ara ad d-tesnulfuḍ ula d yiwen uḥric gar uḥric n unagraw n useɣleḍ d uḥric ideg yella unagraw uffir.

3) Ssekkar anagraw n useɣleḍ (i tesbeddeḍ deg umecwar 2, syen sbedd VeraCrypt deg-s).

Cfu belli anagraw n useɣleḍ ur ilaq ara ad yesɛu ula d yiwen usefku amḥulfu.

4) Deg unagraw n useɣleḍ, senker VeraCrypt, fren 'Anagraw' > 'Wgelhen aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw'. Ilaq ad d-tban tfelwit n umallal n usnulfu n ubleɣ n VeraCrypt.

Imecwaren i d-iteddun ɛnan amallal n usnulfu n ubleɣ n VeraCrypt.
5) Deg umallal n usnulfu n ubleɣ n VeraCrypt, UR FREN ARA taxtiṛt 'Uffir'. Eǧǧ taxtiṛt 'Amagnu' tefran, sit ɣef 'Uḍfir'.\n\n
6) Fren taxtiṛt 'Wgelhen aḥric n unagraw Windows', syen sit ɣef 'Uḍfir'.\n\n

7) Ma yella d anagraw uffir d unagraw n useɣleḍ kan i yettwasbedden deg uselkim, fren taxtiṛt 'Asekkar n yiwen unagraw' (ma llan ugar n sin-a n yinagrawen i yettwasbedden deg uselkim, fren 'Asekkar usgit'). Syen sit ɣef 'Uḍfir'.\n\n

8) D AYEN ILAQEN: Deg umecwar-a, I UNAGRAW N USEƔLEḌ, ILAQ AD TFERNEḌ YIWEN N ULGURITM N UWGELHEN D YIWEN N ULGURITM N UGEDDEḤ AKKEN TFERNEḌ I UNAGRAW UFFIR! MA ULAC, UR TETTIZMIREḌ ARA AD TKECMEḌ ƔER UNAGRAW UFFIR! S wawal-nniḍen, anagraw n useɣleḍ ilaq ad yettwawgelhen s yiwen n ulguritm n uwgelhen akked unagraw uffir. Tamawt: Sebba-s d akken anagraw n useɣleḍ d unagraw uffir ad bḍun yiwen n umsali n usekkar, i yessefraken yiwen n ulguritm kan, i yefren useqdac (i yal alguritm, tella lqem tamaẓlayt n umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt).\n\n

9) Deg umecwar-a, fren awal uffir i unagraw n wammud n useɣleḍ. D awal-a uffir ara tizmireḍ ad temleḍ i ucengu ma yessuter-ik neɣ iḥettem-ik ad teskecfeḍ awal-ik uffir n usesteb uqbel asekkar (awal uffir-nniḍen ara tizmireḍ ad teskecfeḍ d win n ubleɣ aniri). Tilin n wawal uffir wis kraḍ (d anamek, awal uffir n usesteb uqbel asekkar n unagraw n wammud uffir) ad teqqim d tuffirt.

D ayen ilaqen: Awal uffir ara tferneḍ i unagraw n useɣleḍ ilaq ad yemgarrad aṭas ɣef win i tferneḍ i ubleɣ uffir (d anamek, i unagraw n wammud uffir).
10) Ḍfer tinaḍin i d-yeqqimen deg umallal akken ad twgelhneḍ anagraw n wammud n useɣleḍ.

Mi d-yenulfa unagraw n useɣleḍ
------------------------------------------------

Mi ara twgelhneḍ anagraw n useɣleḍ, ad ifak ukala n usnulfu n unagraw n wammud uffir meṛṛa, ad tizmireḍ ad tesqedceḍ kraḍ-a n wawalen uffiren:

1) Awal uffir n usesteb uqbel asekkar n unagraw n wammud uffir.

2) Awal uffir n usesteb uqbel asekkar n unagraw n wammud n useɣleḍ.

3) Awal uffir n ubleɣ aniri.

Ma tebɣiḍ ad tessnekreḍ anagraw n wammud uffir, ilaq kan ad teskecmeḍ awal uffir n unagraw n wammud uffir deg ugdil n umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt (i d-ittban mi ara tessiɣeḍ neɣ talseḍ asenker n uselkim-ik).

Ma tebɣiḍ ad tessnekreḍ anagraw n wammud n useɣleḍ, ilaq kan ad teskecmeḍ awal uffir n unagraw n wammud n useɣleḍ deg ugdil n umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt.

Tzemreḍ ad teskecfeḍ awal uffir n unagraw n useɣleḍ i win ara k-iḥettmen ad teskecfeḍ awal-ik uffir n usesteb uqbel asekkar. Tilin n ubleɣ uffir (akked unagraw n wammud uffir) ad teqqim d tuffirt.

Awal uffir wis kraḍ (n ubleɣ aniri) tzemreḍ ad t-teskecfeḍ i win ara k-iḥettmen ad teskecfeḍ awal uffir n uḥric amezwaru deffir uḥric n unagraw, ideg llan ubleɣ aniri d ubleɣ uffir (i yesɛan anagraw n wammud uffir). Tilin n ubleɣ uffir (akked unagraw n wammud uffir) ad teqqim d tuffirt.

Ma teskecfeḍ awal uffir n unagraw n useɣleḍ i ucengu, u yesteqsa-k acimi tallunt tilellit n uḥric n unagraw (n useɣleḍ) tesɛa isefka igacuranen, tzemreḍ ad terreḍ, amedya: "Aḥric-a yella yesɛa anagraw i yettwawgelhnen s VeraCrypt, maca ttuɣ awal uffir n usesteb uqbel asekkar (neɣ anagraw yexṣer, ur yettsekkir ara), ihi ḥwaǧeɣ ad ɛiwdeɣ asebded n Windows, ad wgelhneɣ aḥric tikkelt-nniḍen."

Ma tettwaḍfer meṛṛa tinaḍin, u ma ttwaḥerzent meṛṛa tɣadfiwin d tfadwin i d-yettwabedren deg uḥric "Security Requirements and Precautions Pertaining to Hidden Volumes" deg umnir n useqdac n VeraCrypt, ilaq ad yili d awezɣi ad yettwasebgen belli ableɣ uffir d unagraw n wammud uffir llan, ula mi yettwaserkeb ubleɣ aniri neɣ mi yettwazmek neɣ yettwasenker unagraw n wammud n useɣleḍ.

Ma teskelseḍ anɣel n uḍris-a neɣ tesgezḍ-t (ayagi yettuwelleh aṭas, ala ma tasaggazt-ik teḥrez inɣalen n yisemliyen i d-tesgiz deg uḍebsi-ines agensan), ilaq ad tesnegriḍ meṛṛa inɣalen-is mi ara d-tesnulfuḍ anagraw n useɣleḍ u mi ara tegzuḍ meṛṛa talɣut i yellan deg uḍris (ma ulac, ma yettwaf unɣel am wa, yezmer ad d-yesken belli yella unagraw n wammud uffir deg uselkim-a).

ƔUR-K: MA UR TEMMESTNEḌ ARA ABLEƔ UFFIR (i telɣut ɣef wamek ara tgeḍ ayagi, ẓer aḥric "Protection of Hidden Volumes Against Damage" deg umnir n useqdac n VeraCrypt), UR TTARU ARA ƔEF UBLEƔ ANIRI (ẓer belli anagraw n wammud n useɣleḍ UR yettwasbedd ARA deg ubleɣ aniri). MA ULAC, TZEMREḌ AD TARUḌ ƔEF UBLEƔ UFFIR, AD T-TESXESREḌ (AKKED UNAGRAW N WAMMUD UFFIR I YELLAN DEG-S)!
Asnulfu n unɣel ummid n unagraw n wammud

Deg yimecwaren i d-iteddun, VeraCrypt ad d-yesnulfu anagraw n wammud uffir s unɣal n ugbur n uḥric n unagraw ɣer ubleɣ uffir (isefka ara yettwanɣalen ad ttwawgelhnen srid s tsarut n uwgelhen yemgaraden ɣef tin ara yettwasqedcen i unagraw n wammud n useɣleḍ).

Ẓer belli akala ad yettwasekker deg twennaḍt uqbel asekkar (uqbel ad yessenker Windows), u yezmer ad yeṭṭef aṭas n wakud akken ad ifak; kra n yisragen neɣ ula d kra n wussan (ilmend n teɣzi n uḥric n unagraw d tmellit n uselkim-ik).

Ad tizmireḍ ad tesḥebseḍ akala, ad tessenseḍ aselkim-ik, ad tessnekreḍ anagraw n wammud, syen ad tkemmleḍ akala. Maca, ma tesḥebseḍ-t, akala n unɣal n unagraw meṛṛa ad iɛiwed seg tazwara (acku agbur n uḥric n unagraw ur ilaq ara ad ibeddel lawan n usnulfu n unɣel ummid).
Tebɣiḍ ad tesemmteḍ akala n usnulfu n unagraw n wammud uffir meṛṛa?\n\nTamawt: UR tettizmireḍ ARA ad tkemmleḍ akala ma tesemmteḍ-t tura.
Tebɣiḍ ad tesemmteḍ asekyed uzwir n uwgelhen n unagraw?

Asekyed uzwir n uwgelhen n unagraw s VeraCrypt ur yeddi ara. Tebɣiḍ ad tɛerḍeḍ tikkelt-nniḍen?

Ma tferneḍ 'Ala', aferdis n usesteb uqbel asekkar ad yettwakkes.

Timawin:

- Ma amsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt ur k-yessuter ara ad teskecmeḍ awal uffir uqbel ad yessenker Windows, yezmer anagraw-ik n wammud ur yettsekkir ara seg uḍebsi ideg yettwasbedd. Ayagi ur yettwasefrak ara.

- Ma tesqedceḍ alguritm n uwgelhen yemgaraden ɣef AES u asekyed uzwir ur yeddi ara (u teskecmeḍ awal uffir), yezmer sebba-s d anuḍaf i yellan d arameɣtu deg ufeṣṣel-is. Fren 'Ala', ɛreḍ ad twgelhneḍ aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw tikkelt-nniḍen, maca seqdec alguritm n uwgelhen AES (i yeḥwaǧen drus n tkatut ugar n wiyaḍ).

- I sebbat d tifrat-nniḍen yezemren ad ilint, ẓer: https://veracrypt.jp/en/Troubleshooting.html
Aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw ur d-ittban ara yettwawgelhen (ama d aḥric kan neɣ s umata).

Aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw-ik yettwawgelhen (d aḥric kan neɣ s umata).\n\nZmek aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw-ik meṛṛa uqbel ad tkemmleḍ. I waya, fren 'Anagraw' > 'Zmek aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw i lebda' seg ufeggag n wumuɣen n tfelwit tagejdayt n VeraCrypt.

Mi ara yili uḥric/uḍebsi n unagraw yettwawgelhen (d aḥric kan neɣ s umata), ur tettizmireḍ ara ad tuɣaleḍ ɣer lqem taqburt n VeraCrypt (maca tzemreḍ ad t-tmucceḍeḍ neɣ ad talseḍ asebded n yiwet n lqem).
Aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw-ik la yettwawgelhen, la yettwazmek, neɣ la yettwabeddel s wudem-nniḍen. Seḥbes akala n uwgelhen/uzmak/ubeddel (neɣ rǧu alamma ifuk) uqbel ad tkemmleḍ.

Tummant n umallal n usnulfu n ubleɣ n VeraCrypt la tetteddu deg unagraw-a, la tessekker neɣ la theggi awgelhen/azmak n uḥric/uḍebsi n unagraw. Uqbel ad tkemmleḍ, rǧu alamma tfuk neɣ mdel-itt. Ma ur tezmireḍ ara ad tt-temdleḍ, ales asenker n uselkim-ik uqbel ad tkemmleḍ.
Akala n uwgelhen neɣ uzmak n uḥric/uḍebsi n unagraw ur ifuk ara. Rǧu alamma ifuk uqbel ad tkemmleḍ.
Tuccḍa: Akala n uwgelhen n uḥric/uḍebsi ur ifuk ara. Ilaq ad ifak d amezwaru.

Tuccḍa: Akala n uwgelhen neɣ uzmak n uḥric/ubleɣ ur ifuk ara. Ilaq ad ifak d amezwaru.\n\nTamawt: Akken ad tkemmleḍ akala, fren 'Iblaɣen' > 'Kemmel akala i yeḥebsen' seg ufeggag n wumuɣen n tfelwit tagejdayt n VeraCrypt.

Awal uffir d ameɣtu, VeraCrypt yezmek tasenṭit n ubleɣ s rrbeḥ, yufa-d belli ableɣ-a d ableɣ n unagraw uffir. Maca, ur tettizmireḍ ara ad tbeddleḍ tasenṭit n ubleɣ n unagraw uffir s wudem-a.

Akken ad tbeddleḍ awal uffir n ubleɣ n unagraw uffir, ssekkar anagraw n wammud i yellan deg ubleɣ uffir, syen fren 'Anagraw' > 'Beddel awal uffir' seg ufeggag n wumuɣen n tfelwit tagejdayt n VeraCrypt.

Akken ad tesbaduḍ alguritm n usuddim n tsarut n tsenṭit, ssekkar anagraw n wammud uffir, syen fren 'Anagraw' > 'Sbadu alguritm n usuddim n tsarut n tsenṭit'.

VeraCrypt ur yessefrak ara azmak deg umḍiq n uḥric n unagraw uffir.\n\nTamawt: Ma tebɣiḍ ad tzemkeḍ aḥric n unagraw n useɣleḍ, ssekkar anagraw n useɣleḍ, syen fren 'Anagraw' > 'Zmek aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw i lebda' seg ufeggag n wumuɣen n tfelwit tagejdayt n VeraCrypt.
Tuccḍa: Aɣewwar ur iṣeḥḥan ara/urameɣtu.
Tferneḍ aḥric neɣ ibenk, maca askar n umallal i tferneḍ iwulem kan i yifuyla n uḥraz n yisefka.\n\nTebɣiḍ ad tbeddleḍ askar n umallal?
Tebɣiḍ ad d-tesnulfuḍ afaylu n uḥraz n yisefka n VeraCrypt deg umḍiq-is?

Tferneḍ aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw (neɣ aḥric n usekkar), maca askar n umallal i tferneḍ iwulem kan i yiḥricen/iḍebsiyen ur nelli ara n unagraw.\n\nTebɣiḍ ad tesɣewreḍ asesteb uqbel asekkar (d anamek, ad tesɛuḍ ad teskecmeḍ awal-ik uffir yal tikkelt uqbel ad isekker/yessenker Windows), ad twgelhneḍ aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw?
Tebɣiḍ s tidet ad tzemkeḍ aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw i lebda?
ƔUR-K: Ma tzemkeḍ aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw i lebda, isefka ur newgilhen ara ad ttwarun ɣef-s.\n\nTebɣiḍ s tidet ad tzemkeḍ aḥric/aḍebsi n unagraw i lebda?
Tebɣiḍ s tidet ad tzemkeḍ ableɣ-a i lebda?
ƔUR-K: Ma tzemkeḍ ableɣ n VeraCrypt i lebda, isefka ur newgilhen ara ad ttwarun ɣef uḍebsi.\n\nTebɣiḍ s tidet ad tzemkeḍ ableɣ i yettwafernen i lebda?

Ɣur-k: Ma tesqedceḍ aẓrar n yilguritmen n uwgelhen i uwgelhen n unagraw, tzemreḍ ad d-temmagreḍ uguren-a:

1) Amsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt ad yili meqqer ugar n umagnu, ihi ur tettɣimi ara tallunt ilaqen deg tfuɣalt tamezwarut n uḍebsi i unɣel n uḥraz n umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt. Ɣef waya, yal tikkelt ara yexser (ayen i d-yeḍerrun aṭas, amedya, deg tarrayin n usentem mgal takerḍa n kra n wahilen i yettwafeṣṣlen s wudem ur nelli d ameɣtu), ad tesɛuḍ ad tesqedceḍ aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt akken ad tessekkreḍ neɣ ad tseggeḍ amsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt.

2) Deg kra n yiselkimen, tuɣalin seg tguni taɣezfant tetteṭṭef ugar n wakud.

Tzemreḍ ad tmenɛeḍ uguren-a yezemren ad d-ḍrun s ufran n ulguritm n uwgelhen ur nelli ara d aẓrar (amedya AES).

Tebɣiḍ s tidet ad tesqedceḍ aẓrar n yilguritmen n uwgelhen?
Ma temmugreḍ-d yiwen seg wuguren i d-yettwabedren yakan, zmek aḥric/aḍebsi (ma yettwawgelhen), syen ɛreḍ ad t-twgelhneḍ tikkelt-nniḍen s ulguritm n uwgelhen ur nelli ara d aẓrar (amedya AES).

ƔUR-K: Ɣef sebba n tɣellist, ilaq ad tmucceḍeḍ VeraCrypt deg unagraw n wammud n useɣleḍ uqbel ad t-tmucceḍeḍ deg unagraw n wammud uffir.

I waya, ssekkar anagraw n useɣleḍ, senker amsebdad n VeraCrypt seg daxel-is. Syen ssekkar anagraw uffir, senker daɣen amsebdad seg daxel-is.

Tamawt: Anagraw n useɣleḍ d unagraw uffir bḍan yiwen n umsali n usekkar. Ma tmucceḍeḍ VeraCrypt deg unagraw uffir kan (maca ala deg unagraw n useɣleḍ), anagraw n useɣleḍ ad yesɛu anuḍaf n VeraCrypt d yisnasen n VeraCrypt iɣef imḍanen n lqem mgarraden ɣef umḍan n lqem n umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt. Amgired am wa yezmer ad d-yesken belli yella unagraw n wammud uffir deg uselkim-a.


Tebɣiḍ ad tkemmleḍ?

Amḍan n lqem n umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt i yessekkren anagraw-a n wammud yemgarrad ɣef umḍan n lqem n unuḍaf n VeraCrypt (akked yisnasen n VeraCrypt) i yettwasbedden deg unagraw-a.\n\nIlaq ad tessnekreḍ amsebdad n VeraCrypt (i yesɛan yiwen n umḍan n lqem akked umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt) akken ad tmucceḍeḍ VeraCrypt deg unagraw-a n wammud.

Amḍan n lqem n umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt i yessekkren anagraw-a n wammud yemgarrad ɣef umḍan n lqem n unuḍaf n VeraCrypt (akked yisnasen n VeraCrypt) i yettwasbedden deg unagraw-a. Ẓer belli ileqman iqburen zemren ad sɛun ibugen i yettwaseɣtan deg yileqman i d-ḍefren.

Ma ur tessekkreḍ ara seg uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt, ilaq ad talseḍ asebded n VeraCrypt neɣ ad t-tmucceḍeḍ ɣer lqem turkidt taneggarut (amsali n usekkar ad yettwamucceḍ daɣen).

Ma tessekkreḍ seg uḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt, ilaq ad t-tmucceḍeḍ ('Anagraw' > 'Snulfu-d aḍebsi n usellek').

Amsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt yettwamucceḍ.\n\nYettuwelleh aṭas ad d-tesnulfuḍ aḍebsi amaynut n usellek n VeraCrypt (ara yesɛun lqem tamaynut n umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt) s ufran n 'Anagraw' > 'Snulfu-d aḍebsi n usellek' mi ara talseḍ asenker n uselkim-ik.

Amsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt yettwamucceḍ.\n\nYettuwelleh aṭas ad tessekkreḍ anagraw n wammud n useɣleḍ, syen ad d-tesnulfuḍ aḍebsi amaynut n usellek n VeraCrypt (ara yesɛun lqem tamaynut n umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt) s ufran n 'Anagraw' > 'Snulfu-d aḍebsi n usellek'.
Amucceḍ n umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt ur yeddi ara.

VeraCrypt ur yezmir ara ad d-yaf teɣzi n tidet n uḍebsi n unagraw, ihi ad yettwaseqdec wayen i d-yenna unagraw n wammud ɣef teɣzi (i izemren ad tili meẓẓiyet ɣef teɣzi n tidet). Ẓer daɣen belli ayagi mačči d abug deg VeraCrypt.

ƔUR-K: Ittban-d belli VeraCrypt yeɛreḍ yakan ad d-yaf igzumen uffiren deg uḍebsi-a n unagraw. Ma temmugreḍ-d uguren deg ukala yezrin n tifin, tzemreḍ ad ten-tmenɛeḍ s uneggez n tifin n yigzumen uffiren tura. Ẓer belli ma tgeḍ ayagi, VeraCrypt ad yesseqdec teɣzi i d-yenna unagraw n wammud (i izemren ad tili meẓẓiyet ɣef teɣzi n tidet n uḍebsi).\n\nẒer belli ugur-a ur d-yekki ara seg ubug deg VeraCrypt.
Neggez tifin n yigzumen uffiren (seqdec teɣzi i d-yenna unagraw n wammud)
Ɛreḍ ad d-tafeḍ igzumen uffiren tikkelt-nniḍen

Tuccḍa: Agbur n yiwen neɣ ugar n yigzumen deg uḍebsi ur yezmir ara ad yettwaɣer (ahat seg lexṣara deg warrum).

Akala n uwgelhen deg umḍiq yezmer ad ikemmel kan mi ara uɣalen yigzumen zemren ad ttwaɣren. VeraCrypt yezmer ad yeɛreḍ ad ten-yerr zemren ad ttwaɣren s tira n yizeruyen ɣef yigzumen (syen, iḥedran-a i yesɛan kan izeruyen ad ttwawgelhnen). Maca, ẓer belli meṛṛa isefka i yettwaḥerzen deg yigzumen ur nezmir ara ad ttwaɣren ad ṛuḥen. Ma tebɣiḍ ad temnɛeḍ ayagi, tzemreḍ ad tɛerḍeḍ ad d-terreḍ iḥricen n yisefka ixesren s yifecka iwulmen n wiyaḍ.

Tamawt: Ma yella lexṣara deg warrum n yigzumen (mačči kan d lexṣara n yisefka d tuccḍiwin n tmernit n usenqed), tuget n wanawen n yibenkan n uḥraz ttaḥeṛṛin igzumen-nniḍen deg daxel mi ara ttwaɛraḍen yisefka ad ttwarun ɣef-sen (ihi isefka yellan deg yigzumen ixesren zemren ad qqimen ur wgilhen ara deg uḍebsi).

Tebɣiḍ VeraCrypt ad yaru izeruyen ɣef yigzumen ur nezmir ara ad ttwaɣren?

Tuccḍa: Agbur n yiwen neɣ ugar n yigzumen deg uḍebsi ur yezmir ara ad yettwaɣer (ahat seg lexṣara deg warrum).

Akken ad ikemmel azmak, VeraCrypt ad yesɛu ad yenger agbur n yigzumen ur nezmir ara ad ttwaɣren (agbur ad yettwasemselsi s yisefka i yettemcabin ɣer yisefka igacuranen). Ẓer belli, uqbel ad tkemmleḍ, tzemreḍ ad tɛerḍeḍ ad d-terreḍ iḥricen n yisefka ixesren s yifecka iwulmen n wiyaḍ.

Tebɣiḍ VeraCrypt ad yenger tura isefka deg yigzumen ur nezmir ara ad ttwaɣren?
Tamawt: VeraCrypt isemselsi agbur n %I64d n yigzumen ur nezmir ara ad ttwaɣren (%s) s yiḥedran n uḍris aḥerfi i yesɛan kan izeruyen, i yettwawgelhnen.
Tamawt: VeraCrypt isemselsi agbur n %I64d n yigzumen ur nezmir ara ad ttwaɣren (%s) s yisefka i yettemcabin ɣer yisefka igacuranen.
Sekcem awal uffir/PIN n tiddest '%s':

Akken ad tsirgeḍ i VeraCrypt ad yekcem ɣer tiddest n tɣellist neɣ takarḍa s uceṛṛun, ilaq ad tesbeddeḍ d amezwaru tamkarḍit n useɣẓan PKCS #11 n tiddest neɣ n tkarḍa s uceṛṛun. Tamkarḍit am ta tezmer ad d-tettunefk akked yibenk neɣ ad tili i usider deg usmel n umzenzi neɣ n wiyaḍ.\n\nMi ara tesbeddeḍ tamkarḍit, tzemreḍ ad tt-tferneḍ s ufus s usiti ɣef 'Fren tamkarḍit', neɣ ad teǧǧeḍ VeraCrypt ad tt-id-yaf, ad tt-yefren s wudem awurman s usiti ɣef 'Af tamkarḍit s wudem awurman' (anadi ad yili deg ukaram n unagraw Windows kan).

Tamawt: I yisem d wadeg n ufaylu n temkarḍit PKCS #11 i yettwasbedden i tiddest-ik n tɣellist neɣ i tkarḍa-k s uceṛṛun, ẓer tumlin i d-yettunefken akked tiddest, takarḍa neɣ aseɣẓan n wiyaḍ.\n\nSit ɣef 'IH' akken ad tferneḍ abrid d yisem n ufaylu.

Akken ad tsirgeḍ i VeraCrypt ad yekcem ɣer tiddest n tɣellist neɣ takarḍa s uceṛṛun, ilaq ad tferneḍ d amezwaru tamkarḍit n useɣẓan PKCS #11 n tiddest/tkarḍa. I waya, fren 'Iɣewwaren' > 'Tiddas n tɣellist'.

Awennez n temkarḍit PKCS #11 n tiddest n tɣellist ur yeddi ara.\n\nḌmen belli abrid d yisem n ufaylu i d-yettunefken mmalen-d tamkarḍit PKCS #11 tameɣtut. Akken ad d-tmelleḍ abrid d yisem n ufaylu n temkarḍit PKCS #11, fren 'Iɣewwaren' > 'Tiddas n tɣellist'.

Ulac tamkarḍit PKCS #11 i d-yettwafen deg ukaram n unagraw Windows.\n\nḌmen belli tamkarḍit PKCS #11 n tiddest-ik n tɣellist (neɣ n tkarḍa-k s uceṛṛun) tettwasbedd (tamkarḍit am ta tezmer ad d-tettunefk akked tiddest/tkarḍa neɣ ad tili i usider deg usmel n umzenzi neɣ n wiyaḍ). Ma tettwasbedd deg ukaram yemgaraden ɣef ukaram n unagraw Windows, sit ɣef 'Fren tamkarḍit' akken ad d-tafeḍ tamkarḍit (amedya deg ukaram ideg yettwasbedd useɣẓan n tiddest/tkarḍa).
Ulac tiddest n tɣellist i d-yettwafen.\n\nḌmen belli tiddest-ik n tɣellist teqqen ɣer uselkim-ik u anuḍaf ameɣtu n yibenk n tiddest-ik yettwasbedd.
Afaylu n tsarut n tiddest n tɣellist ur d-yettwaf ara.
Afaylu n tsarut n tiddest n tɣellist s yiwen n yisem yella yakan.
Tebɣiḍ ad tekkseḍ ifuyla i yettwafernen?
Abrid n ufaylu n tsarut n tiddest n tɣellist d urameɣtu.
Tuccḍa n tiddest n tɣellist
Awal uffir n tiddest n tɣellist ur iṣeḥḥa ara.

Tiddest n tɣellist ur tesɛi ara takatut/tallunt ilaqen akken ad tessekker tamhelt i yettwasutren.\n\nMa la tɛerḍeḍ ad d-tketreḍ afaylu n tsarut, ilaq ad tferneḍ afaylu meẓẓiyen neɣ ad tesqedceḍ afaylu n tsarut i d-yesrew VeraCrypt (fren 'Ifecka' > 'Asaraw n yifuyla n tsura').
Meṛṛa tiɣimitin yeldin n tiddest n tɣellist ttwamedlent.
Fren ifuyla n tsura n tiddest n tɣellist

D AYEN ILAQEN: Ẓer belli awalen uffiren n usesteb uqbel asekkar ttwarun yal tikkelt s tneɣruft tamagnut US n unasiw. Ɣef waya, ableɣ i yesseqdacen awal uffir i yettwarun s tneɣruft-nniḍen n unasiw yezmer ad yili d awezɣi ad yettwaserkeb s wawal uffir n usesteb uqbel asekkar (ẓer belli ayagi mačči d abug deg VeraCrypt). Akken ad tsirgeḍ aserkeb n ubleɣ am wa s wawal uffir n usesteb uqbel asekkar, ḍfer imecwaren-a:

1) Sit ɣef 'Fren afaylu' neɣ 'Fren ibenk', fren ableɣ.
2) Fren 'Iblaɣen' > 'Beddel awal uffir n ubleɣ'.
3) Sekcem awal uffir amiran n ubleɣ.
4) Beddel taneɣruft n unasiw ɣer Teglizit (US) s usiti ɣef tignit n ufeggag n tutlayt deg ufeggag n twuriwin n Windows, syen fren 'EN English (United States)'.
5) Deg VeraCrypt, deg wurti n wawal uffir amaynut, aru awal uffir n usesteb uqbel asekkar.
6) Sentem awal uffir amaynut s wallus n tira-s deg wurti n usentem, sit ɣef 'IH'.
ƔUR-K: Cfu belli ma tḍefreḍ imecwaren-a, awal uffir n ubleɣ ilaq ad yettwaru yal tikkelt s tneɣruft US n unasiw (ayen i yettwaḍemnen s wudem awurman deg twennaḍt uqbel asekkar kan).
Iblaɣen inurifen n unagraw ad ttwaserkben s wawal uffir n usesteb uqbel asekkar. Ma yiwen n ubleɣ anurif n unagraw yesseqdac awal uffir yemgaraden, ur yettwaserkab ara.

Ẓer belli ma teḥwaǧeḍ ad tmenɛeḍ tigawin timagnutin n yiblaɣen n VeraCrypt (am 'Kkes aserkeb n meṛṛa', tukksa tawurmant n userkeb, atg.) ad ḥazent iblaɣen inurifen n unagraw, ilaq ad tremdeḍ taxtiṛt 'Sireg i yinedbalen kan ad walin u ad kksen aserkeb n yiblaɣen inurifen n unagraw deg VeraCrypt'. Daɣen, mi ara yettwasenker VeraCrypt war tiseglutin n unedbal (d ayagi i yellan s wudem amezwer deg Windows Vista d yileqman i d-ḍefren), iblaɣen inurifen n unagraw ur d-ttwabeggaḍen ara deg tebdart n yisekkilen n yimeɣriyen deg tfelwit tagejdayt n usnas VeraCrypt.

D AYEN ILAQEN: Cfu belli ma taxtiṛt-a termed u VeraCrypt ur yesɛi ara tiseglutin n unedbal, iblaɣen inurifen n unagraw i yettwaserkben UR d-ttwabeggaḍen ARA deg tfelwit n usnas VeraCrypt u ur tettizmireḍ ara ad tekkseḍ aserkeb-nsen. Ɣef waya, ma teḥwaǧeḍ amedya ad tekkseḍ aserkeb n ubleɣ anurif n unagraw, sit d amezwaru s teqeffalt tayefust ɣef tignit n VeraCrypt (deg wumuɣ Start), fren 'Run as administrator'. Talast-a teɛna daɣen tawuri 'Kkes aserkeb n meṛṛa', tiwuriwin 'Tukksa tawurmant n userkeb', inegzumen s unasiw 'Kkes aserkeb n meṛṛa', atg.
Ẓer belli aɣewwar-a ad yeddu kan mi ara yettwales usenker n unagraw n wammud.
Tuccḍa deg tesleṭ n tseddast n yizirig n unezḍay.

Serkeb iblaɣen inurifen n unagraw mi ara yessenker Windows (deg tazwara n tarrayt n usenker)

Ɣur-k: Anagraw n yifuyla deg ubleɣ i yettwaserkben am '%s' ur yettwakkes ara userkeb-is akken iwata, ihi yezmer ad yesɛu tuccḍiwin. Aseqdec n unagraw n yifuyla ixesren yezmer ad d-yeglu s ruḥan neɣ s lexṣara n yisefka.

Tamawt: Uqbel ad tekkseḍ s ufus neɣ ad tessenseḍ ibenk (am tsarut USB neɣ aḍebsi aqquran azɣaray) ideg yella ubleɣ n VeraCrypt yettwaserkben, ilaq yal tikkelt ad tekkseḍ d amezwaru aserkeb n ubleɣ n VeraCrypt deg VeraCrypt.


Tebɣiḍ Windows ad yeɛreḍ ad d-yaf u ad iseggem tuccḍiwin (ma llant) deg unagraw n yifuyla?

Ɣur-k: Yiwen neɣ ugar n yiblaɣen inurifen n unagraw ur yettwakkes ara userkeb-nsen akken iwata, ihi zemren ad sɛun tuccḍiwin deg unagraw n yifuyla. Ɣer aɣmis n yineḍruyen n unagraw i wugar n telqayt.\n\nAseqdec n unagraw n yifuyla ixesren yezmer ad d-yeglu s ruḥan neɣ s lexṣara n yisefka. Ilaq ad tesneqdeḍ iblaɣen inurifen n unagraw i yeḥuza wugur akken ad d-tafeḍ tuccḍiwin (sit s teqeffalt tayefust ɣef yal yiwen deg-sen deg VeraCrypt, fren 'Seggem anagraw n yifuyla').

Ɣur-k: Aseggem n unagraw n yifuyla ixesren s ufecku 'chkdsk' n Microsoft yezmer ad d-yeglu s ruḥan n yifuyla deg temnaḍin ixesren. Ɣef waya, yettuwelleh ad tgeḍ d amezwaru anɣel n uḥraz n yifuyla yellan deg ubleɣ n VeraCrypt ɣer ubleɣ-nniḍen n VeraCrypt iṣeḥḥan.\n\nTebɣiḍ ad tseggeḍ anagraw n yifuyla tura?

Ableɣ '%s' yettwaserkeb i tɣuri kan acku anekcum i tira yettwagi.

Ḍmen belli tisirag n tɣellist n ufaylu n uḥraz sirigent-ak ad taruḍ deg-s (sit s teqeffalt tayefust ɣef ufaylu n uḥraz, fren Properties > Security).

Ẓer belli, seg wugur deg Windows, tzemreḍ ad twaliḍ alɣu-a ula mi tesɣewreḍ tisirag n tɣellist iwulmen. Ayagi ur d-yekki ara seg ubug deg VeraCrypt. Tifrat yezemren ad tili d asenkez n ufaylu-ik n uḥraz ɣer ukaram-ik 'Documents', amedya.

Ma tebɣiḍ ad yeqqim ubleɣ-ik i tɣuri kan, sbadu amyerr n tɣuri kan n ufaylu n uḥraz (sit s teqeffalt tayefust ɣef ufaylu n uḥraz, fren Properties > Read-only), ayen ara yekksen alɣu-a.
Ableɣ '%s' yeḥwaǧ ad yettwaserkeb i tɣuri kan acku anekcum i tira yettwagi.\n\nḌmen belli ulac asnas-nniḍen (amedya aseɣẓan mgal ivirusen) i ikecmen ɣer uḥric/yibenk ideg yella ubleɣ.

Ableɣ '%s' yettwaserkeb i tɣuri kan acku anagraw n wammud yelɣa-d belli ibenk ideg yella ubleɣ yettwamesten mgal tira.\n\nẒer belli yettwalɣa-d ɣef kra n yinuḍaf imaẓlayen n ugraw n yiceṛṛunen (chipset) belli ttaǧǧan imidya i izemren ad ttwarun ad d-banen s tuccḍa ttwamestnen mgal tira. Ugur-a ur d-yekki ara seg VeraCrypt. Yezmer ad yettwaseggem s umucceḍ neɣ s tukksa n yinuḍaf imaẓlayen n ugraw n yiceṛṛunen (ur nelli ara n Microsoft) i yettwasbedden tura deg unagraw-a.

Ẓer belli tatiknulujit Hyper-Threading tettak-d aṭas n yiɣsan imeẓẓulen i yal yiwen n yiɣes arruman. Mi ara yermed Hyper Threading, amḍan i yettwafernen sufella yemmal-d amḍan n yisekkaren/yiɣsan imeẓẓulen.
%d n yikalan ifessasen

Ẓer belli AES i yettwasɣewlen s warrum yensa, ayen ara iḥazen igmaḍ n uskazal n tmellit (timellit ad tenqes).\n\nAkken ad tremdeḍ asɣiwel s warrum, fren 'Iɣewwaren' > 'Tawila n tmellit/unuḍaf', rmed taxtiṛt iwulmen.

Ẓer belli amḍan n yikalan ifessasen yesɛa talast tura, ayen ara iḥazen igmaḍ n uskazal n tmellit (timellit ad tenqes).\n\nAkken ad tesqedceḍ akk tazmert n yisekkaren, fren 'Iɣewwaren' > 'Tawila n tmellit/unuḍaf', sens taxtiṛt iwulmen.
Tebɣiḍ VeraCrypt ad yeɛreḍ ad issens amesten mgal tira n uḥric/uḍebsi?
ƔUR-K: Aɣewwar-a yezmer ad issenqes timellit.\n\nTebɣiḍ s tidet ad tesqedceḍ aɣewwar-a?
Ɣur-k: Aserkeb n ubleɣ n VeraCrypt yettwakkes s wudem awurman

Uqbel ad tekkseḍ s ufus neɣ ad tessenseḍ ibenk i yesɛan ableɣ yettwaserkben, ilaq yal tikkelt ad tekkseḍ d amezwaru aserkeb n ubleɣ deg VeraCrypt.\n\nTukksa n userkeb iman-is, ur nettwarǧi ara, tettas-d s umata seg ugatu, aḍebsi (tanaka-s), atg., i ixesren tikwal.
Ableɣ-a yettwasnulfa-d s TrueCrypt %x.%x maca VeraCrypt yessefrak kan iblaɣen n TrueCrypt i d-yettwasnulfan s yileqman TrueCrypt 6.x/7.x

Uqbel ad tizmireḍ ad twgelhneḍ aḥric, ilaq ad d-tesnulfuḍ aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt (VRD), i yesɛan iswan-a:

- Ma yexser umsali n usekkar n VeraCrypt, tasarut tagejdayt neɣ isefka-nniḍen ilaqen aṭas, VRD ad k-yesireg ad ten-id-terreḍ (maca ẓer belli ad tesɛuḍ mazal ad teskecmeḍ awal uffir iṣeḥḥan).

- Ma yexser Windows ur yezmir ara ad yessenker, VRD ad k-yesireg ad tzemkeḍ aḥric i lebda uqbel ad yessenker Windows.

- VRD ad yesɛu anɣel n uḥraz n umsali amiran n usekkar EFI, ad k-yesireg ad t-id-terreḍ ma ilaq.

D AYEN ILAQEN: Ẓer belli afaylu zip ilaq ad yettwassef srid ɣer uẓar n tsarut USB. Amedya, ma asekkil n umeɣri n tsarut USB d E:, tussfa n ufaylu zip ilaq ad d-tesnulfu akaram E:\\EFI deg tsarut USB.\n\n

Ur yezmir ara ad isenqed belli aḍebsi n usellek yettwassef akken iwata.

Ma tessfeḍ aḍebsi n usellek, ssufeɣ tasarut USB, ales asekcem-is; syen sit ɣef Uḍfir akken ad tɛerḍeḍ tikkelt-nniḍen. Ma ayagi ur yefri ara ugur, ɛreḍ tasarut USB-nniḍen akked/neɣ aseɣẓan ZIP-nniḍen.

Ma ur tessifeḍ ara yakan aḍebsi n usellek, eg ayagi, syen sit ɣef Uḍfir.

Ma tɛerḍeḍ ad tesneqdeḍ aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt i d-yettwasnulfan uqbel ad tessnekreḍ amallal-a, ẓer belli aḍebsi am wa n usellek ur yezmir ara ad yettwaseqdec, acku yettwasnulfa-d i tsarut tagejdayt yemgaraden. Ilaq ad tessfeḍ tugna ZIP n uḍebsi n usellek i d-yettusirwen tura.

Ur yezmir ara ad isenqed belli aḍebsi n usellek yettwassef akken iwata.

Ma tessfeḍ tugna n uḍebsi n usellek ɣer tsarut USB, ssufeɣ-itt, ales asekcem-is; syen ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen. Ma ayagi ur yefri ara ugur, ɛreḍ aseɣẓan ZIP-nniḍen akked/neɣ amidya-nniḍen.

Ma tɛerḍeḍ ad tesneqdeḍ aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt i d-yettwasnulfan i tsarut tagejdayt, awal uffir, tissent, atg., yemgaraden, ẓer belli aḍebsi am wa n usellek ur yezmir ara ad iɛeddi asenqed-a. PIM (aseggat udmawan n wallusen) isenqad aseqdec n tkatut d wakud n usuddim n tsarut n tsenṭit s Argon2id akka:
 Takatut = min(64 MiB + ((PIM - 1) x 32 MiB), 1024 MiB)
 Allusen = 3 + ((PIM - 1) / 3) i PIM 31 neɣ ddaw, syen 13 + (PIM - 31)

Ma yeqqim d ilem neɣ yettusbadu ɣer 0, VeraCrypt ad yesseqdec PIM amezwer n Argon2 (12), i yesseqdacen 416 MiB n tkatut d 6 n wallusen.

Ma awal uffir yesɛa ddaw n 20 n yisekkilen, PIM n Argon2 ur yezmir ara ad yili ddaw n 12 akken ad yeḥrez aswir adday n tɣellist.
Ma awal uffir yesɛa 20 n yisekkilen neɣ ugar, PIM n Argon2 yezmer ad yettusbadu ɣer yal azal.

PIM n Argon2 yugaren 12 yessennerni aseqdec n tkatut alamma d 1024 MiB, syen yessennerni allusen. Ayagi ad yerr aserkeb ẓẓay ugar. PIM n Argon2 ameẓẓyan (ddaw n 12) ad yerr aserkeb arurad ugar, maca yezmer ad issenqes taɣellist ma awal uffir ur yeǧhid ara akken ilaq.
Tferneḍ azal PIM n Argon2 yugaren azal amezwer n VeraCrypt.\nẒer belli ayagi yezmer ad yeḥwaǧ ugar n tkatut u ad yerr aserkeb ẓẓay aṭas ugar.

Tferneḍ azal PIM n Argon2 yellan ddaw n wazal amezwer n VeraCrypt. Ẓer belli ma awal-ik uffir ur yeǧhid ara akken ilaq, ayagi yezmer ad issenqes taɣellist.\n\nTesentameḍ belli tseqdaceḍ awal uffir iǧehden?
Awal uffir ilaq ad yesɛu 20 n yisekkilen neɣ ugar akken ad tesqedceḍ PIM n Argon2 i d-yettunefken.\nAwalen uffiren iwezlan ugar zemren ad ttwasqedcen kan ma PIM n Argon2 d 12 neɣ ugar.
Serkeb iblaɣen NTFS s unuḍaf deg yiɣes Linux

I Linux kan. Mi ara termed textiṛt-a u ma ulac anaw n unagraw n yifuyla i d-yettunefken s wudem usrid, VeraCrypt isenqad ibenk uhlis yettwazemken s blkid -p, iserkeb inagrawen n yifuyla NTFS i d-yufa s unuḍaf NTFS yellan deg yiɣes, war allalen n userkeb am ntfs-3g. VeraCrypt yesseqdac ntfs mi ara yettwasen s tidet d anuḍaf amaynut n tɣuri/tira, neɣ mi ara yettwarǧu deg Linux 7.1 neɣ tin i d-ḍefren; ma ulac, yesseqdac ntfs3. Ma tifin n NTFS ur teddi ara, VeraCrypt yesseqdac afran awurman amagnu n unagraw n yifuyla. Ma ulac anuḍaf NTFS deg yiɣes yettwasefraken i yewjden neɣ i izemren ad yettwasali, aserkeb ur yetteddu ara. Taxtiṛt-a, i ilaq ad tt-yermed useqdac, tezmer ad tmenɛ aḥbas lawan n usewḥel neɣ n tguni taɣezfant i d-yettasen seg yinagrawen n yifuyla FUSE yeḥebsen deg tallunt n useqdac.

Ulac anuḍaf NTFS deg yiɣes yettwasefraken i yewjden neɣ i izemren ad yettwasali. Akken ad tesqedceḍ allal amezwer n unagraw i NTFS, sens asmenyif n unuḍaf NTFS n yiɣes neɣ ur ssutur ara s wudem usrid NTFS n yiɣes.

Tukksa tamagnut n userkeb n ubleɣ {0} ur teddi ara. Ayagi yezmer ad yeḍru mi ara mazal isnasen ṭṭfen ifuyla neɣ ikaramen yeldin deg ubleɣ, neɣ mi ara yettwasenser yibenk ideg yella ubleɣ u aserkeb yuɣal d aqbur ur netteddu ara.

Ma ibenk mazal yeqqen, fren Ala, mdel isnasen i yesseqdacen ableɣ, ɛreḍ tukksa n userkeb tikkelt-nniḍen.

Ma ibenk yettwasenser neɣ aserkeb d aqbur ur netteddu ara, VeraCrypt yezmer ad yeɛreḍ asizdeg aɛejlan, s tukksa yettwasmezgren n userkeb n unagraw n yifuyla, syen s tukksa neɣ s usɣiwes n tukksa n tɣawsiwin n VeraCrypt deg yiɣes. Tira yettṛaǧun tezmer ur teddi ara, isefka zemren ad ṛuḥen, u asizdeg yezmer ad yeqqim yettṛaǧu alamma isnasen mdlen ifuyla yeldin. Senqed anagraw n yifuyla s fsck neɣ s ufecku iwulmen n useggem uqbel ad t-tesqedceḍ tikkelt-nniḍen.

Ad tkemmleḍ?

Asizdeg aɛejlan i ubleɣ {0} yebda. Ma ableɣ yettwasenser, aserkeb yella d aqbur ur netteddu ara, neɣ tella tira yettṛaǧun, senqed anagraw n yifuyla s fsck neɣ s ufecku iwulmen n useggem uqbel ad t-tesqedceḍ tikkelt-nniḍen.

Ibenk i yettwafernen '{0}' d aḥraz neɣ d ableɣ APFS yettwasuddes s useɣẓan, ur yezmir ara ad yettwaseqdec d ibenk arewway i uḥraz n ubleɣ n VeraCrypt.\n\nFren deg umḍiq-is aḥric arruman n uḥraz APFS{1}.

macOS yelɣa-d belli ibenk i yettwafernen d i tɣuri kan. Ma wa d aḍebsi APFS, ḍmen belli tferneḍ aḥric arruman n uḥraz APFS, mačči d ableɣ APFS yettwasuddes s useɣẓan. Seqdec Disk Utility neɣ 'diskutil list' akken ad d-tesneḍ aḥric arruman, syen ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen.

Ableɣ-a yettwajerred d anurif n unagraw, u iɣewwaṛen-is n PIM akked/neɣ KDF ttwabeddlen.
Tebɣiḍ VeraCrypt ad imucceḍ s wudem awurman tawila n unurif n unagraw (tiseglutin n unedbal ilaqent)?

Ẓer belli ma terriḍ ala, ad tesɛuḍ ad tmucceḍeḍ anurif n unagraw s ufus.

KDF i yettwafernen yesseqdac iɣewwaṛen n PIM yemgaraden, ihi VeraCrypt ur yesseqdac ara tikkelt-nniḍen PIM udmawan amiran. Tasenṭit tamaynut n ubleɣ ad tesqdec PIM amezwer n KDF i yettwafernen, ala ma tferneḍ "Seqdec PIM" deg uḥric Amaynut u teskecmeḍ azal udmawan.\n\nTebɣiḍ ad tkemmleḍ?

VeraCrypt ur yezmir ara ad isentem belli agraw n yimsaliyen n usekkar EFI yemṣada akked twila tamirant n Secure Boot. Yezmer CA n Microsoft ilaqen ixuṣṣ deg db neɣ yettwabder deg dbx, neɣ amutti n firmware ur yezmir ara ad yettwaɣer neɣ talɣa-s ur tṣeḥḥa ara. Ulac amutti dbx d ayen ameɣtu; maca tuccḍa n twassna n dbx s wazal ur nelli ara d ilem mačči d ayen ameɣtu.\n\nRmed Microsoft Corporation UEFI CA 2011, neɣ rmed snat-a: Microsoft UEFI CA 2023 d Microsoft Option ROM UEFI CA 2023, syen selkem Aseggem/Allus n usebded n VeraCrypt. Eǧǧ Secure Boot yensa alamma tiwassniwin beggḍent-d askazal ummid i yettḥeqqiqen amṣada.

Taflwit n Terminal ad d-teldi mi ara tsateḍ ɣef 'OK', ad tesenqed anagraw n yifuyla deg ubleɣ n VeraCrypt i yettwafernen s 'diskutil'. Agmuḍ ad d-yettwabeggeḍ deg tfelwit-nni.\n\nMa asenqed ur yezmir ara ad yebdu, Disk Utility ad yessenker deg umḍiq-is.

Taflwit n Terminal ad d-teldi mi ara tsateḍ ɣef 'OK', ad tɛreḍ ad tseggem anagraw n yifuyla deg ubleɣ n VeraCrypt i yettwafernen s 'diskutil'. Agmuḍ ad d-yettwabeggeḍ deg tfelwit-nni.\n\nMa aseggem ur yezmir ara ad yebdu, Disk Utility ad yessenker deg umḍiq-is.

Ɣur-k: VeraCrypt ur yezmir ara ad isenqed ifuyla yettwasbedden n umsali n usekkar EFI ilmend n yiwen n ugraw ummid n teɣbula yettwasuddsen deg-s, u ad isentem belli meṛṛa tisudutin n uselken (CA) yettwassnen i ilaqen i uzmul llant deg db u ur ttwabedrent ara deg dbx. Firmware yezmer ad yagi VeraCrypt mi ara yermed Secure Boot.\n\nUqbel asekkar s Secure Boot yermden, err-d iselkinen n Microsoft ilaqen d dbx amiran ilmend n wayen ilaqen, syen selkem Aseggem/Allus n usebded n VeraCrypt. Ur kkes ara Microsoft Corporation UEFI CA 2011 alamma db yesɛa snat-a: Microsoft UEFI CA 2023 d Microsoft Option ROM UEFI CA 2023, u ifuyla i yettwasbedden s tidet mṣadan akked ugraw 2023 n VeraCrypt. Asenqed-a ur yezmir ara ad d-yeskanay yal tukksa n uselken ilmend n udsil n tugna neɣ n lqem n tɣellist. Ḍmen belli tesɛiḍ aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt yettwamucceḍ.

Ɣur-k: VeraCrypt ur yezmir ara ad isenqed azmul yettwasuddsen d umṣada akked tisudutin n uselken (CA) yettwassnen n Windows Boot Manager i yessekkir deffir-s (bootmgfw_ms.vc). Afaylu yezmer ixuṣṣ, ur yezmir ara ad yettwaɣer, mačči d Windows Boot Manager, yesɛa anazmal yettwasuddsen ur nettwassen ara, neɣ yesseqdac CA yettwassnen n uzmul i ixuṣṣen deg db neɣ i yettwabedren deg dbx. Asɛeddi n usenqad ɣer Windows yezmer ur yetteddu ara mi ara yermed Secure Boot.\n\nFak neɣ seggem amucceḍ n uselkin Secure Boot d umsefrak n usekkar n Windows, eǧǧ tanfa n yiblaɣen inurifen n unagraw n VeraCrypt termed, syen selkem Aseggem/Allus n usebded n VeraCrypt. Aseggem isenqad daɣen inɣalen EFI_EX/EFI i imucceḍ Windows akken ad d-yaf amsefrak amiran n usekkar yemṣadan. Ma Windows ur yezmir ara ad yessenker, sens Secure Boot i kra n wakud akken ad terreḍ anagraw ɣer umahil. Ḍmen belli tesɛiḍ aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt yettwamucceḍ.

Ɣur-k: Azmul yettwasuddsen n Windows Boot Manager i yesseqdac VeraCrypt (bootmgfw_ms.vc) mazal yekka-d seg Microsoft Windows Production PCA 2011, ɣas akken db n firmware yesɛa yakan Windows UEFI CA 2023. CA-ines yettwassnen yettwasireg tura, maca amsefrak-a ur yettsekkir ara mi ara yettwarnu uselkin PCA 2011 ɣer dbx.\n\nUr snes ara yakan aselken n PCA 2011 (abit AvailableUpdates 0x80, ula deg wazal yedduklen 0x280). D amezwaru, fak amucceḍ n umsefrak n usekkar 2023 n Windows mi ara termed tenfa n yiblaɣen inurifen n unagraw n VeraCrypt, syen selkem Aseggem/Allus n usebded n VeraCrypt akken VeraCrypt ad yezmir ad d-yekter anɣel EFI_EX/EFI yettwamucceḍ, yemṣadan. Senqed belli amsuffeɣ n uzmul yettwasuddsen deg bootmgfw_ms.vc d Windows UEFI CA 2023, u ḍmen belli tesɛiḍ aḍebsi n usellek n VeraCrypt yettwamucceḍ.
